    Wuyang Luan, Junhui Li, Weiguang Zhao, Rui Ma, Tieru Wu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SnapFlow introduces self-distillation targets and a destination-time projection to reduce a pretrained VLA’s action generation to one evaluation, with empirical gains in latency and task performance. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to model computation, while its action-generation focus alone offers little evidence about compositional generalization.

    SnapFlow 引入自蒸馏目标和目标时间投影，将预训练 VLA 的动作生成减少到一次评估，并在延迟和任务表现上取得实证提升。这对模型计算作出了重要的算法贡献，而其对动作生成的关注本身很少提供有关组合泛化的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-language-action (VLA) models with flow-matching action heads, such as {\pi}0 and {\pi}0.5, have become a standard recipe for generalist robot manipulation, but every action chunk is produced by integrating a learned velocity field over about ten sequential action-expert evaluations, so action generation dominates model latency and caps the achievable control frequency. Existing remedies either shrink each evaluation through layer distillation or pruning while leaving the sequential solver in place, or import one-step objectives from image generation that were designed for training from scratch, rely on an exponential-moving-average teacher or an external critic, and regress finite-span targets onto the conditional velocity, whose variance around the marginal field biases the learned map. We introduce SnapFlow, a self-distillation method that adapts a pretrained flow-matching VLA to one-step action generation. SnapFlow mixes local flow-matching supervision with shortcut samples whose target is the model's own two-step Euler endpoint under stop-gradient, and adds a single zero-initialized destination-time projection so that one action expert serves both objectives while the pretrained predictor is preserved at initialization; no separate teacher network or critic is required. On {\pi}0.5, whose 10-NFE teacher operates near ceiling, the archived one-NFE SnapFlow checkpoint reaches 98.75% LIBERO success versus 97.75% for the teacher; under a separate paired evaluation of {\pi}0, the one-NFE model surpasses its teacher by 10.5 percentage points. SnapFlow also lowers mean and tail action error on held-out data, cuts batch-one model latency by about 3.3x, and transfers to shelf retrieval on a dual-arm humanoid.

    采用流匹配动作头的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，如 {\pi}0 和 {\pi}0.5，已成为通用机器人操作的标准方案，但每个动作块都要通过对学习到的速度场进行积分，并依次调用动作专家约十次才能生成，因此动作生成占据了模型的大部分延迟，并限制了可实现的控制频率。现有改进方法要么通过层蒸馏或剪枝缩短每次调用的耗时，但保留了顺序求解器；要么引入源自图像生成的一步目标，而这些目标原本是为从头训练设计的，依赖指数移动平均教师或外部评论器，并将有限跨度目标回归到条件速度上，而该速度相对于边缘场的方差会使学习到的映射产生偏差。我们提出 SnapFlow，一种自蒸馏方法，可将预训练的流匹配 VLA 调整为单步动作生成。SnapFlow 将局部流匹配监督与捷径样本结合起来；这些样本的目标是在停止梯度条件下由模型自身两步欧拉法得到的终点。它还加入一个零初始化的目标时间投影，使同一个动作专家能够服务于两种目标，同时在初始化时保留预训练预测器；该方法无需单独的教师网络或评论器。在 10-NFE 教师模型已接近性能上限的 {\pi}0.5 上，归档的单 NFE SnapFlow 检查点达到 98.75% 的 LIBERO 成功率，高于教师的 97.75%；在对 {\pi}0 进行的另一项配对评估中，单 NFE 模型比其教师高出 10.5 个百分点。SnapFlow 还降低了留出数据上的平均动作误差和尾部动作误差，将批次大小为 1 时的模型延迟缩短约 3.3 倍，并能迁移到双臂人形机器人的货架取物任务。

    Phantom Paradoxes: Language Models Treat Unresolved Circular Truth Dependence as Contradiction

    幽灵悖论：语言模型将未解决的循环真值依赖视为矛盾

    Ji Ho Bae

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study tests how models handle unresolved circular truth dependence and uses layer-wise truth directions to probe internal representations, providing substantial behavioral and mechanistic evidence about logical reasoning. Circular structure connects to composition, but the abstract does not make compositional learning or generalization a main contribution.

    该研究测试模型如何处理未解决的循环真值依赖，并使用逐层真值方向探查内部表征，为逻辑推理提供了重要的行为和机制证据。循环结构与组合能力有关，但摘要并未将组合学习或泛化作为主要贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Do language models struggle with self-reference itself, or with structures where propagating truth values along references cannot settle a value in finitely many steps? Our results support the latter. In our main test, statements refer to one another's truth in a cycle, yet exactly one consistent assignment exists. Local propagation never settles the queried value, but exhaustive search finds it, so INCONSISTENT (no consistent assignment) is always wrong. We call such misreadings of satisfiable problems phantom paradoxes. Each circular problem has a grounded twin with the same answer but no cycle. To rule out logical difficulty and unfamiliar wording, we added constraint twins (equivalent formulas without talk of truth) and perplexity-matched grounded controls. In confirmatory behavioral tests fixed before any confirmation response, four open models from three families answered INCONSISTENT on average 31.0 percentage points more often on circular problems than on grounded twins, 36.4 more than on constraint twins and 37.1 more than on perplexity-matched controls. In each model, validated layer-wise truth directions, fitted on unrelated arithmetic, recovered the queried value at the question's last token for grounded twins but not for circular problems. Constraint twins, likewise unrecovered, drew INCONSISTENT far less often, so circular truth dependence, not the unrecovered value alone, matters. In a small natural-language bank, self-reference settling in finitely many steps drew INCONSISTENT 23.4 points less often than unsettled self-reference with the same classical solution. Pooled tests did not show the predicted late-layer revision or attention spread. Overall, models treat unresolved circular truth dependence as contradiction. We will release all prompts, outputs and hidden states.

    中文

    语言模型是难以处理自指本身，还是难以处理这样一种结构：沿引用传播真值后，无法在有限步内确定真值？我们的结果支持后一种解释。在主要测试中，陈述以循环方式相互指涉彼此的真值，但恰好存在一种一致赋值。局部传播始终无法确定所查询的值，但穷举搜索可以找到它，因此回答“不一致”（不存在一致赋值）总是错误的。我们将这类对可满足问题的误读称为幽灵悖论。每个循环问题都有一个答案相同但不存在循环的有根对应题。为排除逻辑难度和措辞陌生性的影响，我们加入了约束对应题（不谈真值但公式等价）以及困惑度匹配的有根对照题。在任何确认性回答出现之前就预先设定的确认性行为测试中，来自三个系列的四个开放模型在循环问题上回答“不一致”的比例，平均比有根对应题高 31.0 个百分点，比约束对应题高 36.4 个百分点，比困惑度匹配的对照题高 37.1 个百分点。在每个模型中，使用无关算术数据拟合并经验证的逐层真值方向，在有根对应题的问题末尾词元处恢复了所查询的值，但在循环问题中没有做到。约束对应题同样无法恢复该值，但其引发“不一致”回答的比例远低于循环题，因此起作用的是循环真值依赖本身，而不只是无法恢复该值。在一个小型自然语言题库中，对于能在有限步内确定结果的自指问题，与经典解相同但无法确定结果的自指问题相比，回答“不一致”的比例低 23.4 个百分点。汇总测试未显示预期的后层修正或注意力扩散。总体而言，模型将未解决的循环真值依赖视为矛盾。我们将发布所有提示、输出和隐藏状态。

    Physical reasoning over images requires integrating perception, domain knowledge, and multi-step symbolic inference, yet Vision-Language Models (VLMs) fall far short of human performance on physics benchmarks. Reinforcement learning can improve reasoning via reward signals, but it remains unclear whether these signals must come from outside the model or can be derived from the model itself. We compare external rewards, which rely on an outside verifier (rule-based format and answer-correctness checks, or an LLM-judge rubric), with an internal attention-based reward computed from the model's own attention over image regions, requiring no labels or judge. We find that external rewards drive most of the accuracy gains, while preserving more coherent reasoning when rewarded for reasoning tokens. The internal attention-based reward, provides an annotation-free grounding signal that improves spatial-relation reasoning and is complementary to external rewards: adding it to format and accuracy rewards, at no additional annotation cost, improves average accuracy on Molmo~2 while generalizing to out-of-distribution tasks.     Vibe coding turns natural-language intent into working software, but code generation alone does not give humans and agents a shared account of what they are building. As collaboration spans participants, components, and releases, design choices must remain understandable and open to revision. We argue that scaling human and AI coding collaboration requires a governable consensus layer. Agentic Consensus organizes collaboration around a versioned project-state model linking selected intent, structural commitments, executable artifacts, and evidence. Participants can clarify intent before implementation and coordinate proposed changes against commitments that humans can inspect and revise. Bidirectional synchronization connects intended changes to implementation and exposes conflicts or stale evidence as artifacts evolve. We implemented its review workflow in Consensus Control. In a small exploratory human study, 10 participants used the system on projects from their everyday work and reported clearer, faster understanding of agent-submitted changes. A three-condition comparison with the same participants collected 60 responses, with near-ceiling decision scores and measured representation and pipeline costs.     ENGLISH

    LLM-based agentic systems are rapidly evolving to perform complex autonomous tasks through dynamic tool invocation, stateful memory management, and multi-agent collaboration. However, this semantics-driven execution paradigm creates a severe semantic gap between low-level physical events and high-level execution intent, making post-hoc security auditing fundamentally difficult. Existing representation mechanisms, including static SBOMs and runtime logs, provide only fragmented evidence and fail to capture cognitive-state evolution, capability bindings, persistent memory contamination, and cascading risk propagation across interacting agents. To bridge this gap, we propose Agent-BOM, a unified structural representation for agent security auditing. Agent-BOM models an agentic system as a hierarchical attributed directed graph that separates static capability bases, such as models, tools, and long-term memory, from dynamic runtime semantic states, such as goals, reasoning trajectories, and actions. These layers are connected through semantic edges and security attributes, transforming fragmented execution traces into queryable audit paths. Building on Agent-BOM, we develop a graph-query-based paradigm for path-level risk assessment and instantiate it with the OWASP Agentic Top 10. We further implement an auditing plugin in the OpenClaw environment to construct Agent-BOM from live executions. Evaluation on representative real-world agentic attack scenarios shows that Agent-BOM can reconstruct stealthy attack chains, including cross-session memory poisoning and tool misuse, capability supply-chain hijacking and unexpected code execution, multi-agent ecosystem hijacking, and privilege and trust abuse. These results demonstrate that Agent-BOM provides a unified and auditable foundation for root-cause analysis and security adjudication in complex agentic ecosystems.

    Jiamin Xu, Jacqueline Maasch, Kyra Gan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper constructs provably minimal Markovian states from causal graphs and introduces MOSE to expose RL value functions to multiple history-based state orders. This advances RL state representation and learning, but does not study internal model mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Online reinforcement learning (RL) relies on the Markov property for guaranteed performance, but real-world applications often lack well-defined states given raw observed variables. While causal RL has attracted growing interest, existing work typically assumes Markovian states are provided and uses causality only to accelerate learning. This leaves a fundamental gap: \emph{given a longitudinal causal graph over observed variables, how does one construct MDP states that provably satisfy the Markov property?} We provide a procedure that constructs a provably minimal such state. In deep RL, the minimal representation alone empirically fails to improve performance, indicating that neural networks cannot automatically exploit Markovian minimality. We therefore propose \textbf{MOSE} (Multi-Order State Exposure), which exposes a single shared Q-function to history-based state constructions of orders 1 through $W$ simultaneously. An attention-based selection layer scores the dimensions of this combined input by their estimated relevance to value-function estimation and selects the high-scoring ones. Causal MOSE further constrains the selection layer to retain every variable of the minimal state, guaranteeing sufficiency while leaving the model free to admit useful redundancy. MOSE consistently outperforms both the minimal state construction and single-window policies on common benchmarks and synthetic datasets. Including the minimal representation alongside MOSE can further improve performance. Our results establish a core principle for causal deep RL: minimal sufficiency is not enough. \emph{Controlled redundancy} gives the model flexibility to learn its state representation end-to-end. Causal state information provides structural guidance that can make this learning more efficient.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A recent work shows that Attention Transfer, which transfers only the attention patterns from a pre-trained teacher Vision Transformer (ViT) to a randomly initialized standard student ViT, is sufficient to recover the full benefit of the teacher's pre-trained weights. We revisit this finding on a comprehensive benchmark of 20 teachers from 11 well-known ViT families and reveal that Attention Transfer is not universally effective. While 7 families transfer successfully, 4 consistently fail, falling up to 5.1\% below the from-scratch no-transfer baseline. Further results demonstrate that this failure is family-consistent across model sizes, and persists under extended training durations, different transfer datasets, and out-of-distribution evaluations. Controlled analyses then consistently localize the problem to the attention-routing channel, indicating that the key issue is not whether the student can match the teacher's attention patterns, but whether the matched patterns remain functional for the student. Crucially, we identify architectural mismatch between the pre-trained teacher and the standard student as the primary mechanism. By adding only the teacher's native architectural components to the student in a randomly initialized state, we completely reverse the failure for all 4 families. Notably, these components alone do not improve from-scratch training, confirming that they specifically unlock the usability of the teacher's attention. We further show that this failure is not explained by the inadequate choice of transfer loss, differences in pre-training recipes, or the intrinsic quality of attention maps. Our findings refine the prevailing understanding of attention in ViT representations: attention is sufficient \textit{only} when the student architecture matches the teacher.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Expressive generative policies such as diffusion and flow models are appealing for maximum-entropy (MaxEnt) online reinforcement learning because of their ability to model multimodal and highly non-Gaussian action distributions. However, training effective soft generative policies faces two obstacles that often arise together. First, marginal action densities are often unavailable, so existing methods typically rely on entropy bounds, heuristic proxies or approximations. Second, iterative shared-parameter samplers raise inference cost and require backpropagation through time over repeated network evaluations, increasing memory cost and potentially destabilizing policy optimization. These obstacles motivate us to seek a generative actor-critic method that exposes a tractable soft objective while generating each action in just one network evaluation. To this end, we propose soft generative actor-critic (SoftGAC), whose actor is a single stochastic feedforward network with internal Gaussian bridge layers. This explicit bridge structure allows us to lift the soft objective to path space, yielding an analytical path-KL regularizer against a high-entropy reference process for both actor improvement and the soft Bellman bootstrap, without estimating the endpoint entropy. Crucially, the actor generates each action in only one network evaluation under a total parameter budget comparable to strong baselines, substantially reducing inference cost relative to the existing iterative diffusion and flow policies. It also avoids long unrolled backpropagation through time. Across challenging continuous-control benchmarks, our method achieves competitive or superior returns compared with strong diffusion and flow policies, demonstrating a clear advantage in the compute-return tradeoff.

    扩散模型和流模型等表达能力强的生成式策略，因能够建模多模态且高度非高斯的动作分布，适用于最大熵（MaxEnt）在线强化学习。然而，训练有效的软生成式策略面临两个经常同时出现的障碍。第一，边缘动作密度往往无法获取，因此现有方法通常依赖熵界、启发式代理指标或近似。第二，迭代式共享参数采样器会增加推理成本，而且需要在重复的网络评估上执行时间反向传播，从而增加内存成本，并可能使策略优化不稳定。这些障碍促使我们寻求一种生成式 actor-critic 方法，使其软目标函数可处理，同时每个动作只需一次网络评估即可生成。为此，我们提出软生成式 actor-critic（SoftGAC），其 actor 是一个带有内部高斯桥接层的单一随机前馈网络。这种显式桥接结构使我们能够将软目标函数提升到路径空间，从而为策略改进和软 Bellman 自举提供相对于高熵参考过程的解析路径 KL 正则项，无需估计端点熵。至关重要的是，在总参数预算与强基线相当的情况下，该 actor 每个动作只需一次网络评估即可生成；与现有迭代式扩散和流策略相比，这大幅降低了推理成本。它也避免了长链展开的时间反向传播。在具有挑战性的连续控制基准上，与强扩散和流策略相比，我们的方法取得了具有竞争力或更高的回报，展现出明显的计算量与回报权衡优势。

    Haohui Zhang, Zhiye Wang, Xiaoying Gan, Xinbing Wang, Bo Jiang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LEAP introduces a training-free method that detects early-converging tokens to reduce diffusion language model decoding steps while preserving precision, a substantial contribution to parallel inference and computation allocation. Its use on GSM8K is an evaluation setting, not evidence of a contribution to reasoning mechanisms or capability development.

    LEAP 提出一种无需训练的方法，通过检测早收敛 token 来减少扩散语言模型的解码步数，同时保持精度；这是对并行推理和计算资源分配的重要贡献。其在 GSM8K 上的使用只是评估场景，并不能证明它对推理机制或能力发展有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion Language Models (dLLMs) have garnered significant attention for their potential in highly parallel processing. The parallel capabilities of existing dLLMs stem from the assumption of conditional independence at high confidence levels, which ensures negligible discrepancy between the marginal and joint distributions. However, the stringent confidence thresholds required to preserve accuracy severely constrain the scalability of parallelism. Through systematic token-level statistical analysis, we reveal that a substantial proportion of tokens converge to their correct predictions early in the denoising process yet fail to reach standard confidence thresholds, confirming that current confidence-based criteria are overly conservative. In response, we introduce LEAP (Lookahead Early-Convergence Token Detection for Accelerated Parallel Decoding). LEAP is a training-free, plug-and-play method that leverages future context filtering and multi-sequence superposition to detect early-converging tokens. By validating the alignment between early convergence and correctness, we enable reliable early decoding of these tokens. Benchmarking across diverse domains demonstrates that LEAP significantly lowers inference latency and decoding steps. Compared to confidence-based decoding, the average number of denoising steps is reduced by about 30%. On the GSM8K dataset, combining LEAP with dParallel accelerates decoding to 7.2 tokens per step while preserving model precision. LEAP effectively breaks the reliance on high-confidence priors, offering a novel paradigm for parallel decoding.

    中文

    扩散语言模型（dLLM）因具有高度并行处理的潜力而备受关注。现有 dLLM 的并行能力基于高置信度下条件独立的假设，该假设可确保边缘分布与联合分布之间的差异可以忽略不计。然而，为维持准确率而要求的严格置信度阈值严重限制了并行能力的扩展性。通过系统性的 token 级统计分析，我们发现大量 token 在去噪过程早期就已收敛到正确预测，却未能达到标准置信度阈值，证实当前基于置信度的判据过于保守。为此，我们提出 LEAP（用于加速并行解码的前瞻式早收敛 token 检测）。LEAP 是一种无需训练、即插即用的方法，利用未来上下文过滤和多序列叠加来检测早收敛 token。通过验证早期收敛与正确性之间的一致性，我们能够可靠地提前解码这些 token。在多个领域进行的基准测试表明，LEAP 显著降低了推理延迟和解码步数。与基于置信度的解码相比，去噪步数平均减少约 30%。在 GSM8K 数据集上，将 LEAP 与 dParallel 结合，可将解码速度提升至每步 7.2 个 token，同时保持模型精度。LEAP 有效摆脱了对高置信度先验的依赖，为并行解码提供了一种新范式。

    快与慢的学习：迈向能够持续适应的 LLM

    Rishabh Tiwari, Kusha Sareen, Lakshya A Agrawal, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Matei Zaharia, Kurt Keutzer, Inderjit S Dhillon, Rishabh Agarwal, Devvrit Khatri

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes fast-slow training that learns task-specific information in optimized context while preserving slower model weights, improving continual adaptation and reasoning-task performance. Its contribution substantially advances training for reasoning capability, while context adaptation is a limited memory-like systems connection without a broader systems design contribution.

    本文提出快速—慢速训练，在保留较慢模型权重的同时，通过优化上下文学习任务特定信息，从而提升持续适应能力和推理任务表现。它对推理能力训练作出了重要推进；上下文适应与系统记忆的联系较为有限，并未构成更广泛的系统设计贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) are trained for downstream tasks by updating their parameters (e.g., via RL). However, updating model parameters forces them to absorb task-specific information, which can result in catastrophic forgetting and loss of plasticity. In contrast, in-context learning with fixed LLM parameters can cheaply and rapidly adapt to task-specific requirements (e.g., prompt optimization), but cannot by itself typically match the performance gains available through updating LLM parameters. Inspired by how human learning works at multiple time scales (e.g., System 1 vs 2), we propose a fast-slow learning framework for LLMs, instantiated with model parameters as "slow" weights and optimized context as "fast" weights. These fast "weights" can learn from textual feedback to absorb the task-specific information, while allowing slow weights to stay closer to the base model and persist general reasoning behaviors. Fast-Slow Training (FST) is up to 3x more sample-efficient than only slow learning (RL) across reasoning tasks, while consistently reaching a higher performance asymptote. Moreover, FST-trained models remain closer to the base LLM (up to 70% less KL divergence), resulting in less catastrophic forgetting than RL-training. This reduced drift also preserves plasticity: after training on one task, FST trained models adapt more effectively to a subsequent task. In continual learning scenarios, where task domains change on the fly, FST continues to acquire each new task while RL stalls.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）通过更新参数（例如通过 RL）来训练下游任务。然而，更新模型参数会迫使模型吸收任务特定信息，可能导致灾难性遗忘和可塑性丧失。相比之下，固定 LLM 参数的上下文学习可以低成本、快速地适应任务特定需求（例如提示优化），但通常仅靠它无法达到更新 LLM 参数所能带来的性能提升。受人类多时间尺度学习方式（例如系统 1 与系统 2）的启发，我们提出一种面向 LLM 的快慢学习框架，将模型参数作为“慢”权重，将优化后的上下文作为“快”权重。快速“权重”能够从文本反馈中学习并吸收任务特定信息，同时让慢速权重保持更接近基础模型，并保留通用推理行为。在多个推理任务上，快速—慢速训练（FST）的样本效率最高可达到仅慢速学习（RL）的 3 倍，且性能渐近值始终更高。此外，FST 训练的模型与基础 LLM 更为接近（KL 散度最多低 70%），因此比 RL 训练更不容易发生灾难性遗忘。这种较小的偏移也保留了可塑性：在一个任务上训练之后，FST 训练的模型能更有效地适应后续任务。在任务领域动态变化的持续学习场景中，FST 能继续习得每个新任务，而 RL 则会停滞。

    Symmetry-Compatible Principle for Optimizer Design: Embeddings, LM Heads, SwiGLU MLPs, and MoE Routers

    优化器设计的对称性兼容原则：嵌入层、LM 头、SwiGLU MLP 与 MoE 路由器

    Tim Tsz-Kit Lau and Weijie Su

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops optimizer update rules matched to the symmetries of different parameter blocks and evaluates their effects on language-model training and MoE routing. This is a substantial contribution to model computation and organization, but its symmetry analysis concerns optimizer design rather than internal representations, compositional generalization, or reasoning.

    本文开发了与不同参数块对称性相匹配的优化器更新规则，并评估这些规则对语言模型训练和 MoE 路由的影响。这是对模型计算与组织的重要贡献，但其对称性分析关注的是优化器设计，而非内部表征、组合泛化或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A striking geometric disparity has long persisted in the practice of deep learning. While modern neural network architectures naturally exhibit rich symmetry and equivariance properties, popular optimizers such as Adam and its variants operate inherently coordinate-wise, rendering them unable to respect the equivariance structures of the parameter space. We address this disparity by introducing a symmetry-compatible principle for optimizer design: the gradient update rule should be equivariant under the symmetry group acting on the corresponding weight block. Following this principle, we first provide a unified perspective on bi-orthogonally equivariant updates for general matrix layers, as employed by stochastic spectral descent, Muon, Scion, and polar gradient methods. More importantly, by moving from orthogonal groups to permutation and shared-shift symmetries, we derive symmetry-compatible optimizers for parameter blocks whose symmetries differ from those of general matrix layers: embedding and LM head matrices, SwiGLU MLP projections, and MoE router matrices. These constructions include one-sided spectral, row-norm, hybrid row-norm/spectral, row-aware, column-aware, centered row-norm, and left-spectral updates. They yield an end-to-end layerwise optimizer stack in which each major matrix-valued parameter class is assigned an update whose equivariance matches its symmetry group. We corroborate this principle through pre-training experiments on dense and sparse MoE language models, including Qwen3-0.6B-style, Gemma 3 1B-style, OLMoE-1B-7B-style, and downsized gpt-oss architectures. Across these experiments, symmetry-compatible update rules consistently improve final validation loss, reduce expert load imbalance in sparse MoE models, and in several cases control final vocabulary-logit growth, improve router stability, and overall training stability over the corresponding AdamW updates.

    中文

    深度学习实践中长期存在一种显著的几何差异。现代神经网络架构天然具有丰富的对称性和等变性，而 Adam 及其变体等常用优化器本质上按坐标逐一运作，因而无法遵循参数空间的等变结构。我们通过提出优化器设计的对称性兼容原则来解决这一差异：梯度更新规则应当在作用于相应权重块的对称群变换下保持等变。遵循这一原则，我们首先对一般矩阵层的双正交等变更新提供统一视角，这类更新应用于随机谱下降、Muon、Scion 和极梯度方法。更重要的是，通过从正交群转向置换对称性和共享平移对称性，我们为对称性不同于一般矩阵层的参数块推导出对称性兼容优化器：嵌入矩阵和 LM 头矩阵、SwiGLU MLP 投影，以及 MoE 路由器矩阵。这些构造包括单侧谱更新、行范数更新、行范数/谱混合更新、行感知更新、列感知更新、中心化行范数更新和左谱更新。它们构成端到端的逐层优化器栈，为每一类主要的矩阵值参数分配一个等变性与其对称群相匹配的更新。我们通过在稠密和稀疏 MoE 语言模型上的预训练实验验证这一原则，包括类 Qwen3-0.6B、类 Gemma 3 1B、类 OLMoE-1B-7B 以及缩小版 gpt-oss 架构。在这些实验中，对称性兼容更新规则始终能改善最终验证损失、减少稀疏 MoE 模型中的专家负载不均衡；在若干情况下，还能控制最终词汇表 logit 的增长、改善路由器稳定性，并提升整体训练稳定性，优于对应的 AdamW 更新。

    MOCHA: Multi-Objective Chebyshev Annealing for Agent Skill Optimization

    MOCHA：面向智能体技能优化的多目标切比雪夫退火

    Md Mehrab Tanjim, Jayakumar Subramanian, Branislav Kveton, Xiang Chen, Subhojyoti Mukherjee, Anlan Zhang, Sungchul Kim, Sunav Choudhury, Somdeb Sarkhel

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MOCHA introduces a multi-objective algorithm for optimizing agent skills, improving accuracy and economy while expanding the Pareto front. This is a strong Systems contribution to agent behavior optimization; its connection to reasoning is partial because it optimizes skill specifications without studying reasoning mechanisms or capability formation.

    MOCHA 提出一种用于优化智能体技能的多目标算法，在扩展帕累托前沿的同时提升准确性和经济性。这是对智能体行为优化的有力 Systems 贡献；它与推理的联系较为有限，因为该方法优化的是技能规范，并未研究推理机制或能力形成。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents organize behavior through skills -- structured natural-language specifications that govern how an agent reasons, retrieves, and responds. Unlike monolithic prompts, skills are multi-field artifacts with platform limits: descriptions are indexed for routing, instruction bodies are loaded into a shared context window, and every extra line costs the agent context it could spend elsewhere. Skill optimization is therefore inherently multi-objective: a skill should be accurate and economical at once. Existing prompt optimizers collapse these goals into a single score, and we find that this makes them stall: in most of their runs, 1000 rollouts yield zero progress over the seed skill. We introduce MOCHA (Multi-Objective CHebyshev Annealing), which selects skills to improve by Chebyshev scalarization and accepts improvements that expand the Pareto front, annealing from exploration to exploitation. Chebyshev scalarization scores a skill by its largest weighted shortfall from a perfect skill; with random weights, it can select any skill on the Pareto front for improvement, including trade-offs that an average would never favor. Across six diverse skills and two models, MOCHA escapes the seed in nearly every run, achieving 7.9% higher mean accuracy than the strongest baseline (up to 23.7% on DebugBench with GPT 5.5 and 14.9% on FEVER with Claude Haiku 4.5) while discovering Pareto fronts with the highest hypervolume and nearly twice as many Pareto-optimal skills.

    中文

    LLM 智能体通过技能来组织行为——技能是结构化的自然语言规范，用于控制智能体如何推理、检索和响应。与单体式提示不同，技能是受平台限制的多字段产物：描述会被索引用于路由，指令正文会加载到共享上下文窗口中，而每增加一行都会占用智能体原本可用于其他任务的上下文。因此，技能优化本质上是多目标问题：技能既要准确，也要经济。现有提示优化器将这些目标合并为单一分数，我们发现这会使它们停滞：在大多数运行中，1000 次 rollout 相较于种子技能都没有取得任何进展。我们提出 MOCHA（Multi-Objective CHebyshev Annealing，多目标切比雪夫退火），通过切比雪夫标量化选择要改进的技能，并接受能够扩展帕累托前沿的改进，使搜索从探索逐步转向利用。切比雪夫标量化依据技能相对于完美技能的最大加权差距对其评分；使用随机权重时，它能够选中帕累托前沿上的任何技能进行改进，包括平均分永远不会偏好的权衡方案。在六种不同技能和两个模型上的实验中，MOCHA 几乎每次运行都能摆脱种子技能，平均准确率比最强基线高 7.9%（在使用 GPT 5.5 的 DebugBench 上最高高出 23.7%，在使用 Claude Haiku 4.5 的 FEVER 上高出 14.9%），同时发现了超体积最高、帕累托最优技能数量近乎翻倍的帕累托前沿。

    OScaR: The Occam's Razor for Extreme KV Cache Quantization in LLMs and Beyond

    OScaR：面向 LLM 及其他模型的极端 KV 缓存量化之奥卡姆剃刀

    Zunhai Su, Rui Yang, Chao Zhang, Yaxiu Liu, Yifan Zhang, Wei Wu, Jing Xiong, Dayou Du, Xialie Zhuang, Yulei Qian, Jianchao Tan, Yuchen Xie, Yik-Chung Wu, Hongxia Yang, Ngai Wong

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    OScaR analyzes token norm imbalance and proposes rotations, scaling, and systems optimizations for extreme KV-cache compression. Its memory and computation improvements are a substantial Systems contribution, while links to internal representations and long-context reasoning are incidental to deployment efficiency.

    OScaR 分析 token 范数不平衡，并为极端 KV 缓存压缩提出旋转、缩放和系统优化。它在内存和计算效率方面的改进构成了重要的 Systems 贡献，而与内部表征及长上下文推理的联系只是部署效率方面的附带因素。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The rapid advancement toward long-context reasoning and multi-modal intelligence has made the memory footprint of the Key-Value (KV) cache a dominant memory bottleneck for efficient deployment. While the established per-channel quantization effectively accommodates intrinsic channel-wise outliers in Key tensors, its efficacy diminishes under extreme compression. In this work, we revisit the inherent limitations of the per-channel quantization paradigm from both empirical and theoretical perspectives. Our analysis identifies Token Norm Imbalance (TNI) as the primary bottleneck to quantization fidelity. We demonstrate that TNI systematically amplifies errors when shared quantization parameters are required to span token groups exhibiting substantial norm disparities. Instead of relying on intricate quantization pipelines (e.g., TurboQuant), we propose OScaR (Omni-Scaled Canalized Rotation), an accurate and lightweight KV cache compression framework for X-LLMs (i.e., text-only, multi-modal, and omni-modal LLMs). Advancing the per-channel paradigm, OScaR employs Canalized Rotation followed by Omni-Token Scaling to mitigate TNI-induced sequence-dimensional variance both effectively and efficiently, further supported by our optimized system design and CUDA kernels. Extensive evaluations across X-LLMs show that OScaR consistently outperforms existing methods and achieves near-lossless performance under INT2 quantization, establishing it as a robust, low-complexity, and universal framework that defines a new Pareto front. Compared with the BF16 FlashDecoding-v2 baseline, our OScaR implementation achieves a notable up to 3.0x speedup in decoding, reduces memory footprint by 5.3x, and increases throughput by 4.1x. The code for OScaR is publicly available at https://github.com/ZunhaiSu/OScaR-KV-Quant.

    中文

    随着长上下文推理和多模态智能的快速发展，键值（KV）缓存的内存占用已成为高效部署的主要内存瓶颈。成熟的逐通道量化能够有效适应 Key 张量中固有的通道级离群值，但在极端压缩下效果会减弱。在这项工作中，我们从实证和理论两个角度重新审视逐通道量化范式的内在局限。我们的分析指出，Token Norm Imbalance（TNI，Token 范数不平衡）是影响量化保真度的主要瓶颈。我们证明，当共享量化参数需要覆盖范数差异显著的 token 组时，TNI 会系统性地放大量化误差。我们不依赖复杂的量化流水线（例如 TurboQuant），而是提出 OScaR（Omni-Scaled Canalized Rotation，全尺度导流旋转），这是一种面向 X-LLM（即纯文本、多模态和全模态 LLM）的精准、轻量级 KV 缓存压缩框架。在逐通道范式的基础上，OScaR 先进行 Canalized Rotation（导流旋转），再进行 Omni-Token Scaling（全 token 缩放），以有效且高效地缓解 TNI 引发的序列维度方差，并由优化后的系统设计和 CUDA 内核进一步提供支持。针对 X-LLM 的大量评估表明，OScaR 持续优于现有方法，并在 INT2 量化下实现近乎无损的性能，由此成为一种稳健、低复杂度且通用的框架，开辟了新的帕累托前沿。与 BF16 FlashDecoding-v2 基线相比，我们的 OScaR 实现使解码速度最高提升 3.0 倍，内存占用减少 5.3 倍，吞吐量提高 4.1 倍。OScaR 的代码已公开发布于 https://github.com/ZunhaiSu/OScaR-KV-Quant。

We address the lack of large-scale supervision for structured Torrance Test of Creative Writing (TTCW)-based evaluation by constructing a dataset of 263{,}911 long-form stories, each paired with scalar scores and meta-synthesised review comments across 14 TTCW-based dimensions. Using this dataset, we study whether reviewer-style reasoning traces improve structured literary review generation across Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Nemotron-8B. Across all three models, no-trace supervision yields higher score imitation fidelity and near-complete report generation, whereas trace supervision reduces completion to $85.9$--$90.9\%$. Failure analysis shows that $88.6\%$ of failed reasoning generations contain semantic repetition loops inside the trace. These loops concentrate in particular story--criterion interactions and progressively harden after onset, while comparable repetition is rare in the supervision data. Our results suggest that, for long-form tasks requiring strictly structured outputs, explicit reasoning traces can introduce generation instability that outweighs their overall benefit.

    ENGLISH

    KV cache growth is a major bottleneck for long-context inference in large language models. Existing methods are often dominated by binary eviction or representation approximation, which may underutilize tokens that are not critical for exact retention but are still reconstructable. We present VECTOR, a plug-and-play augmentation for eviction-based pipelines that introduces three-way token routing: retention, approximation, and eviction. VECTOR combines an importance signal from the base scorer with a reconstructability signal from an offline-calibrated regression-based value estimation. By leveraging reconstructability, VECTOR recovers useful value information that would otherwise be irreversibly lost under binary eviction, while preserving key vectors for attention routing stability. On LongBench, RULER with contexts up to 128K tokens, and multi-turn SCBench, VECTOR yields significant gains over its base eviction methods under high compression. At a 90% compression ratio, SnapKV augmented with VECTOR outperforms six competing compression methods, including D2O and RocketKV, on all three evaluated models. Since VECTOR makes all routing decisions at prefill, decoding runs on a standard compressed cache with no measurable overhead.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SD-JEPA separates progression from content in world-model latents and shows that a small subspace tracks task progress, backtracking, and surprise, providing substantial insight into representation geometry. Its planning results connect secondarily to reasoning and agent systems, while the abstract does not establish compositional generalization.

    SD-JEPA 将世界模型潜变量中的进程与内容分离，并表明一个小子空间能够追踪任务进度、回退和意外，为表征几何提供了重要见解。其规划结果与推理及智能体系统有次要关联，而摘要并未证明组合泛化能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    World models used for planning learn to predict how a scene evolves, yet they rarely hold a global view of how far a task has progressed. We argue that such a view should be part of the representation, and that it can be compact: describing a scene takes many dimensions, but where the scene stands on its way to the goal can be summarised by only a few. We propose SD-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive world model whose latent is split into a small progression subspace and a large content subspace. A temporal triplet loss keeps consecutive frames of a trajectory close in the progression coordinates and separates different trajectories, while a distributional regulariser keeps the content coordinates from collapsing. On four control benchmarks, the model plans as well as the same architecture without the split. In return, its latent becomes easier to read. A few percent of its dimensions are enough to predict progress within an episode, and the angle they form follows the task, moves backward when the agent backtracks and changes fastest around events such as grasps and releases. Surprise also becomes anchored in the trajectory: when the scene changes mid-episode, the angle spikes and then relocalizes on a new part of the progression, anchoring surprise in the agent's own map of the task.

    中文

    用于规划的世界模型会学习预测场景如何演变，但很少能整体把握任务进展到了哪一步。我们认为，这种全局视角应当成为表征的一部分，而且可以很紧凑：描述一个场景需要许多维度，但概括场景在通往目标的过程中所处的位置只需少数几个维度。我们提出 SD-JEPA，这是一种联合嵌入预测世界模型，其潜变量被拆分为一个较小的进程子空间和一个较大的内容子空间。时间三元组损失使同一轨迹中的相邻帧在进程坐标中彼此接近，并将不同轨迹分开；同时，分布正则项防止内容坐标发生坍塌。在四个控制基准上，该模型的规划能力与采用相同架构但未进行拆分的模型相当。作为回报，其潜变量更易于解读。只需使用其几个百分点的维度，就足以预测一个 episode 内的进度；这些维度形成的角度会随任务推进而变化，在智能体回退时向后移动，并在抓取和释放等事件附近变化最快。意外也变得与轨迹相关：当场景在 episode 中途发生变化时，角度会突然增大，随后在进程的另一个位置重新定位，从而将意外锚定在智能体自己的任务地图中。

    Matthew Dowling, Hyungju Jeon, Cristina Savin, Il Memming Park

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives Bayesian sequence layers that track uncertainty in associative memory and shows how several recurrent architectures relate to this design, with empirical retrieval and robustness gains. This offers substantial insight into model memory and sequence computation, but does not study internal representation mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文推导出能够追踪联想记忆不确定性的贝叶斯序列层，并展示了多种循环架构与这一设计之间的关系，同时报告了检索和鲁棒性方面的实证提升。这为模型记忆与序列计算提供了重要见解，但并未研究内部表征机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We introduce the \emph{design-model framework}: a way to derive efficient recurrent sequence maps from explicit assumptions about memory. A design model writes evidence into memory by exact Bayesian filtering; a query- dependent readout produces a predictive distribution whose mean is the layer output. In our linear-Gaussian instantiation, the \emph{Bayesian Layer} propagates both a mean and a covariance: the covariance tracks uncertainty over stored associations, steering writes toward uncertain directions, attenuating gains as evidence accumulates, and preserving confident memories. The same framework unifies several sub-quadratic recurrences: linear attention, GLA, and Mamba-2/SSD are exact filters under a latent-input design model, whereas DeltaNet and related Delta-rule models are covariance-reset reductions of the Bayesian Layer's design model. Restoring covariance propagation yields closed-form predictions for retrieval dynamics, which we verify empirically, and improves robustness beyond the training regime in controlled collision studies, learned associative recall, and the Zoology MQAR benchmark. Training from scratch on WikiText-103 under matched state budgets lowers perplexity on associative-recall hits. Distilling Bayesian Layers into a pretrained 340M Gated DeltaNet improves RULER long-context retrieval over a matched-compute control, at a 2.5--2.7\% held-out perplexity cost.

    我们提出 \emph{design-model framework}（设计模型框架）：一种根据关于记忆的明确假设推导高效循环序列映射的方法。设计模型通过精确的贝叶斯滤波将证据写入记忆；依赖查询的读出会产生预测分布，其均值即为层的输出。在我们的线性高斯实例化中，\emph{Bayesian Layer}（贝叶斯层）同时传播均值和协方差：协方差追踪所存储关联的不确定性，引导写入指向不确定方向，随着证据累积而减弱增益，并保留置信度高的记忆。同一框架统一了若干次二次复杂度的循环结构：在潜在输入设计模型下，线性注意力、GLA 和 Mamba-2/SSD 是精确滤波器；而 DeltaNet 及相关 Delta-rule 模型则是贝叶斯层设计模型中重置协方差的简化形式。恢复协方差传播后，可得到关于检索动态的闭式预测；我们通过实证验证了这些预测，并发现该方法在受控碰撞研究、学习到的联想回忆以及 Zoology MQAR 基准中提升了超出训练分布范围时的鲁棒性。在 WikiText-103 上从头训练并采用匹配的状态预算时，该方法降低了联想回忆命中样本的困惑度。将贝叶斯层蒸馏到预训练的 340M Gated DeltaNet 中后，相较于计算量匹配的对照模型，RULER 长上下文检索表现得到提升，代价是在留出集上的困惑度增加 2.5--2.7\%。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper benchmarks LLM pipelines for asynchronous planning and finds that recovering and editing task graphs is a key bottleneck, while targeted constraint updates improve execution-time adaptation. It advances planning and formalizer-based agent systems, with a substantive but secondary connection to compositional structure through task graphs.

    本文对用于异步规划的 LLM 流水线进行了基准测试，发现恢复和编辑任务图是关键瓶颈，而有针对性地更新约束能够改善执行期间的适应能力。该研究推动了规划和基于 formalizer 的智能体系统发展，并通过任务图与组合结构存在实质但次要的联系。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLMs can plan by generating schedules directly as a Planner, or by translating a task into a formal specification for a solver as a Formalizer. Most real-world tasks are asynchronous, with non-uniform durations, concurrency, and execution-time changes, yet existing benchmarks hardly cover them. We unify asynchronous planning under one formulation and release three benchmarks spanning task-graph scale, grounded state and resource constraints, and execution-time events. Surprisingly, PDDL2.1, the formalism built for temporal planning, is the weakest pipeline. On AsyncPlan-XXL it averages 30.8% plan accuracy, against 81.7% for the Planner and 94.0% for a CP-SAT Formalizer. The gap widens with scale, and at 100 actions the three pipelines reach 9.0%, 44.5%, and 82.5%, respectively. The formalism is not to blame. Compiled from the same model-extracted intermediate representation, PDDL2.1 and CP-SAT reach nearly identical accuracy (81.6% vs. 81.5%), and gold task graphs reach 100% for both. What remains is a bottleneck shared by every pipeline: recovering the task graph from language. Execution-time events further degrade every pipeline, yet updating only event-induced constraints reaches 81.6% versus 41.6% for full regeneration. Robust asynchronous planning thus hinges not on the expressiveness of the target formalism but on how reliably a model can write and edit it, and a well-chosen interface can let a weaker model match a stronger one.

    中文

    LLM 可以通过直接生成调度方案来规划，此时充当 Planner；也可以将任务转换为形式化规范交给求解器，此时充当 Formalizer。大多数现实任务都是异步的，具有非均匀时长、并发和执行期间发生变化等特点，但现有基准几乎没有覆盖这些情况。我们将异步规划统一到一个形式化框架中，并发布了三个基准，分别涵盖任务图规模、接地状态与资源约束，以及执行期间的事件。令人意外的是，为时间规划设计的形式化语言 PDDL2.1 所构成的流水线表现最弱。在 AsyncPlan-XXL 上，其平均规划准确率为 30.8%，而 Planner 为 81.7%，CP-SAT Formalizer 为 94.0%。随着规模增大，差距进一步扩大；在 100 个动作时，这三种流水线的准确率分别为 9.0%、44.5% 和 82.5%。问题并不在于形式化语言本身。使用从同一模型提取的中间表示进行编译时，PDDL2.1 和 CP-SAT 的准确率几乎相同（81.6% 对 81.5%）；使用真实任务图时，两者均达到 100%。所有流水线共有的剩余瓶颈是：从语言中恢复任务图。执行期间的事件会进一步降低所有流水线的表现，但只更新事件引发的约束可达到 81.6%，而完全重新生成仅为 41.6%。因此，稳健的异步规划关键不在于目标形式化语言的表达能力，而在于模型能否可靠地编写和编辑它；恰当选择接口能够使较弱模型达到与较强模型相当的表现。

    The paper studies how steering vectors in activation space induce broad misalignment and characterizes the effects of steering magnitude, subspace structure, and intervention layer. This gives substantial mechanistic insight into internal representations and behavior; safety evaluation and inference-time steering alone do not substantively address the other directions.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Activation steering (AS) has emerged as a popular inference-time technique for modulating the behavior of large language models (LLMs). AS modulates model behavior in a flexible and lightweight manner by injecting task-specific steering vectors (SVs) into intermediate activations. Meanwhile, recent work has identified emergent misalignment (EM) as an emerging safety concern, whereby finetuning on unsafe examples from a narrow task unexpectedly induces broadly unsafe behavior in unrelated domains. With the increasing popularity of AS, it is pressing yet under-explored to thoroughly investigate whether AS can induce EM. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive study of activation-steering-induced emergent misalignment. Specifically, (1) we identify a steering vector construction to confirm that SVs derived from a narrow task can indeed induce misalignment across broad unrelated domains. Qualitative measurement further reveals that AS-induced EM may pose more severe safety risks than finetuning-induced EM, i.e., AS elicits more actionable harmful responses with greater semantic coherence than those generated by finetuned models. (2) We characterize the properties of AS-induced EM by analyzing key steering-specific factors, including steering magnitude, the low-rank structure of the steering subspace, and the number of fine-tuning epochs used during steering-vector construction. (3) We evaluate the robustness and sensitivity of AS-induced EM across diverse model families, model scales, target tasks, and intervention layers. Our findings reveal activation steering as a significant yet underexamined source of emergent misalignment and provide an activation-space perspective on emergent misalignment and its safety risks.

    激活引导（AS）已成为一种流行的推理时技术，可用于调节大型语言模型（LLM）的行为。AS 通过向中间激活注入特定任务的引导向量（SV），以灵活且轻量的方式调节模型行为。与此同时，近期研究指出涌现失准（EM）是一项新兴安全隐患：在某个狭窄任务上使用不安全示例进行微调，可能意外地导致模型在无关领域也表现出广泛的不安全行为。随着 AS 日益普及，全面研究 AS 是否会诱发 EM 已迫在眉睫，但目前对此探索不足。本文全面研究了激活引导所诱发的涌现失准。具体而言，（1）我们确定了一种引导向量构建方法，并确认从狭窄任务中得到的 SV 确实能够诱发跨多个无关领域的失准。定性测量进一步表明，与微调诱发的 EM 相比，AS 诱发的 EM 可能带来更严重的安全风险；也就是说，AS 会引出更具可操作性、语义连贯性更强的有害响应，而微调模型生成的响应则较弱。（2）我们通过分析引导特有的关键因素来刻画 AS 诱发 EM 的属性，包括引导幅度、引导子空间的低秩结构，以及构建引导向量时使用的微调轮数。（3）我们评估了 AS 诱发 EM 在不同模型系列、模型规模、目标任务和干预层之间的鲁棒性与敏感性。我们的发现表明，激活引导是涌现失准的一个重要但尚未得到充分研究的来源，并从激活空间视角揭示了涌现失准及其安全风险。

However, higher-order cognitive functions necessary for AGI, such as long-term strategic planning, metacognition, and symbolic reasoning, heavily rely on hippocampal explicit memory and cannot arise solely from implicit statistical learning. Existing LLM-based reviewers largely organize the review process around predefined workflows, leaving limited scope for emerging evidence to reshape investigation. We propose ProReviewer, an evidence-driven review agent that formulates reviewing as a Markov Decision Process, with a structured review log forming the core of its state. At each step, the agent uses accumulated findings to decide what to inspect next and when to conclude. As new evidence emerges, it updates the log by revising claim statuses, resolving open questions, and recording new findings. Each point in the final review cites supporting log entries, making its judgments traceable to the recorded evidence.     Jose Pascual Gumbau Mezquita

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper establishes limits on certifying safety through self-modification, with formal computability and complexity results plus design implications for monitors and restricted rewrites. Its focus on self-modifying systems supports Systems 4; reasoning is incidental to the safety-verification problem, and it does not study model internals or compositional generalization.

    论文通过形式化的可计算性和复杂度结果，以及对监视器和受限重写的设计启示，确立了自我修改情况下安全认证的局限。其对自我修改系统的关注支持将系统列为核心主题；推理只是安全验证问题的附带内容，论文也未研究模型内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Existing impossibility results for AI verification concern a fixed system. Self-modifying systems (agents that rewrite their own code, recursive self-improvement loops) raise a different question: can a safety property that holds now be certified, in advance, to keep holding after the system rewrites itself? We model one step of self-modification as a total computable transformation of code, and preservation as 'safe now and safe after the step'. If the transformation depends only on behaviour, preservation is Rice's theorem one level up; if it reads the code, as self-modification does, preservation is no longer semantic, yet at least as hard as the halting problem, by the same s-m-n reduction carried out inside a class of behaviourally identical programs. One step is never harder than the property; persistence along the whole trajectory can be one arithmetical level higher. No tower of supervisors lowers the problem; every total supervisor errs on a set of systems it cannot locate. Every faithful scheme certifying on finite behavioural evidence admits, for properties not settled by any finite set of inputs, an evolution trace it certifies at every stage while the property is violated. Statically, we record the classical limits (Rice, Goedel, Trakhtenbrot) and add the resource face: over succinctly described finite environments, verifying a policy against an adversary is coNP-complete and synthesising one PSPACE-complete. These limits do not say self-modifying systems are unsafe; they locate where algorithmic guarantees break, at the expressivity a general system needs: Turing-completeness and unrestricted self-modification. What survives is exact: a monitor detects the first violation of a safety property, and no sound procedure certifies all safe systems; certification requires restricting rewrites by design; and a frozen reference keeps the question well posed.

    中文

    现有关于 AI 验证不可能性的结果针对的是固定系统。自我修改系统（会重写自身代码的智能体、递归自我改进循环）引出了另一个问题：一项当前成立的安全性质，能否预先获得认证，保证系统重写自身后它仍然成立？我们将一步自我修改建模为代码的全可计算变换，并将保持性定义为“当前安全且变换后仍安全”。如果该变换仅取决于行为，那么保持性相当于高一个层级的 Rice 定理；如果变换会读取代码（如自我修改所做的那样），保持性便不再是语义性质，但至少与停机问题同样困难，这一点可通过在一类行为等价程序内部执行相同的 s-m-n 归约来证明。单步问题的难度不会超过该性质本身；沿整个轨迹保持性质，则可能高出一个算术层级。增加多少层监督者也无法降低问题难度；每个全可计算监督者都会在一组它无法定位的系统上出错。对于任何无法由有限输入集确定的性质，任何基于有限行为证据进行认证的忠实方案，都存在一条演化轨迹：该方案在每个阶段都给予认证，但性质实际上被违反。静态方面，我们记录了经典限制（Rice、Goedel、Trakhtenbrot），并补充资源复杂度方面的限制：在简洁描述的有限环境中，针对对手验证策略是 coNP 完全的，而综合策略是 PSPACE 完全的。这些限制并不意味着自我修改系统是不安全的；它们指出算法保证在哪些地方失效，即一般系统所需的表达能力处：图灵完备性和不受限制的自我修改。仍然可行的事项则是明确的：监视器能够检测安全性质首次被违反的时刻，且不存在能够认证所有安全系统的可靠程序；认证需要通过设计限制重写操作；而冻结的参照版本可以使问题定义明确。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper distills chain-of-thought behavior into a compact model and studies its mathematical accuracy and response-length effects, making reasoning training a substantial contribution.     论文将思维链行为蒸馏到紧凑模型中，并研究其数学准确率及回答长度的影响，因此推理训练是其重要贡献。竞赛数据集和双智能体设置与组合性及系统设计仅有附带关系；摘要没有对内部表征作出机制性说明。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    This paper investigates knowledge distillation from a large reasoning model (DeepSeek-R1) to a compact student model (Qwen2.5-7B). Using historical problems from the John O'Bryan Mathematics Competition at Northern Kentucky University (2011-2025), we build a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) training corpus through a dual-agent framework. The dataset is used to fine-tune the student model with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on Apple Silicon hardware using the MLX framework. The base Qwen2.5-7B model achieves 64.67% accuracy on competition problems, while the DeepSeek-R1 teacher achieves 91.40%. An initial 1,000-iteration training run revealed severe overfitting, with validation loss reaching a minimum at iteration 200 before rising steadily. Based on this finding, we ran five independent training runs each limited to 200 iterations with varied random seeds to assess result stability. Across these five runs, the fine-tuned student model achieves a mean accuracy of 69.43% (std dev 0.17%) on the competition dataset, a 4.76 percentage-point improvement over the base model, and generalizes to 73.1% (std dev 0.18%) on the MATH-500 benchmark. We further study how response length affects answer quality across six reasoning levels (R1-R6): accuracy declines consistently from 69.43% at R1 (mean 220 words) to 41.9% at R6 (mean 31.2 words), with the two-person speed section most sensitive to token reduction. These results demonstrate that CoT distillation improves compact student models and that response length is a critical factor in mathematical reasoning quality.

    中文

    本文研究如何将大型推理模型（DeepSeek-R1）的知识蒸馏到紧凑学生模型（Qwen2.5-7B）中。我们使用 Northern Kentucky University 举办的 John O'Bryan 数学竞赛（2011—2025 年）历年题目，通过双智能体框架构建思维链（CoT）训练语料。我们使用该数据集，通过低秩适配（LoRA），在 Apple Silicon 硬件上利用 MLX 框架对学生模型进行微调。基础版 Qwen2.5-7B 模型在竞赛题目上的准确率为 64.67%，而 DeepSeek-R1 教师模型的准确率为 91.40%。一次初始的 1,000 轮训练显示出严重过拟合：验证损失在第 200 轮达到最低点，之后持续上升。基于这一发现，我们进行了五次独立训练，每次训练均限制在 200 轮，并使用不同随机种子来评估结果稳定性。在这五次训练中，微调后的学生模型在竞赛数据集上的平均准确率为 69.43%（标准差 0.17%），比基础模型提高 4.76 个百分点；在 MATH-500 基准上的准确率为 73.1%（标准差 0.18%），显示出良好的泛化能力。我们还研究了六个推理等级（R1-R6）下回答长度对答案质量的影响：准确率从 R1 的 69.43%（平均 220 词）持续下降至 R6 的 41.9%（平均 31.2 词）；双人速度赛环节对 token 减少最为敏感。这些结果表明，CoT 蒸馏能够提升紧凑学生模型的表现，而回答长度是影响数学推理质量的关键因素。

    ENGLISH

    Autonomous robots often need to move their camera before they can act: to inspect an object, reveal an occluded region, or obtain a view that responds to a user's intent. While vision-language navigation translates instructions to base motion and vision-language-action policies map instructions to manipulation actions, vision-language conditioned camera motion remains comparatively underexplored as a first-class action. We formulate vision-language conditioned camera motion generation: given a current RGB observation and a free-form natural-language intent, predict a relative target camera pose for the next observation. The challenge is that useful viewpoint changes depend on latent perceptual intent, ranging from coarse spatial moves to fine-grained inspection or occlusion revealing. To model this structure, we mine multi-intent camera-motion supervision from egocentric video via hindsight labeling, pairing each relative SE(3) target pose with plausible intents and observation-gain descriptions inferred from the reached view. We propose LIME, a vision-language camera-motion generator that combines an autoregressive observation-gain output with a continuous flow-matching pose head. This design lets the model jointly predict what the next view should reveal while representing multi-hypothesis target views. Across viewpoint-prediction experiments and downstream robotic tasks, we show that LIME learns intent-conditioned camera motion from passive egocentric video, turning ordinary human recordings into supervision for a reusable active-perception primitive that supports general-purpose viewpoint selection, manipulation, embodied question answering, and mid-distance navigation.

    Kazuo Ishii, Bishnu Prasad Gautam, Jieling Wu, Saher Javaid

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops an operator framework for representation observability, quotient geometry, and limits on output-based interpretability, with empirical validation. This substantially advances representation geometry and interpretability, but does not address compositionality, reasoning, or system organization.

    本文提出了一种算子框架，用于研究表征可观测性、商几何以及基于输出的可解释性的局限，并进行了实证验证。这显著推进了表征几何和可解释性研究，但未涉及组合性、推理或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We characterize observability in representation learning through Platonic Projection Structures (PPS), an operator-theoretic framework for analyzing representation accessibility under partial observation. Rather than treating observable outputs as direct reflections of latent representations, PPS models observation through a self-adjoint positive semidefinite operator acting on a latent representation space. A system is represented as a triple $(H, \Pi, O)$, where $H$ is a latent representation space, $\Pi \succeq 0$ is an observation operator, and $O(v)=\langle v,\Pi v\rangle$ defines an induced scalar observable. Observability is characterized by the quotient geometry $H/\ker(\Pi)$, representing equivalence classes of latent states indistinguishable under observation. We show that quantum measurement and representation inference under linear observation models share this operator-theoretic structure while differing in the algebraic properties of their observation operators; the correspondence is structural rather than physical. Representation transfer and knowledge distillation can likewise be interpreted as approximate preservation of observable geometry through $\Phi \Pi_T \approx \Pi_S \Phi$. PPS also reveals a structural limitation of output-based interpretability: latent components in $\ker(\Pi)$ are inaccessible from induced observables, imposing intrinsic constraints on attribution and explanation methods. Controlled empirical validations demonstrate kernel-invariant observability, projection-induced attribution gaps, and rank-controlled observable geometry in latent representation spaces. PPS thus provides an explicit characterization of observability through operator-induced quotient geometry and a unified perspective on representation accessibility, interpretability, and projection-mediated inference.

    中文

    我们通过柏拉图投影结构（PPS）刻画表征学习中的可观测性。PPS 是一种算子理论框架，用于分析部分观测条件下表征的可访问性。PPS 不将可观测输出视为潜在表征的直接反映，而是通过作用于潜在表征空间的自伴正半定算子对观测进行建模。一个系统表示为三元组 $(H, \Pi, O)$，其中 $H$ 是潜在表征空间，$\Pi \succeq 0$ 是观测算子，而 $O(v)=\langle v,\Pi v\rangle$ 定义一个诱导标量可观测量。可观测性通过商几何 $H/\ker(\Pi)$ 来刻画，它表示在观测下无法区分的潜在状态等价类。我们表明，量子测量与线性观测模型下的表征推断具有相同的算子理论结构，但其观测算子的代数性质不同；这种对应关系是结构性的，而非物理性的。表征迁移和知识蒸馏同样可以解释为通过 $\Phi \Pi_T \approx \Pi_S \Phi$ 近似保持可观测几何。PPS 还揭示了基于输出的可解释性的一项结构性局限：$\ker(\Pi)$ 中的潜在分量无法从诱导可观测量中访问，这对归因和解释方法施加了内在约束。受控实证验证展示了核不变可观测性、投影诱导的归因差距，以及潜在表征空间中由秩控制的可观测几何。因此，PPS 通过算子诱导的商几何明确刻画了可观测性，并为表征可访问性、可解释性和投影中介推断提供了统一视角。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as data-science agents, combining abstract reasoning with advanced tool use. Yet the relevant benchmark landscape largely divides into symbolic causal reasoning benchmarks without realistic data analysis or data analysis benchmarks without causal data-generating structure or a range of causal data science tasks. Existing causal evaluation datasets are often restricted to curated examples from existing sources, with diversity coming from limited templatized variations rather than from systematic generation of novel synthetic causal structures. We introduce CausalDS, a benchmark for evaluating causal reasoning in agentic data-science workflows. Each benchmark instance is a scene consisting of a sampled structural causal model (SCM) with generated observational data and an accompanying synthetic natural-language story grounded in a real domain. We ground the composition of the benchmark components in empirical distributions obtained from real-world datasets, thus retaining empirical structure while reducing the memorization risk through completely synthetic generation. From each scene, we then derive tasks spanning all three of Pearl's rungs. Most tasks include a data science coding component, where the model typically needs to use several tools to arrive at the final answer due to imperfect observations. Abstention is tested directly: for targets the graph does not identify, the graded answer is to abstain. The benchmark thus jointly evaluates symbolic causal reasoning, data science, uncertainty quantification, abstention, and tool use/coding. Because the generator is fully synthetic, the exam is not a fixed dataset: composition, difficulty, and size are parameters, and fresh exams can be drawn at will.

    Correlation-Aware Contextual Bandits with Surrogate Rewards for LLM Routing

    面向 LLM 路由、具备相关性感知能力的上下文老虎机与替代奖励

    Ajay Narayanan Sridhar, Ronak Singh, Mehrdad Mahdavi, Vijaykrishnan Narayanan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops contextual bandit algorithms for routing, with theoretical regret guarantees under correlated arms and potentially misspecified surrogate rewards. This advances decision-making for model routing, while its LLM application alone provides no evidence of internal mechanisms, compositionality, or general reasoning capability.

    论文开发了用于路由的上下文老虎机算法，并针对相关臂和可能存在模型设定错误的替代奖励，给出了理论遗憾保证。这推进了模型路由的决策方法；仅有 LLM 应用并不能证明其涉及内部机制、组合性或通用推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We study contextual bandit problems with correlated arms and access to surrogate reward signals produced by a machine learning model, motivated by applications such as large language model (LLM) routing. Unlike classical contextual bandits that rely solely on bandit feedback and assume conditional independence across arms, our setting allows context-dependent inter-arm correlations and auxiliary reward information that may be noisy or misspecified. We propose algorithms that leverage such surrogate rewards through two complementary designs. A coupled reward-mixing approach pools true and surrogate rewards to accelerate learning when surrogate signals are reliable, while a decoupled prediction-mixing approach maintains separate estimators for bandit feedback and surrogate rewards and adaptively combines their predictions. This decoupling yields robustness to surrogate misspecification, recovering regret guarantees comparable to reward-only bandit methods in the worst case, while achieving improved regret when surrogate predictions are sufficiently informative. We provide theoretical regret analyses for both approaches and evaluate them on LLM routing benchmarks under varying accuracy versus cost trade-offs. The results demonstrate improved sample efficiency and consistently better accuracy-cost trade-offs compared to standard contextual bandit baselines and strong static routing methods.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether adaptive depth improves latent world-model rollouts and whether learned routers can identify steps that need more compute, finding no trained router beats fixed-depth planning. Multi-step composition is part of the analysis, but it does not study compositional generalization or model reasoning directly.

    本文检验自适应深度能否改善潜在世界模型的滚动预测，以及学习得到的路由器能否识别需要更多计算的步骤；结果发现，训练出的路由器没有一个优于固定深度规划。多步组合是分析的一部分，但本文并未直接研究组合泛化或模型推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Adaptive-compute world models run fewer predictor blocks on some rollout steps than on others. This rests on two assumptions: that a deeper predictor gives a more accurate rollout, and that the steps which need depth can be identified before the predictor runs. We test both on nine DeepMind Control tasks with a twelve-block early-exit latent predictor, eight seeds per task. The first assumption fails on three tasks, where a shallower exit rolls out more accurately than the full stack on every seed, and composing predictions over ten steps moves the depth-error relation away from its one-step shape in both directions. In hindsight, choosing depth per step helps: a greedy oracle that sees the true next latent has 10-37% lower rollout error than the best mixture of fixed depths at equal average compute, and 8-28% lower than the best step-index schedule, on all nine tasks. No router we trained captures this. The difficulty router these models carry stays within 5% of fixed-depth mixtures; a router trained to predict each exit's error beats them by up to 12% but no more than a fixed schedule does; and in closed-loop planning at equal compute the routed planner matches a fixed middle depth. On cheetah, where depth 2 rolls out more accurately than the full stack (an inversion), supervising the early exits only at the first rollout step removes the inversion, while a control with the same loss weight that supervises them at one random step keeps most of it (rho 0.91 vs 0.85 standard and 1.14 first-step-only, three seeds): the inversion depends on supervising exits from composed latents. These results change with the encoder, backbone, horizon and training data. The fixed-depth campaign was pre-registered; the routing analyses, planner runs, ablation control and one-step decomposition are exploratory.

    自适应计算世界模型在某些滚动预测步骤中运行的预测器模块少于其他步骤。这依赖于两个假设：更深的预测器能给出更准确的滚动预测；需要深度的步骤可以在预测器运行前识别出来。我们在九项 DeepMind Control 任务上检验这两个假设，使用一个含十二个模块的早退潜在预测器，每项任务运行八个随机种子。第一个假设在三项任务上不成立：在每个随机种子上，较浅的退出层滚动预测都比完整模块堆栈更准确；而将预测组合十个步骤后，深度与误差的关系会朝两个方向偏离其单步形态。事后看来，逐步选择深度确有帮助：在平均计算量相同的情况下，一个能看到真实下一时刻潜在状态的贪心预言机，在全部九项任务上的滚动预测误差都比最佳固定深度混合方案低 10–37%，比最佳步数索引调度方案低 8–28%。我们训练的路由器无一能达到这一点。这些模型自带的难度路由器与固定深度混合方案的差距在 5% 以内；经过训练以预测各退出层误差的路由器，最多能比它们好 12%，但表现并不优于固定调度方案；在计算量相同的闭环规划中，路由规划器则与固定中间深度相当。在 cheetah 任务上，深度 2 的滚动预测比完整模块堆栈更准确（即出现反转）；只在首次滚动预测步骤监督早退层会消除这一反转，而采用相同损失权重、在一个随机步骤监督它们的对照仍保留了大部分反转（rho 分别为 0.91、标准设置下的 0.85，以及仅首步监督下的 1.14，均为三个随机种子）：这种反转取决于是否从组合后的潜在状态监督退出层。这些结果会随编码器、骨干网络、预测跨度和训练数据而变化。固定深度实验预先注册；路由分析、规划器运行、消融对照和单步分解均为探索性研究。

    Commit Locally, Exit Globally: Coordinating Adaptive Sampling and Early Exit in Diffusion Language Models

    局部提交，全局退出：协调扩散语言模型中的自适应采样与早退

    Chia-Ming Lee, Shao-Kai Liu, Ming-Ching Chang, Xin Li, Yu-Lun Liu, Chih-Chung Hsu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    C$^4$ combines adaptive token commitment with confidence-based early exit to reduce diffusion language model decoding steps while keeping task performance close to full decoding. It substantively improves computation allocation, especially across reasoning and code tasks, but the abstract does not investigate how reasoning mechanisms form or work.

    C$^4$将自适应词元提交与基于置信度的早退结合起来，在保持任务表现接近完整解码的同时，减少扩散语言模型的解码步骤。这实质性地改进了计算分配，尤其适用于推理和代码任务，但摘要并未探究推理机制如何形成或运作。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion language models predict tokens in parallel but still require many iterative forward passes. Adaptive sampling accelerates local token commitment, while recent global stopping methods seek to end generation early. Our trajectory analysis shows that short answers can stabilize early in decoding, whereas reasoning outputs often require more steps to settle. A fixed progress threshold therefore struggles to avoid both redundant computation on short-answer tasks and premature termination on reasoning tasks. We introduce C$^4$, a training-free framework that combines local decoding acceleration with adaptive global early exit. Confidence-Verified Early Exit (CVEE) determines when to end generation, skipping the remaining steps once its stopping criterion is met. It combines confidence and temporal agreement to adapt stopping to the observed revision history. Commit-Core-Then-Confirm (CCTC) accelerates token commitment while generation continues, reducing the decoding steps needed to complete each block. It extends confidence-threshold parallel decoding with a boundary-anchored core and one-step confirmation of deferred predictions, constraining additional commitments to mitigate premature freezing under unresolved context. With CVEE calibrated once on LLaDA, the same numerical settings transfer across all 12 zero-shot tasks and to Dream without recalibration. Under this configuration, C$^4$ reduces decoding steps by 64-95% and achieves measured decoding-loop speedups of 2.6x-18.6x, with task performance close to full decoding. Component analyses show complementary contributions: early exit supplies most savings on short-answer tasks, while local acceleration contributes more on reasoning and code generation.

    中文

    扩散语言模型并行预测词元，但仍需要许多次迭代前向传播。自适应采样可加快局部词元提交，而近期的全局停止方法则力求提前结束生成。我们的轨迹分析表明，短答案可能在解码早期就趋于稳定，而推理输出通常需要更多步骤才能稳定下来。因此，固定进度阈值难以同时避免短答案任务上的冗余计算和推理任务上的过早终止。我们提出 C$^4$，这是一个无需训练的框架，将局部解码加速与自适应全局早退结合起来。置信度验证早退（CVEE）决定何时结束生成，一旦满足停止准则，就跳过剩余步骤。它结合置信度与时间一致性，根据观察到的修订历史自适应地决定停止时机。先提交核心、再确认（CCTC）会在生成继续进行的同时加快词元提交，减少完成每个区块所需的解码步骤。它在基于置信度阈值的并行解码基础上，加入边界锚定核心以及对延后预测的一步确认，并限制额外提交，以缓解上下文尚未明确时过早冻结的问题。CVEE 只需在 LLaDA 上校准一次，同一组数值设置便可迁移到全部 12 项零样本任务以及 Dream，无需重新校准。在此配置下，C$^4$将解码步骤减少 64–95%，实测解码循环加速比达到 2.6x–18.6x，且任务表现接近完整解码。组件分析显示，两者的贡献互为补充：早退在短答案任务中贡献了大部分节省，而局部加速对推理和代码生成的贡献更大。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces persistent, task-structured attention biases that improve Boolean extrapolation and low-data arithmetic, advancing systematic generalization and reasoning. Although it changes Transformer architecture, the abstract does not study internal representations or computational organization, so those connections remain incidental.

    本文提出持久、基于任务结构的注意力偏置，改善了布尔外推和低数据量算术表现，推动了系统性泛化与推理的发展。尽管它改变了 Transformer 架构，但摘要并未研究内部表征或计算组织，因此与这些方面的联系仅属附带。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Transformers do not merely lack data on some Boolean extrapolation tasks; they generalize in a systematically wrong way. Recent work on generalization on the unseen has shown that, despite fitting the observed domain, Transformers often extrapolate according to a simpler minimum-degree interpolator rather than the true target function. These Boolean tasks are not practical applications, but controlled stress tests for understanding Transformer inductive bias. We ask whether this failure mode can be corrected by injecting explicit structural priors into attention. Existing structured-initialization methods alter Transformer inductive bias indirectly, by choosing query and key projections whose similarity scores approximate a desired attention pattern. However, we find that when applied to Boolean extrapolation, these QK-based priors can be rapidly overwritten during training and fail to change the learned extrapolation rule. We propose a simpler alternative: initialize the additive attention mask directly. Unlike standard hard masks used for causality or locality attention, our mask is a finite, learnable attention-logit bias initialized from task-level interaction structure. This separates the structural prior from content-dependent attention scores, allowing it to persist throughout optimization. On Boolean reasoning tasks, mask-based initialization achieves near-perfect extrapolation where vanilla and QK-initialized Transformers remain trapped by the default inductive bias. The same mechanism also improves low-data arithmetic performance and remains competitive on vision and language benchmarks. These results show that attention masks can serve not only as architectural constraints, but as a simple substrate for encoding persistent inductive bias in Transformers.

    中文

    Transformer 并非只是在某些布尔外推任务上缺少数据；它们的泛化方式存在系统性错误。近期关于未见数据泛化的研究表明，尽管 Transformer 能拟合观测到的领域，但它们常常依据一个更简单的最低次数插值器进行外推，而不是依据真实的目标函数。这些布尔任务并非实际应用，而是用于理解 Transformer 归纳偏置的受控压力测试。我们探究能否通过向注意力注入显式结构先验来纠正这种失败模式。现有的结构化初始化方法通过选择查询和键投影，使其相似度分数近似所需的注意力模式，从而间接改变 Transformer 的归纳偏置。然而，我们发现，将这些基于 QK 的先验用于布尔外推时，它们可能在训练过程中迅速被覆盖，无法改变学到的外推规则。我们提出一种更简单的替代方案：直接初始化加性注意力掩码。与用于因果注意力或局部注意力的标准硬掩码不同，我们的掩码是一种有限值、可学习的注意力 logits 偏置，其初始化依据任务层面的交互结构。这将结构先验与依赖内容的注意力分数分离开来，使先验能够在整个优化过程中持续保留。在布尔推理任务上，基于掩码的初始化实现了近乎完美的外推，而普通 Transformer 和采用 QK 初始化的 Transformer 仍受困于默认归纳偏置。同一机制还能提升低数据量算术任务的表现，并在视觉和语言基准上保持竞争力。这些结果表明，注意力掩码不仅能用作架构约束，也能作为一种简单载体，为 Transformer 编码持久的归纳偏置。

    Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has become a standard approach for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models, but its training is costly because each step requires generating many long reasoning responses. Recent methods use speculative decoding to accelerate the rollouts, where a draft model proposes tokens that the target model verifies. However, we find that the draft model repeatedly misses the same tokens within a response and across responses in the same GRPO group, and the verification feedback on these misses is not used to update the draft during the rollout. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce SPARK, a lightweight self-adaptive mechanism designed to enhance draft models used in speculative GRPO training. SPARK leverages target verification feedback to refine draft predictions during generation while preserving their existing training procedures.     特权指导发生错配时：面向多轮智能体的状态匹配路由与上下文化自蒸馏

    Junzhuo Liu, Weiwei Li, Jun Ling, Peng Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SMRC-SD routes teacher guidance according to the agent’s reached state and contextualizes compatible references, improving multi-turn interaction and transfer across agent tasks. This advances agent training and task execution, with a limited connection to compositionality through subgoal ordering and reference continuations; it does not study internal mechanisms or general reasoning processes directly.

    SMRC-SD 根据智能体到达的状态来路由教师指导，并将兼容的参考信息上下文化，从而改善多轮交互以及跨智能体任务的迁移。这推动了智能体训练与任务执行的发展，并通过子目标排序和参考后续步骤与组合性有有限关联；但它并未直接研究内部机制或一般推理过程。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-turn agents trained with sparse outcome rewards receive limited supervision for intermediate decisions. Privileged on-policy self-distillation provides denser guidance by having a synchronized teacher re-score student responses with training-only references. However, the student may take different actions or complete subgoals in another order, reaching states for which the reference provides no applicable continuation. The resulting state--reference mismatch can lead the reference-conditioned teacher to penalize valid actions. We introduce State-Matched Routing and Contextualized Self-Distillation (SMRC-SD), which uses the student's reached state to decide when and how a reference should guide the student. At each turn, SMRC-SD checks state compatibility with the reference, distills only on matched turns, and contextualizes the reference by augmenting it with a reached-state summary and a compatible continuation. At inference, the policy requires neither references nor state matching. Experiments spanning three model sizes show gains over unconditional full-path self-distillation in embodied interaction (ALFWorld), web navigation (WebShop), and tool use (FTRL). FTRL-trained policies also transfer to BFCL and ToolHop without additional training. Code is available at https://github.com/liujunzhuo/SMRC-SD.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AVA-Encoder builds structured Film Knowledge Graphs and uses reconstruction-driven loops to refine representations and support coordinated video editing, offering strong contributions to compositional structure and agent-system design. Planning is a motivating capability, but the abstract does not establish a direct advance in reasoning mechanisms.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agentic video creation systems remain far from cinematic-grade quality: their underlying models struggle to plan how story, characters, visuals, and sound fit together, and high-quality creation trajectories to learn such planning abilities are scarce. Finished human films embody this knowledge, but in a tightly coupled audiovisual form that agents cannot directly read or manipulate. We propose the Agentic Video Auto-Encoder (AVA-Encoder), which works backward from finished films, turning them into agent-native representations with reconstruction itself as supervision. It encodes a film into a Film Knowledge Graph (Film KG) of structured-text nodes, typed dependency edges, and linked multimodal assets, then regenerates the film from this graph with a fixed decoder. Reconstruction residuals are distilled into textual gradients that drive dual-loop self-evolution: an outer loop learns a shared encoding policy across videos, and an inner loop refines each video's Film KG at test time. AVA-Encoder improves reconstruction fidelity by 20.7 percentage points over the strongest baseline; its learned policy outperforms a finely human-tuned policy with over 70 percent fewer system-prompt tokens; and Film KGs support coordinated editing and improve all tested downstream creation systems. We release the framework, a reconstruction benchmark, and a Film KG dataset.

    智能体式视频创作系统距离电影级质量仍相去甚远：其底层模型难以规划故事、角色、视觉画面和声音如何相互配合，而且缺少可用于学习此类规划能力的高质量创作轨迹。已完成的人类电影蕴含了这些知识，但它们以紧密耦合的视听形式呈现，智能体无法直接读取或操作。我们提出智能体视频自编码器（AVA-Encoder），从已完成的电影反向处理，将其转化为智能体原生表征，并以重建本身作为监督信号。该方法将电影编码为电影知识图谱（Film KG），其中包含结构化文本节点、带类型的依赖边以及关联的多模态资源，然后使用固定解码器从该图谱重新生成电影。重建残差会被蒸馏为文本梯度，驱动双循环自演化：外循环学习跨视频共享的编码策略，内循环则在测试时优化每部视频的 Film KG。与最强基线相比，AVA-Encoder 将重建保真度提高了 20.7 个百分点；其学习到的策略优于经过精细人工调优的策略，同时系统提示词元减少了 70% 以上；Film KG 还支持协同编辑，并改善了所有受测下游创作系统。我们发布了该框架、一个重建基准和一个 Film KG 数据集。

    Dongfang Li, Zixuan Liu, Junmai Wang, Jiahe Huang, Fuhao Li, Lin Zhang, Bonian Jia, Baotian Hu and Min Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is a segment-level consolidation and indexed retrieval framework that reduces the cost of long-term memory for LLM agents while preserving evidence. This substantially advances agent memory systems; reasoning is incidental to retrieval, and the abstract offers no mechanistic interpretability or compositional generalization contribution.

    本文的主要贡献是一种片段级整合与索引检索框架，它在保留证据的同时降低了 LLM 智能体长期记忆的成本。这显著推动了智能体记忆系统的发展；推理只是检索的附带环节，摘要也没有涉及机制可解释性或组合泛化方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon LLM agents must preserve information from past interactions to support future tasks. Existing memory systems typically rely on eager consolidation, invoking LLMs after each interaction to extract, summarize, or update memories. This design makes memory construction increasingly costly as conversations grow. Coarse summarization can reduce construction cost but risks discarding fine-grained contextual evidence, whereas larger retrieval contexts or multi-hop LLM reasoning shift the overhead to query time. We present LycheeMemory V2, an efficient long-term memory framework that replaces turn-level consolidation with semantic segment-level consolidation. Instead of consolidating every interaction, LycheeMemory batches multiple exchanges into segments and encodes each finalized segment into context-independent typed memory records. Segment-level batching lowers LLM encoding frequency, while semantic boundary detection helps preserve coherent event-level and temporal evidence compared with fixed-window batching. The resulting records are organized with lightweight structured indexes for query-planned evidence retrieval. Experiments using GPT-4.1-Mini show that LycheeMemory achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching 89.22% on LoCoMo and 92.20% on LongMemEval-S. Compared with A-Mem, it reduces construction tokens by 86.0% on LoCoMo and 75.9% on LongMemEval-S without increasing query-time token usage. More broadly, our results suggest that the accuracy--cost trade-off of long-term agent memory depends not only on what information is retained, but also on the granularity at which it is consolidated.

    中文

    长时程 LLM 智能体必须保留过去交互中的信息，以支持未来任务。现有记忆系统通常依赖即时整合：每次交互后都调用 LLM 来提取、概括或更新记忆。随着对话增长，这种设计会使记忆构建成本不断上升。粗粒度摘要虽能降低构建成本，却可能丢弃细粒度的上下文证据；而扩大检索上下文或采用多跳 LLM 推理，则会将开销转移到查询阶段。我们提出 LycheeMemory V2，这是一种高效的长期记忆框架，以语义片段级整合取代轮次级整合。LycheeMemory 不再整合每次交互，而是将多轮交流批量组成片段，并把每个定稿片段编码为与上下文无关的类型化记忆记录。片段级批处理降低了 LLM 编码频率；与固定窗口批处理相比，语义边界检测有助于保留连贯的事件级和时间证据。随后，系统使用轻量级结构化索引来组织这些记录，以便按查询计划检索证据。使用 GPT-4.1-Mini 的实验表明，LycheeMemory 达到最先进水平，在 LoCoMo 上取得 89.22%，在 LongMemEval-S 上取得 92.20%。与 A-Mem 相比，它在 LoCoMo 上将构建词元数减少 86.0%，在 LongMemEval-S 上减少 75.9%，且未增加查询阶段的词元用量。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，长期智能体记忆的准确率与成本权衡不仅取决于保留哪些信息，也取决于整合信息时采用的粒度。

    Yu He, Weikai Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SkillCommit builds reusable skills by abstracting experiences that share validated behavioral mechanisms, a substantial contribution to compositional reuse and agent skill organization. Its mechanism checks validate transfer but do not explain model-internal mechanisms, and the abstract does not focus on reasoning capability.

    SkillCommit 通过抽象具有共同且经过验证的行为机制的经验来构建可复用技能，为组合式复用和智能体技能组织作出了重要贡献。其机制检查用于验证迁移，并不解释模型内部机制；摘要也未聚焦于推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents can continually improve without parameter updates by converting historical experience into reusable procedural knowledge. However, existing methods often consolidate experience based on semantic similarity or LLM judgments, which may merge superficially related but behaviorally incompatible strategies and thereby degrade performance. To address the issue, we propose SkillCommit, an online skill evolution framework that continuously transforms experience into a hierarchical library of reusable skills. Rather than generalizing from individual experiences immediately, SkillCommit first preserves each experience as an instance-specific patch, retaining its locally validated behavior. As patches accumulate, SkillCommit abstracts those sharing a common behavioral mechanism into higher-level skills. Specifically, for each incoming skill, embedding-based retrieval first identifies candidate related skills. Cross-instance replay and an LLM-based mechanism check determine whether these skills transfer across cases and share a common underlying mechanism. Candidates that pass both checks are abstracted into a higher-level skill and committed only if it preserves the validated behavior of all constituent skills. Experiments on RuleArena, OpenExempt and KOR-Bench demonstrate that SkillCommit consistently improves agent performance across diverse domains. Moreover, the learned skills transfer across model scales and families, enabling cross-model experience transfer.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体可以将历史经验转化为可复用的程序性知识，从而在不更新参数的情况下持续改进。然而，现有方法往往基于语义相似性或 LLM 判断来整合经验，这可能会合并表面相关、但行为上不兼容的策略，进而降低表现。为解决这一问题，我们提出 SkillCommit，这是一种在线技能演进框架，可持续地将经验转化为分层的可复用技能库。SkillCommit 不会立即从单个经验中进行泛化，而是首先将每段经验保留为针对特定实例的补丁，以保留经过局部验证的行为。随着补丁不断积累，SkillCommit 会将共享某种行为机制的补丁抽象为更高层技能。具体而言，对于每个新技能，系统首先通过基于嵌入的检索找出相关候选技能。跨实例重放与基于 LLM 的机制检查会判断这些技能能否迁移到不同案例，以及是否共享某种底层机制。只有同时通过这两项检查的候选技能才会被抽象成更高层技能，而且只有在保留所有组成技能已验证行为的情况下才会提交。RuleArena、OpenExempt 和 KOR-Bench 上的实验表明，SkillCommit 能在不同领域持续提升智能体表现。此外，学到的技能还能跨模型规模和模型系列迁移，从而实现跨模型经验迁移。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies transferring external memory across model backbones and shows that a target-aligned reader is key to making the frozen knowledge useful, a substantial contribution to model memory systems.
