    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Methods for improving knowledge use in large language models typically fall into two regimes. Non-parametric retrieval offers flexible access to external knowledge, but adds retrieval latency, context overhead, and only shallow integration with the backbone. Parametric adaptation is efficient at inference time, but entangles knowledge with model weights and can be hard to update, audit, or transfer. Engram-style hashed memory occupies a middle regime: it stores learned information in an external, addressable table, yet consumes that table through a small learned reader. This raises a basic question: when such a memory is moved across backbones, what matters more, the frozen memory itself or the target-side reader? We study this question through cross-model frozen-memory extraction, in which a memory trained on a source model is frozen and attached to a different target model, with only a lightweight reader trained. Ablations show that learned memory content and correct addressing both matter, but the transferred table becomes useful only through a reader aligned to the target model. In downstream question answering tasks, a dual-layer, four-branch reader nearly closes the gap between same-model and cross-model reuse, achieving an average score of 38.8 under our controlled evaluation protocol. Moreover, when the provider reader is directly compatible with the target interface, the frozen artifact can provide substantial utility without target-side training, while optional reader adaptation yields further improvement. These results suggest that Engram can serve as a reusable external knowledge artifact, provided that the target has access to a compatible reader interface; target-side adaptation can further improve alignment when direct reader reuse is insufficient.

    中文

    提升大型语言模型知识使用能力的方法通常分为两类。非参数检索可灵活访问外部知识，但会增加检索延迟和上下文开销，并且与骨干网络的整合较浅。参数适配在推理时效率较高，但会使知识与模型权重纠缠，难以更新、审计或迁移。Engram 式哈希记忆处于中间地带：它将学到的信息存储在外部可寻址表中，但通过一个小型学习型读取器来读取该表。这引出了一个基本问题：将这类记忆迁移到不同骨干网络时，冻结的记忆本身与目标侧读取器，哪一个更重要？我们通过跨模型冻结记忆提取来研究这一问题：先冻结在源模型上训练的记忆并将其接入另一个目标模型，然后仅训练一个轻量级读取器。消融实验表明，学到的记忆内容和正确寻址都很重要，但迁移后的表只有通过与目标模型对齐的读取器才能发挥作用。在下游问答任务中，一个双层、四分支读取器几乎弥合了同模型复用与跨模型复用之间的差距；在我们的受控评估方案下，其平均分达到 38.8。此外，如果提供方读取器与目标接口直接兼容，冻结的产物无需目标侧训练便能提供显著效用；可选的读取器适配还能进一步提升效果。这些结果表明，只要目标模型能够访问兼容的读取器接口，Engram 就可以作为可复用的外部知识产物；当直接复用读取器不足以实现对齐时，目标侧适配还能进一步改善对齐。

    Xiwei Dai, Zijie Meng, Zhiting Fan, Yixuan Tang, Guanyu Jiang, Ziru Niu, Zuozhu Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CDEG uses counterfactual interventions to identify decision-critical evidence from diagnostic trajectories, then stores and retrieves diagnosis–evidence–action relations to guide long-horizon agents. This substantially advances agent memory and diagnostic reasoning, while its evidence-graph structure offers more limited insight into compositional generalization and internal model mechanisms.

    CDEG 通过反事实干预从诊断轨迹中识别决策关键证据，继而存储并检索诊断—证据—行动关系，以引导长时程智能体。这显著推动了智能体记忆和诊断推理的发展；与此同时，其证据图结构对组合泛化和模型内部机制的揭示较为有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Unlike static medical question answering, long-horizon diagnosis captures the sequential nature of clinical practice: evidence is progressively acquired, integrated, and evaluated over multiple rounds of interaction before reaching a final diagnosis. However, existing doctor agents often fail when critical evidence is either not acquired or not adequately incorporated into diagnostic reasoning. Recent agentic approaches attempt to address these failures by reusing historical trajectories or distilled memories. But their diagnostic gains remain constrained because such experience may contain noisy or incidental information and is typically reused without validating which evidence actually drives diagnostic decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce CDEG, a graph-based framework that learns reusable decision-critical evidence from historical diagnostic trajectories. CDEG contrasts successful and failed trajectories from the same case to identify candidate evidence, validates their diagnostic impact through controlled counterfactual interventions, and organizes the resulting diagnosis--evidence--action relations into a structured graph. During inference, CDEG tracks the evolving patient evidence state to retrieve relevant diagnostic relations and selectively guide missing evidence acquisition or overlooked evidence reappraisal. Across in-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks with multiple doctor agent backbones, CDEG consistently improves diagnostic performance, achieving up to an 11.5% accuracy gain over vanilla agents. These results demonstrate that reliable long-horizon diagnosis requires moving beyond trajectory-level experience reuse toward evidence-level learning of the factors that truly shape clinical decisions.

    中文

    不同于静态医学问答，长时程诊断体现了临床实践的序贯特性：在得出最终诊断之前，证据会经过多轮交互逐步获取、整合和评估。然而，当关键证据未被获取或未被充分纳入诊断推理时，现有医生智能体往往会失败。近期的智能体方法试图通过重用历史轨迹或提炼后的记忆来解决这些失败。但其诊断效果提升仍受限制，因为此类经验可能包含噪声或偶然信息，而且通常未经验证便被重用，无法确认究竟哪些证据真正驱动了诊断决策。为解决这一局限，我们提出 CDEG，这是一种基于图的框架，可从历史诊断轨迹中学习可重用的决策关键证据。CDEG 对比同一病例中成功与失败的轨迹，以识别候选证据，通过受控反事实干预验证其对诊断的影响，并将由此得到的诊断—证据—行动关系组织成结构化图。在推理过程中，CDEG 跟踪不断变化的患者证据状态，以检索相关诊断关系，并有选择地引导缺失证据的获取或对被忽略证据的重新评估。在多个医生智能体骨干模型上的域内和分布外基准测试中，CDEG 持续提升诊断表现，相较于原始智能体，准确率最高提升 11.5%。这些结果表明，要实现可靠的长时程诊断，需要超越轨迹级经验重用，转向在证据层面学习真正影响临床决策的因素。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DCGC develops a confidence-guided method for correcting reasoning traces and reports gains on math, code, and knowledge reasoning tasks.     Correcting flawed reasoning traces remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs), whose autoregressive generation can propagate early mistakes into subsequent reasoning. We introduce DCGC, a Masked Diffusion Model (MDM) framework for global correction that uses an imperfect solution draft from an upstream solver as auxiliary context. DCGC combines task-specific Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with a novel inference-time mechanism called Dynamic Dual-CFG. This mechanism separates problem-only and joint problem-draft branches and scales the draft-conditioned residual using a relative confidence gap. Across math, code, and knowledge reasoning benchmarks, DCGC outperforms standard sampling and simpler CFG variants, with additional results suggesting transfer to different diffusion backbones. In test-time setting where ground-truth failure labels are unavailable, DCGC improves full test set accuracy by correcting low-consensus upstream outputs, highlighting its utility as a verifier-free global correction module for difficult reasoning instances.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AdaVDR trains a video research agent to adapt tool use and backtrack, using necessity-aware credit assignment and task-specific trajectories. Its agent and tool-use design is a substantial systems contribution, with reasoning involved in multi-step research but no explicit advance in reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Video deep research aims to answer questions by jointly understanding video content and retrieving external knowledge from the open Web. However, these tasks often require diverse and multi-step tool-use trajectories, which may lead to unnecessary video tool calls, incurring additional costs and failure risk. In this paper, we propose AdaVDR, an adaptive video deep research agent with adaptive tool use and reflection, which selects tools based on task and model capabilities while backtracking when needed. To this end, we develop a data construction pipeline that builds adaptive tool-use trajectories according to task types and model capabilities. Specifically, we construct QA pairs that require both video and external information, and organize the information acquisition processes into task-specific tool-use trajectories. We then apply model-conditioned tool necessity filtering to remove tools that can be bypassed using video understanding and internal knowledge of the model. Based on this pipeline, we construct a training dataset with adaptive trajectories and perform SFT on them to initialize these capabilities of AdaVDR. To further improve adaptive capabilities, we propose NASA-GRPO, a necessity-aware segment-guided credit assignment method, which evaluates segment-guided evidence contribution and tool necessity to construct normalized tool-level rewards. We also construct VDR-EE, a benchmark built using the proposed pipeline. Experiments show that AdaVDR outperforms the base model by 15.20 and 29.00 percentage points on VDR-EE and the existing VideoDR, respectively, demonstrating its superiority.

    Jiaming Fan, Daming Cao, Canchen Huang, Jiale Fu, Jin Zhang, Junjie Gao, Kai Yang, Xiangzhong Luo, Xu Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TreeGraft combines drafters of different costs to build speculative-decoding trees and uses a scheduler to control when stronger drafting is worthwhile. This is a substantial contribution to inference efficiency and adaptive computation; tree composition is incidental, with no claimed advance in reasoning or internal interpretability.

    TreeGraft 结合不同成本的草稿器来构建推测解码树，并使用调度器控制何时值得调用较强的草稿器。这项工作对推理效率和自适应计算作出了实质性贡献；树的组合只是附带设计，并未声称在推理或内部可解释性方面有所进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference through a draft-then-verify paradigm. Building on this, tree-structured methods improve inference by organizing proposals into multiple candidate paths, increasing the accepted length. However, existing tree-structured methods use a single drafter for all drafting steps, creating a dilemma: a smaller drafter is fast but yields lower-quality trees, whereas a larger drafter improves tree quality but suffers from high latency. To address this, we propose TreeGraft, a multi-drafter framework in which drafters of different costs jointly construct a shared draft tree. TreeGraft uses the stronger drafter to rescore candidates by updating scores assigned by the weaker drafter, reselect grafting positions, and recover promising paths left unexplored. It also integrates stronger drafter expansions non-destructively, preserving existing branches that may still be accepted by the target model. Together, these designs improve the quality of the shared draft tree. To control the drafting cost, TreeGraft introduces a lightweight scheduler distilled from an offline value system to decide when to call the stronger drafter. Across 10 model pairs and 6 benchmarks, TreeGraft outperforms the better of the two fixed single-drafter endpoint strategies by 15.1% on average, reaching a maximum gain of 26.6%. Our code is available at https://github.com/fjm9933/TreeGraft.

    中文

    推测解码通过“先起草、后验证”的范式加速大型语言模型推理。在此基础上，树结构方法将提议组织成多条候选路径，以提高接受长度。然而，现有树结构方法在所有起草步骤中都使用单个草稿器，因此陷入两难：较小的草稿器速度快，但生成的树质量较低；较大的草稿器能提升树质量，却有较高的延迟。为解决这一问题，我们提出 TreeGraft，这是一种多草稿器框架，由成本各异的草稿器共同构建共享草稿树。TreeGraft 使用较强的草稿器重新评分候选项，方法是更新较弱草稿器给出的分数、重新选择嫁接位置，并找回此前未探索的有希望路径。它还以非破坏性方式整合较强草稿器扩展，同时保留仍可能被目标模型接受的现有分支。这些设计共同提升了共享草稿树的质量。为控制起草成本，TreeGraft 引入一种从离线价值系统中蒸馏得到的轻量级调度器，用于决定何时调用较强的草稿器。在 10 组模型配对和 6 个基准测试中，TreeGraft 的表现平均比两种固定单草稿器端点策略中较好的策略高 15.1%，最高提升达 26.6%。我们的代码见 https://github.com/fjm9933/TreeGraft。

    FaithSieve: Fine-Grained Evaluation of Math Proofs with Faithful Formal Evidence

    FaithSieve：基于忠实形式化证据的数学证明细粒度评估

    Ziyu Wang, Qiming Dai, Yishan Wu, and Zaiwen Wen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FaithSieve improves fine-grained localization of errors in mathematical proofs by decomposing steps and checking aligned formal obligations. This substantially advances reasoning evaluation; its use of an evaluation agent and Lean is incidental to the contribution, with no broader agent-system or compositional mechanism insight.

    FaithSieve 通过拆解证明步骤并检查对齐的形式化证明义务，提高了数学证明中的细粒度错误定位能力。这显著推动了推理评估的发展；其对评估智能体和 Lean 的使用只是实现贡献的手段，并未揭示更广泛的智能体系统或组合机制方面的洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models can now generate complex, multi-step mathematical proofs, but reliably determining their correctness and localizing early logical errors remains a critical challenge. Existing evaluation approaches largely depend on model-based natural-language judgments, which often overlook local reasoning gaps. While formal theorem provers like Lean offer a path to rigorous verification, using them to evaluate informal text requires solving locality and semantic mismatches: a prover might bypass a local flaw by proving an overly broad target, or validate an auto-formalized statement that drifts from the original mathematical intent. To address this, we introduce FaithSieve, a Lean-assisted framework for fine-grained evaluation of natural-language mathematical proofs. FaithSieve decomposes coarse proof steps into local reasoning units, extracts typed proof obligations, and verifies them through a formal evaluation agent. Formal validation is gated by semantic alignment scoring, so Lean evidence is incorporated only when the formal statement faithfully preserves the context, objects, and logical form of the original claim. We construct two expert-verified datasets, ProofLoc-Olympiad and ProofLoc-University, to benchmark first-error localization. On the 350-problem Olympiad dataset, FaithSieve using a GPT-5.4 backbone achieves 81.43% exact first-error accuracy, outperforming the direct-judging baseline of 72.29%. Furthermore, on the 200-problem ProofLoc-University benchmark spanning six advanced domains, FaithSieve reaches 84.5% exact accuracy, compared to 75.0% for the direct judge. Our work demonstrates that decomposing proofs into fine-grained units and grounding them with faithful formal evidence significantly improves reliable evaluation of natural-language reasoning.

    中文

    大型语言模型如今能够生成复杂的多步数学证明，但可靠地判定其正确性并定位早期逻辑错误仍是一项关键挑战。现有评估方法大多依赖基于模型的自然语言判断，常常忽略局部推理缺口。Lean 等形式化定理证明器为严格验证提供了一条途径，但将其用于评估非正式文本需要解决局部性和语义不匹配问题：证明器可能通过证明一个过于宽泛的目标来绕过局部缺陷，也可能验证一个自动形式化后偏离原始数学意图的陈述。为解决这些问题，我们提出 FaithSieve，这是一种借助 Lean 对自然语言数学证明进行细粒度评估的框架。FaithSieve 将粗略的证明步骤拆解为局部推理单元，提取带类型的证明义务，并通过形式化评估智能体对其进行验证。形式化验证受语义对齐评分门控，因此只有当形式化陈述忠实保留原始论断的上下文、对象和逻辑形式时，才会纳入 Lean 证据。我们构建了两个经专家验证的数据集 ProofLoc-Olympiad 和 ProofLoc-University，用于评测首个错误定位。在包含 350 道题的 Olympiad 数据集上，使用 GPT-5.4 骨干模型的 FaithSieve 达到 81.43% 的首个错误精确定位准确率，优于 72.29% 的直接判断基线。此外，在涵盖六个高级领域、包含 200 道题的 ProofLoc-University 基准上，FaithSieve 的精确准确率达到 84.5%，而直接判断器为 75.0%。我们的工作表明，将证明拆解为细粒度单元，并用忠实的形式化证据为其提供依据，能显著提高自然语言推理评估的可靠性。

    Mingqian Yu, Wenpeng Zhang, Shaobo Cui, Peilin Zhao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The main contribution is token-specific routing over loop iterations, with recursion-wise KV caching to improve autoregressive decoding. Adaptive latent computation advances reasoning and model systems, while the abstract offers no analysis of internal representations or compositional generalization.

    其主要贡献是针对令牌在循环迭代中进行令牌特定路由，并通过按递归层级划分的 KV 缓存改进自回归解码。自适应潜空间计算推动了推理和模型系统的发展，而摘要没有分析内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Looped Transformers have recently demonstrated strong performance in both reasoning and language tasks by reusing a shared set of parameters across multiple iterations, achieving parameter efficiency without sacrificing representational power. Besides, looped Transformers perform inference directly in the latent space (latent reasoning) to reduce the number of tokens consumed during inference, thereby achieving improved sample efficiency. However, these models typically apply a fixed recursion depth uniformly to every token, leading to suboptimal compute allocation and leaving significant efficiency gains on the table. In this work, we propose \textbf{t}oken-level elastic-depth \textbf{looped transformers}: T-LoopFormer. T-LoopFormer uses \textbf{dynamic token-choice routing}, which enables each token to adaptively determine its own number of loop iterations based on its hidden state, which could improve the token generation accuracy. Moreover, we further introduce recursion-wise KV cache, which maintains an independent key-value cache for each recursion loop of active tokens; this design ensures that tokens at different depths only attend to their corresponding cached states, effectively enabling faster autoregressive decoding. Extensive experiments show that T-LoopFormer achieves robust performance on a wide range of language modeling and zero-shot reasoning tasks, and our model could reach the lowest decoding latency, which validates the effectiveness of token-choice router and recursion-wise KV cache. Code is available at https://github.com/YuMingQian1234/T-LoopFormer

    中文

    循环 Transformer 通过在多次迭代中重用一组共享参数，近期已在推理和语言任务上展现出强劲表现，在不牺牲表征能力的情况下实现了参数效率。此外，循环 Transformer 直接在潜空间中进行推理（潜在推理），以减少推理时消耗的令牌数，从而提升样本效率。然而，这些模型通常对每个令牌都采用固定递归深度，导致计算资源分配欠佳，未能充分发挥效率提升空间。在本研究中，我们提出令牌级弹性深度循环 Transformer：T-LoopFormer。T-LoopFormer 使用动态令牌选择路由，使每个令牌能够根据自身隐藏状态，自适应地决定循环迭代次数，从而有望提升令牌生成准确率。此外，我们还引入按递归层级划分的 KV 缓存，为活跃令牌的每个递归循环维护独立的键值缓存；这一设计确保不同深度的令牌只关注各自对应的缓存状态，从而有效加快自回归解码。大量实验表明，T-LoopFormer 在广泛的语言建模和零样本推理任务上表现稳健，且模型能够达到最低解码延迟，验证了令牌选择路由器和按递归层级划分的 KV 缓存的有效性。代码见 https://github.com/YuMingQian1234/T-LoopFormer

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MemoryAthena’s main contribution is a learned causal router that selectively uses generated memory to correct direct retrieval, with bounded residual interpolation and recovery on rejection. This advances model memory and conditional computation; complementary pathways alone do not establish compositional generalization, and the abstract gives no mechanistic interpretability or reasoning contribution.

    MemoryAthena 的主要贡献是一个学习得到的因果路由器，它通过有界残差插值和拒绝时的路径恢复，有选择地使用生成式记忆来修正直接检索。这推进了模型记忆和条件计算；仅有互补路径并不能证明组合泛化，而摘要也未体现机制可解释性或推理方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Learned-memory methods store information in an explicit table and consume it through a separate reader, allowing addressing, storage, and reading to be modified independently. We study whether useful memory can also be generated rather than only retrieved. MemoryAthena uses three pathways: direct Engram retrieval (E), generation from retrieved Engram cues (GE), and generation from causal backbone states without consulting the memory table (GH). Generated memory is conditionally useful: it can complement E in one context but interfere with it in another. MemoryAthena therefore treats E as an anchor and learns when a generated representation should intervene. With the backbone, memory, generators, and readers frozen, a lightweight causal routing head is trained from counterfactual future-token likelihood advantages of GE and GH relative to E. At inference time, an admitted candidate modifies the E residual through bounded interpolation, while rejection recovers the direct pathway exactly. On question answering, MemoryAthena raises the five-task average from 37.65 to 39.28 over the direct pathway of the same checkpoint, while the six-task general-NLP average increases from 76.73 to 79.13. The complete memory-side system contains approximately 201M parameters, excluding the frozen backbone. Further analyses show complementary strengths among E, GE, and GH across tasks and inputs. These results support generated memory as a selective correction to direct retrieval and highlight routing when, which, and how strongly to intervene as the central challenge.

    中文

    学习式记忆方法将信息存储在显式表中，并通过独立的读取器使用这些信息，因此寻址、存储和读取可以分别修改。我们研究有用的记忆是否也可以通过生成获得，而非仅靠检索。MemoryAthena 使用三条路径：直接 Engram 检索（E）、根据检索到的 Engram 线索进行生成（GE），以及在不查询记忆表的情况下根据因果主干网络状态进行生成（GH）。生成式记忆的效用取决于具体情境：在一种情境中，它可以补充 E；在另一种情境中，则可能与之冲突。因此，MemoryAthena 将 E 视为锚点，并学习何时应让生成的表征介入。在主干网络、记忆、生成器和读取器均冻结的情况下，系统根据 GE 和 GH 相对于 E 的反事实未来词元似然优势训练一个轻量级因果路由头。在推理时，获准候选项通过有界插值修改 E 的残差；若候选项被拒绝，则精确恢复直接路径。在问答任务上，相比同一检查点的直接路径，MemoryAthena 将五项任务的平均分从 37.65 提高到 39.28；六项通用 NLP 任务的平均分则从 76.73 提高到 79.13。完整的记忆侧系统约含 201M 个参数，不包括冻结的主干网络。进一步分析显示，E、GE 和 GH 在不同任务和输入上各有互补优势。这些结果表明，生成式记忆可作为对直接检索的选择性修正，并凸显了路由的核心挑战：何时介入、选择哪种方式介入，以及介入力度多大。

    Memory Attention

    记忆注意力

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Memory Attention replaces value projections with token-indexed memory combined with contextual keys, and the lookup design supports CPU offloading and lower GPU storage.     记忆注意力用按词元索引的记忆与上下文键相结合来替代值投影，其查找式设计还支持 CPU 卸载并减少 GPU 存储需求。这是对模型架构和记忆的重要贡献，但摘要没有研究表征机制、组合或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language models typically construct attention values from contextual hidden states, even when some of their content may be reusable across contexts. We investigate whether token-indexed memory can replace the dedicated value projection when complemented by contextual information. We propose Memory Attention (MA), which forms values by combining layer-specific token memory with contextual keys. The memory supplies token-specific representations, while the keys preserve context dependence. At inference, normalization can be folded into the memory tables, reducing value construction to lookup and addition. Token-indexed retrieval also enables CPU offloading with prefetching, reducing GPU parameter storage. Under matched training token budgets and with additional memory parameters, experiments across attention configurations show improved language modeling and average downstream performance.

    Zhiwei Chen and Tianchun Wang and Zhongtao Rao and Haiming Zhu and Ding Cao and Tianxiang Zhao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SAGE structures inference-time game reasoning around an equilibrium anchor, opponent beliefs, and recalibration from relevant interactions, with reported gains in payoff and token use. This is a substantial strategic reasoning method, while its coordination of steps and interaction history gives only limited evidence for broader compositional or systems advances.

    SAGE 将推理时的博弈推理组织为均衡锚点、对手信念，以及根据相关交互进行重新校准，并报告了收益和词元用量方面的提升。这是一种重要的战略推理方法；不过，其步骤协同和交互历史仅有限地证明了更广泛的组合或系统层面进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A strong LLM strategic agent should reason prospectively over uncertain futures, adapt its strategy to opponents' behavioral tendencies, and continuously recalibrate its decision process from interaction experience. However, incorporating these sources in free-form reasoning could lead to unsupported strategic assumptions, inconsistent opponent estimates, and harmful interference from irrelevant historical interactions. To address these issues, we propose SAGE, a training-free inference-time framework that structures LLM strategic reasoning around three coordinated operations: anchor, adapt, and recalibrate. SAGE first anchors reasoning to an equilibrium policy that provides a strategically valid prior. It then conditions deviations from this anchor on a soft belief over opponent behavioral tendencies, enabling opponent-specific exploitation. Finally, SAGE distills strategically related interactions into counterfactual hypotheses about previously missing considerations, allowing past experience to recalibrate the model's reasoning. We evaluate SAGE on three repeated imperfect-information games: Leduc Hold'em, Liar's Dice, and Goofspiel, against various opponent types in each game. Compared with reasoning-intensive LLM agents, including Suspicion-Agent, ReTA, Agent-Pro, EMO, and Hypothetical Minds, SAGE achieves up to a 127.6% payoff improvement in Liar's Dice while reducing input and output token usage by up to 80% and 90%, respectively. In direct match-up play, it attains non-negative mean payoff against 5/10, 8/10, and 8/10 evaluated opponents in Leduc Hold'em, Liar's Dice, and Goofspiel, respectively, while using relatively fewer tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/SAGE.

    中文

    强大的 LLM 战略智能体应当对不确定的未来进行前瞻性推理，根据对手的行为倾向调整策略，并持续依据交互经验重新校准决策过程。然而，在自由形式推理中纳入这些信息，可能导致缺乏依据的战略假设、前后不一致的对手估计，以及无关历史交互造成的有害干扰。为解决这些问题，我们提出 SAGE：一种无需训练的推理时框架，将 LLM 战略推理组织为三个协同操作：锚定、适应和重新校准。SAGE 首先将推理锚定于一种均衡策略，该策略提供在战略上有效的先验。随后，它依据对手行为倾向的软性信念来决定偏离锚点的程度，从而能够针对特定对手进行利用。最后，SAGE 将战略相关交互提炼为反事实假设，指出此前遗漏的考量，使过往经验能够重新校准模型推理。我们在三种重复进行的不完全信息博弈中评估 SAGE：Leduc Hold'em、Liar's Dice 和 Goofspiel；每种游戏均对阵多种类型的对手。与包括 Suspicion-Agent、ReTA、Agent-Pro、EMO 和 Hypothetical Minds 在内的推理密集型 LLM 智能体相比，SAGE 在 Liar's Dice 中的收益最高提升 127.6%，同时将输入和输出词元用量分别最多减少 80% 和 90%。在直接对局中，SAGE 在 Leduc Hold'em、Liar's Dice 和 Goofspiel 中，分别对 5/10、8/10 和 8/10 个受评估对手取得非负平均收益，同时使用的词元相对较少。代码见 https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/SAGE。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    NeuronDiscover combines a world action model, experiment selection, and graph revision to identify mechanisms while accounting for simulator discrepancy. Its main contribution is an agent system for intervention and observation design, but the claimed mechanism discovery concerns neuronal worlds rather than AI model internals; composition and reasoning are supporting elements rather than central advances.

    NeuronDiscover 将世界行动模型、实验选择和图修订结合起来，在考虑模拟器差异的同时识别机制。其主要贡献是一个用于干预和观测设计的智能体系统，但所声称的机制发现针对的是神经元世界，而非 AI 模型内部；组合与推理只是辅助要素，并非核心进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Mechanistic discovery in neuronal microenvironments requires interventions and measurements that separate competing explanations of solute transport and neuronal response. Predictive accuracy cannot settle the question: a real mechanistic change and an error in the computational twin leave the same signature in sparse observations. We formalize this twin confounding and reason over a joint mechanism--discrepancy belief, designing experiments that separate the two. NeuronDiscover is an Agent-in-Twin framework whose shared, mechanism-grounded World Action Model (WAM) couples prediction, intervention proposals, and observation design; independently adjudicated outcomes revise a scoped Mechanism--Intervention--Observation--Outcome (MIOY) graph, whose supported relations compile into executable programs carrying discrepancy-adjusted acceptance bounds. We evaluate on simulated brain-fluid tracer-transport worlds adjudicated by an independently frozen finer-mesh reference solver, and on donor-disjoint public current-clamp recordings of cortical neurons. Counting only relations that reach a certified terminal status, and scoring abstentions as unresolved for every method, at a matched budget of 16 experiments over 32 source units NeuronDiscover resolves 4.0 relations per assigned world against 3.4 for the strongest baseline and 3.2 without graph revision, at 5% false support and 82% scope accuracy. Joint mechanism--discrepancy acquisition resolves 3.8 relations versus 2.9 for plug-in expected information gain; discrepancy-adjusted verification lowers accepted-program failure from 15% to 9% at 60% acceptance coverage; and transfer to the recordings yields 1.94 versus 1.53 relations per assigned world. Correctness is adjudicated within declared model worlds and archival recordings.

    中文

    在神经元微环境中发现机制，需要通过干预和测量区分关于溶质运输和神经元响应的竞争性解释。预测准确率无法解决这一问题：真实的机制变化与计算孪生体中的误差，在稀疏观测中会呈现相同特征。我们将这种孪生体混淆形式化，并围绕联合的机制—差异信念进行推理，以设计能够区分二者的实验。NeuronDiscover 是一种 Twin 内智能体框架，其共享且以机制为基础的世界行动模型（WAM）将预测、干预方案提出和观测设计结合起来；经过独立裁定的结果会修订一个有范围限定的机制—干预—观测—结果（MIOY）图，其中得到支持的关系会被编译为可执行程序，并附带经差异调整的接受界限。我们在模拟的脑脊液示踪剂运输世界中进行评估，并由一个独立冻结的、更细网格的参考求解器裁定结果；还在供体互不重叠的公开皮层神经元电流钳记录上进行评估。在匹配预算下，每个来源单元进行 16 次实验、共涉及 32 个来源单元；只统计达到认证终止状态的关系，并对所有方法均将弃答计为未解决。NeuronDiscover 在每个分配世界中解决 4.0 个关系，而最强基线为 3.4 个、不进行图修订时为 3.2 个；假支持率为 5%，范围准确率为 82%。联合机制—差异采集解决 3.8 个关系，而插件式期望信息增益为 2.9 个；经差异调整的验证将已接受程序的失败率从 15% 降至 9%，接受覆盖率为 60%；迁移到记录数据后，每个分配世界得到 1.94 个关系，而对照为 1.53 个。正确性是在声明的模型世界和存档记录范围内裁定的。

    NeuronSifter：利用世界行动模型优先排序中枢神经系统干预的 Twin 内智能体

    Haowei Xu, Wanyi Fu, Hongbin Han, Zhaoheng Xie

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    NeuronSifter contributes an agent-and-digital-twin framework for choosing interventions and informative measurements under uncertainty, with mechanisms grounded in neuronal simulations. Its decision planning supports a partial reasoning connection, while the biological application does not establish compositional generalization or model-internal interpretability.

    NeuronSifter 提出一个智能体与数字孪生体框架，用于在不确定性下选择干预和有信息价值的测量，其机制以神经元模拟为基础。其决策规划与推理有一定关联，但该生物学应用并未证明组合泛化或模型内部可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Effective central nervous system (CNS) intervention requires more than predicting biological responses: a scientific system must determine which intervention, observation, or additional evidence can improve a decision under uncertainty. However, in partially observed neuronal microenvironments, identical predicted outcomes may correspond to different exposure states, biological mechanisms, and intervention risks. We propose NeuronSifter, a decision-centric Agent-in-Twin framework, where an AI agent operates with an evolving biological digital twin rather than a fixed predictive model. NeuronSifter compiles interventions into state-conditional target-occupancy representations, propagates them through a mechanism-grounded World Action Model (WAM), and selects informative measurements based on their expected reduction in decision uncertainty. A shared probabilistic belief state couples intervention simulation, observation selection, and outcome assimilation, enabling the digital twin to continuously refine its decision-relevant representations through externally verified evidence. We evaluate NeuronSifter in Alzheimer's disease intervention scenarios using mechanistic neuronal microenvironment simulations and retrospective clinical endpoint references. The evaluation framework examines adaptive evidence acquisition, uncertainty-aware intervention planning, and robustness under model discrepancy through controlled environments and independent comparisons. NeuronSifter demonstrates how an AI system can actively identify missing evidence, refine biological hypotheses, and optimize intervention decisions under limited experimental budgets. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/NeuronSifter.

    中文

    有效的中枢神经系统（CNS）干预不仅需要预测生物响应：科学系统还必须确定在不确定性下，哪种干预、观测或额外证据能够改善决策。然而，在部分可观测的神经元微环境中，相同的预测结果可能对应不同的暴露状态、生物机制和干预风险。我们提出 NeuronSifter，这是一种以决策为中心的 Twin 内智能体框架，其中 AI 智能体与不断演进的生物数字孪生体协同运行，而非依赖固定预测模型。NeuronSifter 将干预编译为以状态为条件的靶点占有率表征，通过以机制为基础的世界行动模型（WAM）传播这些表征，并根据测量预计能够降低决策不确定性的程度来选择有信息价值的测量。共享的概率信念状态将干预模拟、观测选择和结果吸收联系起来，使数字孪生体能够通过外部验证的证据，持续改进与决策相关的表征。我们使用机制性神经元微环境模拟和回顾性临床终点参考，对 NeuronSifter 在阿尔茨海默病干预场景中的表现进行评估。评估框架通过受控环境和独立比较，考察自适应证据获取、考虑不确定性的干预规划，以及面对模型差异时的稳健性。NeuronSifter 展示了 AI 系统如何在实验预算有限的情况下，主动识别缺失证据、完善生物学假设，并优化干预决策。代码见 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/NeuronSifter。

    The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation

    教师是方向，而非目的地：在在线蒸馏中外推 RL 诱导的表征残差

    Hao Li, MeiJia Chen, Weijie Ren, Donghan Li, Zijun Tian, Jingchun Huang, Naibo Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RIDE directly uses layerwise representation changes induced by RL and proposes an algorithm to extrapolate them during distillation, providing transferable insight into representation geometry. Its reported gains concern training performance rather than reasoning capabilities, and the abstract gives no substantive composition or systems contribution.

    RIDE 直接利用 RL 诱导的逐层表征变化，并提出在蒸馏过程中外推这些变化的算法，从而对表征几何提供了可迁移的见解。报告的收益涉及训练性能而非推理能力，摘要也未体现实质性的组合或系统层面贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student to match the teacher's next-token distributions on the student's own trajectories and has yielded substantial empirical gains. Generalized variants allow the student to surpass the teacher by extrapolating an implicit reward in output space. The language-model head, however, attenuates this change anisotropically: much of the change encoded in the teacher's hidden states reaches the logits at a small fraction of its weight, and the sampled-token log-probability ratios on which output-space extrapolation relies inject noise that the extrapolation amplifies, making training unstable. We observe that reinforcement learning (RL) shifts a model's internal representations relative to its base checkpoint, and that the direction of this shift can be measured at every layer. Motivated by this observation, we propose RIDE (RL-Induced Direction Extrapolation), which extrapolates the RL-induced change directly in representation space: at every layer and token position, RIDE computes the residual between the teacher and its pre-RL checkpoint and regresses the student's hidden states toward targets displaced beyond the teacher along this residual. Conditioned on a sampled trajectory, this regression is equivalent to maximizing a linear directional reward defined by the residual under a quadratic penalty centered at the teacher, which makes explicit how the objective moves the student along the RL-induced direction while limiting its deviation from the teacher. Across four base/RL-teacher pairs spanning different scales, architectures, and pre-training lineages, RIDE approaches or exceeds the RL-trained teacher on every pair and is the only method whose mean does so, and it consistently outperforms output-space extrapolation, which degrades the student whenever the teacher is close to its base. Project page: https://github.com/xixixixixxxx/RIDE.

    中文

    在线蒸馏（OPD）在学生自身的轨迹上训练学生，使其匹配教师的下一词元分布，并已带来显著的实证收益。广义变体通过在输出空间中外推隐式奖励，使学生得以超越教师。然而，语言模型头会以各向异性的方式削弱这种变化：教师隐藏状态中编码的大部分变化，只有一小部分权重传递到 logits；而输出空间外推所依赖的采样词元对数概率比会引入噪声，且外推会放大这种噪声，使训练不稳定。我们观察到，强化学习（RL）会使模型的内部表征相对于其基础检查点发生偏移，并且可以在每一层测量这种偏移的方向。受此观察启发，我们提出 RIDE（RL 诱导方向外推），直接在表征空间中外推 RL 诱导的变化：对于每一层和每个词元位置，RIDE 计算教师与其 RL 前检查点之间的残差，并将学生隐藏状态回归到沿该残差方向越过教师位置的目标上。给定一条采样轨迹后，这种回归等价于最大化由残差定义的线性方向奖励，同时施加以教师为中心的二次惩罚；这明确说明了目标如何推动学生沿 RL 诱导的方向移动，同时限制其偏离教师的程度。在涵盖不同规模、架构和预训练谱系的四组基础模型/RL 教师组合上，RIDE 在每组中都接近或超过经过 RL 训练的教师，且只有 RIDE 的平均表现达到或超过教师；它也始终优于输出空间外推，后者在教师接近其基础模型时会降低学生性能。项目页面：https://github.com/xixixixixxxx/RIDE。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies how rollout scale and champion-challenger selection improve automatic evolution of a robot agent’s harness, with held-out task results. Its agent design and revision-selection strategy are a substantial systems contribution; tool use and task performance provide no substantive evidence about model mechanisms, composition, or reasoning.

    该论文研究 rollout 规模和冠军—挑战者筛选如何改进机器人智能体工具框架的自动演化，并报告留出任务结果。其智能体设计和修订筛选策略是重要的系统贡献；工具使用和任务表现并未对模型机制、组合能力或推理提供实质性证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When an off-the-shelf coding agent is used directly as a robot policy, observing a browser-based 3D interface through screenshots and acting by posing a virtual target gripper through a few tools, the agent's harness, its prompts, tools, and control rules, largely determines success, and until now it has been written by hand. We show that this harness can be improved automatically by another coding agent, the optimizer agent, and report two findings about what makes it work. First, the number of rollouts the optimizer agent sees per round governs whether the evolved harness generalizes: with rounds fixed, held-out success rises as the training batch grows from 5 to 100 rollouts, while small batches overfit the training tasks. Second, the optimizer agent must not be given free rein. Accepting every revision it proposes degrades the harness within a few rounds; a simple Champion-Challenger rule that promotes a revision only if it beats the incumbent on the same fixed cases turns the same loop into one that raises held-out success on LIBERO tasks from 51% to 67% over 30 rounds. Combining the evolved harness with a pretrained policy, through one tool that hands it control, reaches 71.2% on the RoboCasa365 leaderboard benchmark, 13.1 points above the best published entry. Automatic harness evolution for visual-interface robot agents is thus feasible, but its gains hinge on the rollout scale behind each decision and on how the optimizer agent's revisions are selected.

    中文

    当直接将现成的编码智能体用作机器人策略时，智能体通过截图观察基于浏览器的 3D 界面，并通过少数几个工具摆放虚拟目标夹爪来执行操作；此时，智能体的工具框架——包括提示词、工具和控制规则——在很大程度上决定了成败，而此前这些内容一直由人工编写。我们展示了另一个编码智能体，即优化器智能体，可以自动改进这一工具框架，并报告了关于其有效机制的两项发现。第一，优化器智能体每轮看到的 rollout 数量决定了演化后的工具框架能否泛化：在轮数固定时，随着训练批次从 5 个增至 100 个 rollout，留出集上的成功率会上升；而较小批次会对训练任务过拟合。第二，不能让优化器智能体不受约束地自由发挥。接受它提出的每一项修订，会在几轮之内使工具框架退化；一条简单的冠军—挑战者规则规定，只有当修订版在相同的固定案例上胜过当前版本时才予以晋升，这便能让同一循环在 30 轮内将 LIBERO 任务的留出集成功率从 51% 提升到 67%。将演化后的工具框架与预训练策略结合，并通过一个将控制权交给该策略的工具进行协作，在 RoboCasa365 排行榜基准上达到 71.2%，比已发表的最佳成绩高 13.1 个百分点。因此，面向视觉界面的机器人智能体可以自动演化工具框架，但其收益取决于每次决策所依据的 rollout 规模，以及优化器智能体提出的修订如何被筛选。

    Imagine the Future, Internalize the Gist: Efficient VLA Reasoning via Internalized Spatiotemporal Imagination

    想象未来，内化要旨：通过内化时空想象实现高效 VLA 推理

    Shenglan Li, Zhendong Mi, Hengyi Zhu, Jingwu Luo, Chun Kit Chan, Geng Yuan, Yanzhi Wang, Pu Zhao, Shaoyi Huang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    IG-VLA learns latent future scene reasoning for action prediction and compresses reasoning-derived scene-behavior associations into a gist token, improving performance and inference speed. This advances embodied reasoning and efficient inference, with a limited connection to representations; the abstract does not establish compositional generalization or mechanistic interpretability.

    IG-VLA 学习潜在的未来场景推理来预测动作，并将推理得出的场景—行为关联压缩为要旨 token，从而提升性能和推理速度。这项工作推进了具身推理和高效推理，与表征研究有一定联系；摘要并未证实组合泛化或机制可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate intermediate reasoning to improve robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches primarily reason about observed states without explicitly anticipating future scene evolution. Extending such reasoning to explicit future rollouts at every inference step, however, introduces substantial computational overhead. We propose IG-VLA, a VLA reasoning framework that enables models to imagine the future and internalize the gist. Our Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning learns to imagine task-relevant future scene evolution directly in visual representation space, guiding action prediction without costly pixel-level video generation. To further reduce inference overhead, we introduce Scene Gist Memory, which internalizes reasoning-derived scene-behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token, preserving the benefits of future reasoning while bypassing explicit future imagination at inference. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of IG-VLA. On the LIBERO-Plus Language suite, both the reasoning and gist policies outperform the strongest baseline by nearly 6% in success rate. The gist policy also achieves up to 6.38x speedup over baselines, reducing inference latency from 1081ms to 169.5ms per action chunk on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU. These results demonstrate that future spatiotemporal reasoning can be effectively internalized for efficient VLA deployment.

    中文

    视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型日益融入中间推理以改进机器人操作，但现有方法主要针对已观察到的状态进行推理，并未明确预测场景未来如何演变。然而，在每个推理步骤中都扩展为显式预测未来轨迹，会带来大量计算开销。我们提出 IG-VLA，这是一种使模型能够想象未来并内化要旨的 VLA 推理框架。我们的潜在时空推理直接在视觉表征空间中学习想象与任务相关的未来场景演变，以指导动作预测，避免代价高昂的像素级视频生成。为进一步降低推理开销，我们引入场景要旨记忆，将推理得出的场景—行为关联内化为紧凑的场景要旨 token，在保留未来推理优势的同时，于推理时绕过显式的未来想象。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 VLABench 上的大量实验展示了 IG-VLA 的有效性和效率。在 LIBERO-Plus Language 套件上，推理策略和要旨策略的成功率均比最强基线高出近 6%。要旨策略相较基线还实现了最高 6.38 倍的加速；在单块 NVIDIA A6000 GPU 上，每个动作块的推理延迟从 1081ms 降至 169.5ms。这些结果表明，可以有效地内化未来时空推理，以支持高效部署 VLA。

    RRM-GPT: A Framework and Vision for Radio Resource Management Foundation Models

    RRM-GPT：无线资源管理基础模型的框架与愿景

    Ahmed Aboulfotouh, Akram Bin Sediq, Koosha Pourtahmasi Roshandeh, Omar Mashaal, Ahmad M. Nagib, Jale Sadreddini, and Hatem Abou-Zeid

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RRM-GPT generates structured scheduling decisions field by field and reports transfer to an unseen scenario, making reusable composition a substantial contribution. Its foundation-model framing and reinforcement-learning adaptation are incidental to general reasoning or model-system mechanisms.

    RRM-GPT 逐字段生成结构化调度决策，并报告了向未见场景迁移的结果，因此可复用的组合能力构成了重要贡献。其基础模型定位和强化学习适配只是附带内容，与通用推理或模型系统机制无关。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Learning-based models for radio resource management (RRM) are typically built for a single function and deployment, so each new setting repeats the development pipeline. RRM decisions, however, share a common structure: each is assembled from interdependent fields, defined by the standard, whose values are selected in view of the network state. We propose RRM-GPT, an autoregressive framework for RRM foundation models that generate these decisions as a language model generates text. An encoder maps heterogeneous network observations into a common token representation, and a decoder emits the decision one field at a time, each conditioned on the network state and the fields already committed. Pretraining on unannotated network logs teaches the model what makes a decision valid and how controllers choose among valid decisions; post-training then adapts it to deployment-specific operator objectives through imitation or reinforcement learning. The framework targets two forms of reuse: a function-specific model reused across deployments, and a model shared across RRM functions that generates their interdependent decisions as one sequence. In a 5G New Radio (NR) case study, we demonstrate that a single model generates complete scheduling grants spanning user selection, timing, link adaptation, resource allocation, and control signaling. The model captures dependencies among grant fields and transfers learned behavior to an unseen scenario without adaptation.

    中文

    基于学习的无线资源管理（RRM）模型通常针对单一功能和部署场景构建，因此每遇到新的设置都要重复开发流程。然而，RRM 决策具有共同结构：每项决策都由标准定义的、相互依赖的字段组成，其取值根据网络状态选择。我们提出 RRM-GPT，这是一种用于 RRM 基础模型的自回归框架，像语言模型生成文本一样生成这些决策。编码器将异构网络观测映射为统一的词元表征，解码器则逐字段生成决策；每个字段的生成都以网络状态和此前已确定的字段为条件。利用未标注的网络日志进行预训练，可以教会模型何种决策有效，以及控制器如何在有效决策中作出选择；随后通过模仿学习或强化学习进行后训练，使模型适应特定部署场景的运营商目标。该框架旨在实现两种复用：一种是将面向特定功能的模型用于不同部署场景；另一种是在多个 RRM 功能间共享模型，将它们相互依赖的决策作为一个序列生成。在 5G 新空口（NR）案例研究中，我们展示了单个模型能够生成完整的调度授权，涵盖用户选择、时序、链路自适应、资源分配和控制信令。该模型捕捉了各授权字段之间的依赖关系，并将学到的行为迁移到未经适配的新场景。

    MiniCorp：迈向 AI 智能体公司的最后一程

    Jingying Zeng, Zhenwei Dai, Jinning Li, Changho Shin, Dylan Zhang, Yuxuan Lu, Qi He, Dakuo Wang, Kai-Wei Chang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MiniCorp contributes a replayable simulator and longitudinal, counterfactual data for training and evaluating enterprise agents, with experiments on coordination and strategic adaptation. Agent organization is central, while the abstract gives no substantive account of internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    MiniCorp 提供了可重放的模拟器以及纵向和反事实数据，用于训练和评估企业智能体，并通过实验考察协作和战略适应。智能体组织是其核心，但摘要没有实质性讨论内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The last mile toward enterprise AGI is a company that runs itself. Training and adapting such agents require longitudinal enterprise data, which remain scarce, costly to acquire, and often restricted by privacy constraints. Historical archives are also frequently incomplete and record only what actually happened. They cannot show the outcomes of alternative decisions. We introduce MiniCorp, an office simulator for studying how agents can collectively run a company while generating enterprise data at scale. Using an e-commerce company as a demonstration, MiniCorp connects two interacting worlds. The external world models customers, dynamic competitors, and market mechanisms. The internal world consists of agents that observe events, discuss their options, and make strategic decisions. These decisions have lasting effects on the market, and the resulting feedback informs the firm's later decisions. As the firm and market interact, MiniCorp continuously records the agents' communications and decisions. These records preserve the information available at the time and the business results that followed. Checkpointing allows the same situation to be replayed under different decisions, providing comparisons unavailable in static archives. We evaluate end-to-end fidelity against patterns reported in empirical studies of real markets. These evaluations provide agents with realistic market feedback and reduce the risk that they learn to exploit flaws in the simulator. Our experiments show agents coordinating across roles and adapting their decisions to market feedback. With explicit long-term strategic guidance, they also sustain advertising exploration despite weak early returns. MiniCorp thus provides an environment for studying AI-run companies and a scalable source of longitudinal and counterfactual enterprise data for agent training and evaluation.

    中文

    迈向企业级 AGI 的最后一程，是建立一家能够自主运营的公司。训练和适配这类智能体需要企业纵向数据，但这类数据仍然稀缺、获取成本高，且常受隐私限制。历史档案也往往不完整，只记录实际发生过的事情，无法呈现其他决策可能带来的结果。我们提出 MiniCorp，这是一种办公室模拟器，用于研究智能体如何协同经营公司，同时大规模生成企业数据。MiniCorp 以一家电子商务公司为示例，将两个相互作用的世界连接起来。外部世界模拟客户、动态变化的竞争者和市场机制；内部世界由智能体组成，它们观察事件、讨论选项并作出战略决策。这些决策会对市场产生持久影响，而由此产生的反馈又会影响公司之后的决策。随着公司与市场持续互动，MiniCorp 不断记录智能体的通信和决策。这些记录保留了当时可获得的信息及其后续商业结果。检查点机制允许在同一情境下重放不同决策，从而提供静态档案无法实现的比较。我们依据真实市场实证研究报告的模式，评估端到端保真度。这些评估为智能体提供真实的市场反馈，并降低其学会利用模拟器缺陷的风险。实验显示，智能体能够跨角色协作，并根据市场反馈调整决策。在明确的长期战略指导下，即使早期回报微弱，它们也能持续探索广告策略。因此，MiniCorp 提供了一个研究 AI 自主经营公司的环境，并为智能体训练和评估提供了可扩展的纵向及反事实企业数据来源。

    Monte Carlo Estimation for KV Cache Eviction

    KV 缓存驱逐的蒙特卡洛估计

    Ahsan Bilal, Muhammad Ahmed Mohsin, Muhammad Umer, Wajih Hassan Raza, Atta Ul Asad, Young D. Kwon, Michal Valko, Dean F. Hougen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LORE-KV estimates which prompt tokens future decoding will need, using sampled continuations and response-side attention costs to improve cache eviction. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to model memory management, but its attention analysis does not investigate internal mechanisms or representations, and the decoding connection alone offers little reasoning insight.

    LORE-KV 利用采样续写和响应侧注意力成本来估计未来解码所需的提示词词元，从而改进缓存驱逐。这是对模型记忆管理的重要算法贡献，但其注意力分析并未研究内部机制或表征，而与解码的关联本身并未提供多少推理方面的洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Most KV-cache eviction methods ask, in effect, which memory appeared important while reading the prompt? We instead ask which memory will matter while answering? Since decoding queries are unavailable at eviction time, prior future-aware methods rely on pseudo-responses or synthetic future-query estimates. We cast fixed-budget future-aware eviction as distributional estimation over plausible model-conditional query trajectories and introduce LORE-KV (Lookahead Output-perturbation with Reliability-weighted Ensembles for Key-Value caches), a training-free method that samples short autoregressive continuations from the frozen target model and uses their response-side query states to estimate prompt-token utility. Tokens are scored by projected leave-one-out attention-output deletion cost and aggregated across sampled futures with optional trajectory weighting. The temporary continuations are discarded before final decoding, requiring no auxiliary model or training. Ablations isolate the mechanism: at B=128, a single response-side continuation recovers about 89% of the gain over the prompt-window control, while additional futures provide smaller improvements. At B=128, LORE-KV raises the LongBench average on Qwen2.5-14B from 45.49 to 48.24 (+2.75) and the 16K RULER average on Mistral-7B from 45.20 to 51.05 (+5.85); on Llama-3.1-8B, the RULER margin over AnDPro widens to +8.13 and +11.65 points at 64K and 128K contexts. Gains diminish at larger cache budgets and coexist with task-level regressions. LORE-KV incurs 1.46-2.77x AnDPro's per-sample wall-clock time as a one-time compression overhead across six dense and hybrid-attention backbones. Project webpage: https://ahsanbilal7.github.io/train_free_kv/

    中文

    大多数 KV 缓存驱逐方法实际上是在问：读取提示词时，哪些记忆显得重要？我们转而问：回答时，哪些记忆会起作用？由于驱逐时无法获得解码查询，先前具有未来感知能力的方法依赖伪响应或合成的未来查询估计。我们将固定预算的未来感知驱逐建模为对合理的、以模型为条件的查询轨迹进行分布估计，并提出 LORE-KV（用于键值缓存的前瞻输出扰动与可靠性加权集成），这是一种无需训练的方法。它从冻结的目标模型中采样短自回归续写，并利用续写响应侧的查询状态估计提示词词元的效用。通过投影的留一注意力输出删除成本为词元评分，并在采样的未来轨迹上进行聚合，还可选择按轨迹加权。临时续写会在最终解码前丢弃，因此无需辅助模型或训练。消融实验分离了其作用机制：在 B=128 时，单个响应侧续写即可恢复相对于提示词窗口对照方法约 89% 的增益，增加更多未来轨迹带来的提升则较小。在 B=128 时，LORE-KV 将 Qwen2.5-14B 上的 LongBench 平均分从 45.49 提高到 48.24（+2.75），并将 Mistral-7B 上 16K RULER 平均分从 45.20 提高到 51.05（+5.85）；在 Llama-3.1-8B 上，相较于 AnDPro，RULER 的优势在 64K 和 128K 上下文长度下分别扩大到 +8.13 和 +11.65 分。缓存预算增大时，收益会减小，且部分任务的性能有所回退。在六种稠密和混合注意力主干网络上，LORE-KV 会产生相当于 AnDPro 每样本墙钟时间 1.46–2.77 倍的一次性压缩开销。项目网页：https://ahsanbilal7.github.io/train_free_kv/

    Self-Retrospection Distillation: Turning Post-hoc Experiences into Prior Foresight

    自我回溯蒸馏：将事后经验转化为事前预见

    Haoxiang Zhang, Qinglin Chen, Hiroaki Hayashi, Zhuofeng Li, Siming Zhang, Jiaxin Zhang, Jixuan Chen, Fang Wu, Pan Lu, Silvio Savarese, Julian McAuley, Chien-Sheng Wu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SRD uses completed trajectories to train the same policy’s pre-action foresight, improving learning when reward signals are uninformative; this gives substantial insight into training reasoning and long-horizon agents. Its mention of predictive representations does not establish a mechanistic account of internal representations, and it does not focus on compositional generalization.

    SRD 利用已完成的轨迹训练同一策略的行动前预见能力，在奖励信号缺乏信息时改善学习；这为推理和长时程智能体的训练提供了重要见解。文中提到预测性表征，但并未建立关于内部表征的机制性解释，也不以组合泛化为重点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) turns agent experience into learning signals primarily through scalar outcome rewards after interaction. For group-relative objectives, however, this signal vanishes when all rollouts receive the same reward, even though their trajectories may reveal useful information about what the task requires and how the agent fails. We ask a complementary question: can hindsight teach an agent what it could have anticipated before acting? We introduce prospective learning, which uses post-hoc experience to supervise foresight predictions from the pre-interaction view, and instantiate it with Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD). Intuitively, a completed trajectory reveals knowledge that would have been useful and pitfalls that should be avoided; SRD distills this privileged hindsight into trajectory-blind foresight of the same policy. Foresight serves only as a training target and need not be explicitly generated at inference time. Across 10 tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks, SRD complements RLVR and self-distillation baselines with gains of up to 24.2 pp. Its advantage is especially pronounced when reward contrast is scarce: when 37--98% of rollout groups are reward-uniform across model scales, yet SRD can still exploit learning signal from sampled trajectories. In the 2B setting, where 98% of groups are all-failure, the RLVR training ends up at 0.0% success, while adding SRD reaches 60.6% under the same rollout budget. Our results suggest that post-hoc agent experience is useful not only for evaluating or improving behavior, but also for shaping predictive representations before available interaction. Training code can be found at https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/SRD.

    中文

    带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）主要通过交互后的标量结果奖励，将智能体经验转化为学习信号。然而，对于组相对目标，当所有 rollout 获得相同奖励时，这种信号便会消失，尽管它们的轨迹可能揭示任务要求以及智能体失败方式的有用信息。我们提出一个互补的问题：事后回顾能否教会智能体在行动前本可以预见什么？我们提出前瞻式学习，利用事后经验从交互前视角监督预见预测，并以自我回溯蒸馏（SRD）加以实现。直观而言，一条已完成的轨迹会揭示哪些知识原本有用、哪些陷阱应当避开；SRD 将这种特权式事后信息蒸馏为同一策略不依赖轨迹的预见能力。预见仅作为训练目标，在推理时不必显式生成。在 10 项集成工具的推理和长时程智能体任务中，SRD 对 RLVR 和自蒸馏基线形成补充，带来最高 24.2 个百分点的提升。当奖励差异稀少时，其优势尤为明显：在不同模型规模下，37--98% 的 rollout 组内奖励相同，但 SRD 仍能利用采样轨迹中的学习信号。在 2B 设置下，98% 的组全部失败，RLVR 训练最终成功率为 0.0%；在相同 rollout 预算下加入 SRD 后，成功率达到 60.6%。我们的结果表明，事后智能体经验不仅有助于评估或改进行为，也能在交互可用之前塑造预测性表征。训练代码见 https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/SRD。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SkillForge co-evolves an agent's skill memory and policy through skill evaluation, retirement, and mutation, advancing agent memory management and long-horizon task execution. Skill reuse and mutation have a compositional connection, but the abstract does not establish a main contribution to compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    SkillForge 通过评估、退役和变异技能，使智能体的技能记忆与策略共同演进，从而推动了智能体记忆管理和长时程任务执行。技能复用与变异和组合性有关，但摘要并未表明组合泛化或推理机制是其主要贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Memory-augmented reinforcement learning strengthens LLM agents' ability to solve complex long-horizon tasks. Skills are one such form of memory, pairing instructions with an applicability condition over task types. However, retaining every skill indiscriminately as the policy improves lets obsolete or harmful entries accumulate and mislead the agent. We propose SkillForge, an agentic RL method that compiles and evolves the skill library through a fitness-driven skill lifecycle of trial, active, stable, and retired states, so that the skills and the model co-evolve throughout training. A pre-RL evaluation phase first uses the base model's own rollouts to pre-retire low-fitness skills, yielding a filtered library that then seeds supervised fine-tuning. Reinforcement learning takes over from this checkpoint, and at each iteration selective retirement, stabilization, and LLM-guided mutation continue to forge the skill library alongside policy optimization. Across multiple interactive agent benchmarks, SkillForge achieves the highest aggregate success rate, delivering up to 7.8% relative improvement over the strongest baseline while keeping the skill library compact throughout training. We introduce SkillFurnace, a dataset of 5k+ annotated records bundling retirement-filtered SFT trajectories, evolved skill libraries with fitness annotations, and retirement events with human-annotated failure categories to support research on skill quality and lifecycle management.

    记忆增强型强化学习能提升 LLM 智能体解决复杂长时程任务的能力。技能是这类记忆的一种形式，它将指令与适用任务类型的条件配对。然而，随着策略不断改进，若不加区分地保留所有技能，过时或有害的条目就会不断累积并误导智能体。我们提出 SkillForge，这是一种智能体强化学习方法，通过由适应度驱动、包含试用、活跃、稳定和退役状态的技能生命周期，对技能库进行编整和演化，使技能与模型在整个训练过程中共同演进。强化学习前的评估阶段首先利用基础模型自身的 rollout，将适应度较低的技能提前退役，生成筛选后的技能库，并以此作为监督微调的初始数据。随后，强化学习从该检查点接手；在每次迭代中，通过选择性退役、稳定化和 LLM 引导的变异，技能库会随着策略优化持续演进。在多个交互式智能体基准上，SkillForge 的总体成功率最高；相较于最强基线，提升幅度最高达 7.8%，同时在整个训练过程中保持技能库精简。我们推出 SkillFurnace，这是一个包含 5k+ 条标注记录的数据集，汇集了经过退役筛选的 SFT 轨迹、带有适应度标注的演化技能库，以及附有人工标注失败类别的退役事件，以支持对技能质量和生命周期管理的研究。

    Min-Young Yu, Tony Kim, Jang Won Choi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    NOMOS compiles policies into statically checked, deterministic gates for agent tool calls, with evaluations of safety and task success. This is a substantial agent-system contribution; reasoning is only incidental because the gate constrains actions without advancing how models reason.

    NOMOS 将策略编译为经过静态检查的确定性门控，以限制智能体的工具调用，并评估其安全性和任务成功率。这是对智能体系统的重要贡献；推理只是附带方面，因为该门控约束的是动作，并未推进模型的推理方式。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tool-using LLM agents violate the policies they are deployed to enforce, often silently. Prior defenses hand-write rules, query an LLM verifier per action, or compile policies through heavyweight formal machinery. Naive compilation fails: extracted rules block the tool satisfying their own precondition, or read arguments their tool lacks. NOMOS, a four-pass compiler, turns a natural-language policy into a deterministic tool-call gate; static verification with tool-schema-level checks alone (no prover, solver, or LLM) repairs or rejects 37% (airline) and 13% (retail) of candidates, without which most shipped rules are inoperable. Replaying compiled rules over undefended transcripts flags bindings that refuse legitimate work (a development binding refused 95.9% of task-passing calls); no evaluation binding is flagged. On $\tau^2$-bench the gate cuts violations of reference-encoded clauses among state-changing calls from 66.3% to 2.6% (airline) and 30.8% to 6.9% (retail), raising airline task success significantly for $2 \le k \le 4$; a 26B on-premise compilation is not significantly worse than hand-written or frontier-compiled rules. Unlike AgentDojo's shipped defenses, it reaches a zero attack success rate (ASR) on banking, where nine attack families collapse onto three structural rules. On the other three suites its ASR is at most 3.6%, from goals with no tool call to govern and one write admitted by a binding weaker than its clause; a second agent model, Llama-3.3-70B, reproduces the effect on both benchmarks. Decisions take microseconds without an LLM call, at a domain-dependent benign-utility cost; compilation runs on-premise on open-weight gemma-4-26B.

    Text-to-SQL models are commonly trained to map questions directly to static queries, whereas real-world database agents operate through stateful, multi-turn interaction with live databases -- inspecting schemas, executing probe queries, diagnosing errors, and revising hypotheses. This creates a critical train-deploy mismatch, as the execution harness that mediates this interaction is introduced only at inference time.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    Self-supervised multimodal representation learning has achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet capturing synergistic information remains challenging due to the complexity of cross-modal interactions. Unlike the shared information across individual modalities, synergy arises when task-relevant signals emerge only from the joint configuration of multiple modalities and cannot be recovered from any modality in isolation. This work focuses on how to preserve the information capacity for such synergistic signals in multimodal representations. The key observation is that synergistic information is reflected in higher-order statistical dependence among modalities, which provides a principled target for explicitly modeling joint interactions. Motivated by this insight, we propose Higher-order Representation and Information Learning (HRIL), which constructs an empirical cross-moment tensor over modality embeddings to represent multi-way interactions. HRIL employs Tucker decomposition to obtain a core tensor, complemented by a synergy-aware regularizer that prevents energy concentration and preserves higher-order coupling capacity for synergistic information capture. Experiments on the controlled synergy task and real-world benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing multimodal contrastive methods, with notable gains on tasks dominated by synergistic interactions. We interpret these rotations as underdamped second-order dynamics, providing a framework for investigating the role of oscillation in sequence modeling. Controlled comparisons show that underdamped dynamics outperform non-oscillatory damping regimes on state-tracking tasks, while language-model pretraining demonstrates benefits for long-context prediction and length generalization. Interventions in pretrained models further establish the importance of learned phase, and state analysis suggests that rotation regulates how retained information combines with incoming updates.     ENGLISH

    Reconstructing accurate camera poses and floor-plan layouts from sparse, unposed, wide-baseline RGB panoramas remains a challenging open problem. Direct multi-room floor-plan prediction is especially difficult in this setting: pose, geometry, semantics, and global layout structure are tightly coupled, yet a complete floor-plan is hard to learn as a single global output. Our key insight is to keep the model's predictions strictly local. Multi-view Ordered Wall Instance Segmentation (MOIS) is designed around this concept. Each panorama column predicts only the wall it observes plus the next two adjacent walls in clockwise order. The global wall partition, room layouts, and shared coordinates emerge from deterministic aggregation of overlapping local predictions. Building on MOIS, we propose Multi-view floor-plan Feed-Forward Network (MvFFN), which jointly predicts coarse camera poses, dense global geometry, and per-wall semantic outputs. A downstream Layout Chaining (LC) post processing pipeline then assembles these predictions into multi-room floor-plans with shared global coordinates, consistent wall identities, and connected room structure. The dense MOIS predictions recover cross-view wall identity and local within-room connectivity more accurately than composed modular baselines, and the assembled layouts substantially outperform prior methods on wall and junction level accuracy. We also introduce the ZInD-CrossView dataset, which augments ZInD with globally unique wall instances and cross-view segmentation labels for this task.

Using this benchmark, we conduct a large-scale zero-shot evaluation of 17 language models spanning closed model families and deployment-oriented open-weight models from 1.7B to 14B parameters, each judged independently by five strong LLM judges, plus a deterministic rule-based evaluator that checks tool coverage, hallucinated tool use, and unsupported claims. We present a self-defining operator (SDO) that improves with time by updating its operational behavior and memory. When SDO resolves an incident, it distills that experience into playbooks, which describe reusable diagnostic instructions for future incidents with similar faults, and detectors, scripts that take application telemetry as input and output relevant playbook(s). SDO continuously runs the detectors and invokes LLMs only when one fires, so its token cost scales with incident count rather than with operational time. SDO is open source at https://github.com/self-defining-systems/sdo.

    Xuyao Feng and Antonis Bikakis

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The main contribution is a trainable proposition-level linker that learns latent relations from sentence-level labels to improve neuro-symbolic NLI and downstream SAT reasoning. It substantially addresses compositional inference and reasoning; the fixed translator and reasoner make systems design incidental.

    本文的主要贡献是一个可训练的命题级链接器，它从句子级标签中学习潜在关系，以改进神经符号 NLI 和下游 SAT 推理。它实质性地涉及组合推断和推理；由于翻译器和推理器保持固定，系统设计只是附带内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We study neuro-symbolic natural language inference (NLI) with independently translated propositional representations of the premise and hypothesis. Before symbolic reasoning, the system must infer semantic links between their proposition-level units (atoms). Existing systems based on Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) and Boolean satisfiability (SAT) identify these links using fixed embedding-based source selection and pretrained sentence-level NLI models not trained for atom-level linking. We introduce a trainable atom linker that jointly predicts link existence, source selection, and relation type. Without atom-pair training annotations, we treat cross-formula link structures as latent and train the linker from sentence-level NLI labels, keeping the translator and SAT reasoner fixed. We evaluate on the full public test splits of Stanford Natural Language Inference (SNLI) and Sentences Involving Compositional Knowledge (SICK), and the matched and mismatched validation splits of Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference (MNLI). Our system improves accuracy by 11.40-27.09 percentage points over a baseline applying sentence-trained NLI models unchanged to atom pairs within the same SAT pipeline. It also improves over the prior fixed-linker AMR-to-SAT system by 8.14-26.32 percentage points on SNLI and both MNLI splits, with a smaller gain on SICK.

    中文

    我们研究神经符号自然语言推理（NLI），其中前提和假设分别被独立转换为命题表示。在进行符号推理之前，系统必须推断二者命题级单元（原子）之间的语义链接。现有基于抽象意义表示（AMR）和布尔可满足性（SAT）的系统，使用基于固定嵌入的源选择，以及并非针对原子级链接训练的预训练句子级 NLI 模型来识别这些链接。我们提出一个可训练的原子链接器，联合预测链接是否存在、源选择和关系类型。由于没有原子对训练标注，我们将跨公式链接结构视为潜变量，并使用句子级 NLI 标签训练链接器，同时固定翻译器和 SAT 推理器。我们在斯坦福自然语言推理（SNLI）和包含组合知识的句子（SICK）的全部公开测试划分上，以及多体裁自然语言推理（MNLI）的匹配和不匹配验证划分上进行评估。与在同一 SAT 流程中将句子级训练的 NLI 模型原样应用于原子对的基线相比，我们的系统准确率提升了 11.40-27.09 个百分点。与先前采用固定链接器的 AMR-to-SAT 系统相比，我们在 SNLI 和两个 MNLI 划分上也提升了 8.14-26.32 个百分点，在 SICK 上的提升则较小。

    SuperAI: Merging Capabilities Across Heterogeneous Foundation Models

    SuperAI：融合异构基础模型的能力

    Jingtong Dou, Chuancheng Shi, Wenhua Wu, Wei Bao, Fei Shen, Zhiyong Wang and Tat-Seng Chua

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SuperAI aligns task-relevant representation subspaces across heterogeneous models and learns input-dependent residuals to combine their capabilities, advancing representation geometry, composition, and model architecture. Its relevance to reasoning is incidental because capability fusion is evaluated broadly, without a specific reasoning mechanism.

    SuperAI 对齐异构模型中与任务相关的表示子空间，并学习依赖输入的残差来组合模型能力，从而推进表示几何、组合和模型架构方面的研究。它与推理的关联只是附带内容，因为能力融合是在广泛领域中评估的，并未针对特定推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Enabling the reuse and composition of knowledge and capabilities distributed across foundation models is an important step toward building scalable artificial intelligence (AI) systems. However, architectural differences and incompatible representations make it difficult to transfer and integrate these capabilities through a unified cross-model interface. To address this challenge, we propose SuperAI, a cross-architecture multi-model fusion framework that integrates complementary capabilities from multiple source models into a host model through orthogonal alignment of low-dimensional task-relevant representations. Specifically, we first extract task-relevant representations from the source models and the host model using shared anchor samples, and apply principal component analysis (PCA) to construct low-dimensional functional subspaces with the same dimensionality. Next, we use orthogonal Procrustes mappings to align the source and host coordinate systems, establishing cross-model correspondences while preserving the internal geometry of each source subspace. Finally, we train a lightweight residual multilayer perceptron (MLP) with joint supervision on task outputs and source-model increments, learning input-dependent residual increments that are injected into the host model for multi-model capability fusion. Experiments on three host models across 15 capability domains show that SuperAI achieves higher average domain scores than the evaluated cross-architecture fusion methods and better preserves general capabilities as the number of source models increases. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of orthogonal alignment, nonlinear residual mapping, and joint supervision.

    中文

    让分布在不同基础模型中的知识和能力得以复用和组合，是构建可扩展人工智能（AI）系统的重要一步。然而，架构差异和不兼容的表示使得难以通过统一的跨模型接口迁移和整合这些能力。为此，我们提出 SuperAI，一种跨架构多模型融合框架，通过对低维任务相关表示进行正交对齐，将多个源模型的互补能力整合到一个宿主模型中。具体而言，我们首先利用共享锚点样本，从源模型和宿主模型中提取任务相关表示，并应用主成分分析（PCA）构建维度相同的低维功能子空间。接下来，我们使用正交 Procrustes 映射对齐源模型和宿主模型的坐标系，在保留每个源子空间内部几何结构的同时建立跨模型对应关系。最后，我们通过对任务输出和源模型增量进行联合监督，训练一个轻量级残差多层感知机（MLP），学习依赖输入的残差增量，并将其注入宿主模型以实现多模型能力融合。在三个宿主模型和 15 个能力领域上的实验表明，与评估过的跨架构融合方法相比，SuperAI 的领域平均得分更高；随着源模型数量增加，它也能更好地保留通用能力。消融研究进一步支持正交对齐、非线性残差映射和联合监督的有效性。

    Agent-Canary-Mas: End-to-End Evaluation of Protocol Risk in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems

    Agent-Canary-Mas：长时程多智能体系统中协议风险的端到端评估

    Xiuming Liu, Le Gai, Zhiyuan Chang, Peiyang Li, Bin Zhu, Shuo Wang, Chao Feng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Agent-Canary-Mas evaluates how protocol attacks propagate through long-horizon, tool-using multi-agent tasks and tests a handoff guard, contributing a risk measurement and defense framework for agent systems. Its task decisions and coordination are incidental to the focus on protocol risk, with no substantive contribution to reasoning mechanisms.

    Agent-Canary-Mas 评估协议攻击如何在长时程、使用工具的多智能体任务中传播，并测试交接防护机制，为智能体系统贡献了风险测量和防御框架。任务决策和协调与其关注的协议风险只是附带关系，对推理机制没有实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agent-to-agent protocols allow LLM agents to discover peers, exchange results, and coordinate tool use. A locally successful protocol attack, however, may be rejected by a later agent or propagated into a consequential task decision. Measuring local exploitability alone leaves this difference unresolved and provides limited evidence about which participant caused the final outcome. We present Agent-Canary-Mas, an end-to-end evaluation system that follows protocol risk through long-horizon multi-agent tasks. It covers five risk classes and 13 subclasses across A2A, ANP, and BCS, with 975 matched malicious--benign task pairs in five business domains. A shared OpenClaw framework runs autonomous, tool-using agents under different underlying models while preserving the task and execution setup. Matched runs separate local protocol success from downstream consequences; retained evidence connects participant selection, message consumption, tool activity, and task-state changes. We further evaluate a protocol-context Guard that checks an object's authority at consequential handoffs. Across three model conditions, local attack success is frequently at or above 90%, while consequence conversion ranges from 7.1% to 100.0%. Cross-agent evidence raises macro-averaged Audit-F1 from 29.7% to 95.5%. On Finance tasks, the Guard lowers average ASR from 86.1% to 53.8% and PTCR from 65.5% to 31.2%, with a measurable completion tradeoff. These results show that protocol risk depends on how agents use exchanged objects throughout the task, and that evaluating this path supports more informative risk assessment, attribution, and defense.

    中文

    智能体间协议允许 LLM 智能体发现同伴、交换结果并协调工具使用。然而，一次在局部成功的协议攻击可能会被后续智能体拒绝，也可能传播到会影响重大后果的任务决策中。仅测量局部可利用性无法厘清这一差异，也难以确定最终结果由哪个参与者导致。我们提出 Agent-Canary-Mas，这是一个端到端评估系统，用于追踪长时程多智能体任务中的协议风险。它涵盖 A2A、ANP 和 BCS 中的五类风险及 13 个子类，并包含五个业务领域中的 975 对匹配的恶意与良性任务。一个共享的 OpenClaw 框架在保留任务和执行设置的同时，运行由不同底层模型驱动的自主工具使用型智能体。匹配运行将局部协议攻击成功与下游后果区分开来；保留的证据将参与者选择、消息使用、工具活动和任务状态变化联系起来。我们还评估了一个协议上下文 Guard，它会在产生重大后果的交接环节检查对象的权限。对于三种模型条件，局部攻击成功率往往达到或超过 90%，而后果转化率介于 7.1% 到 100.0% 之间。跨智能体证据将宏平均 Audit-F1 从 29.7% 提高到 95.5%。在 Finance 任务中，Guard 将平均 ASR 从 86.1% 降至 53.8%，并将 PTCR 从 65.5% 降至 31.2%，同时带来可测量的任务完成率损失。这些结果表明，协议风险取决于智能体在整个任务过程中如何使用交换的对象；评估这条传播路径有助于更有信息量地开展风险评估、归因和防御。

    Who Sets the Pace of Judge Hacking? Judge Capability versus the Policy-Judge Gap

    谁决定评审者攻击的速度？评审者能力与策略—评审者差距

    Haosen Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study compares judge capability and policy–judge gaps in GRPO judge hacking, finding that judge quality tracks hacking depth while evidence about its pace is inconclusive. It substantially examines RL training and evaluation of mathematical problem-solving, but does not analyze internal model mechanisms or system design.

    这项研究比较了在 GRPO 评审者攻击中评审者能力与策略—评审者差距的作用，发现评审者质量与攻击深度相关，而关于攻击速度的证据尚无定论。它对强化学习训练和数学问题求解评估进行了深入研究，但未分析模型内部机制或系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Under GRPO against a frozen, reference-free LLM judge, RL exploits the judge's false positives. Does the policy-judge capability gap or the judge itself set how fast and how far? We train 0.5B and 1.5B Qwen2.5 policies on GSM8K against four judges at least as large, and the 1.5B policy also against one smaller judge. In a post-hoc analysis, judge acceptance rose, but no cell of 12 gained more than 0.04 in seed-mean held-out greedy accuracy. A gold-reward control with the same recipe raised the 1.5B policy's accuracy by +0.054 (for the 0.5B policy, gold reward gave no detectable gain either). The depth of judge hacking tracks the judge: the plateau correlates with judge AUC (Spearman -0.69 over 12 cells), and within a family the larger judge is fooled less deeply. For the pace, two pre-specified pairs contradict the gap account: the cell with the larger gap was fooled 3.5x sooner at the pre-specified threshold. With 12 cells, however, we cannot formally separate judge AUC from the gap for either endpoint. A blind test of step-0 predictors on three held-out judges was inconclusive. At 7-8B, judges from three families plateaued between 0.37 and 0.85.

    中文

    在针对一个冻结的、无需参考答案的 LLM 评审者进行 GRPO 时，强化学习会利用评审者的假阳性。决定攻击推进速度和深度的是策略与评审者的能力差距，还是评审者本身？我们让 0.5B 和 1.5B 的 Qwen2.5 策略在 GSM8K 上分别针对四个参数量至少相同的评审者进行训练；此外，1.5B 策略还针对一个更小的评审者训练。在事后分析中，评审者的接受率有所上升，但 12 个实验单元中，没有一个的种子平均留出集贪心准确率提升超过 0.04。采用相同方案的真实奖励对照组使 1.5B 策略准确率提高了 +0.054（对于 0.5B 策略，真实奖励也没有带来可检测的提升）。评审者攻击的深度与评审者有关：平台期表现与评审者 AUC 相关（12 个实验单元上的 Spearman 相关系数为 -0.69）；在同一系列内，较大的评审者不容易被愚弄到那么深。至于攻击速度，两个预先指定的配对实验与“差距决定论”相矛盾：能力差距更大的实验单元在达到预先指定阈值时，反而早了 3.5 倍被愚弄。可是，基于 12 个实验单元，我们无法正式区分 AUC 和能力差距对任一结果的影响。在三个留出评审者上的第 0 步预测盲测结果并不明确。在 7-8B 规模下，来自三个系列的评审者平台期介于 0.37 到 0.85 之间。

    Beyond Perfect Teammates: Multi-Agent Collaboration with Unreliable Colleagues

    超越完美队友：与不可靠同事开展多智能体协作

    Chen Huang, Yiyang Zhang, Yuhao Wu, Yang Deng, Wenxuan Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    UnCoBench measures how agents diagnose and recover from unreliable evidence, and its trace analysis identifies missed follow-ups, waiting, and redundant queries. This offers a substantial benchmark and behavioral analysis of multi-agent coordination, while reasoning is part of task solving and the abstract does not establish compositional generalization.

    UnCoBench 衡量智能体诊断并从不可靠证据中恢复的能力，其轨迹分析还指出了遗漏后续追问、等待和重复查询等问题。该工作为多智能体协调提供了有实质内容的基准和行为分析；推理是任务解决过程的一部分，但摘要没有证明存在组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM-based multi-agent collaboration is increasingly used to solve complex tasks by dividing work among specialized agents and integrating complementary expertise. Yet existing systems and evaluations largely rest on an implicit perfect-colleague assumption: collaborators provide correct and complete information and respond promptly to requests. In realistic teamwork, however, collaborators may return information that does not answer the intended question, provide insufficient detail to support a decision, or fail to respond to a request. To separate task-solving competence from the ability to recover an unreliable evidence-gathering process, we introduce the Unreliable Colleagues Benchmark (UnCoBench), which organizes behavioral failures through Misaligned, Incomplete, and Missed settings. The main agent need to verify contextual correctness, diagnose information gap and track unresolved dependencies in order to obtain the correct evidence for solving the task. We also introduce a verifiable and scalable automated generation pipeline that pairs LLM-based scenario generation with executable checks of answer uniqueness and role necessity. Results across ten models show that similar reliable-setting performance can result in different robustness to unreliable evidence. Trace analysis reveals frequent omissions of corrective follow-up, and the recovery behavior involves inefficient waiting and redundant queries. These findings show that robust collaboration requires not only sound reasoning, but also targeted action to diagnose evidence failures, recover relevant information, and integrate it into decisions. Our data and source code are available at https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/UnCoBench.

    中文

    基于 LLM 的多智能体协作日益广泛地用于解决复杂任务：它将工作分配给专门化的智能体，并整合互补的专业知识。然而，现有系统和评估大多依赖一种隐含的“完美同事”假设：协作者提供正确、完整的信息，并及时响应请求。但在真实的团队协作中，协作者可能返回答非所问的信息、提供不足以支持决策的细节，或未能回应请求。为将任务解决能力与从不可靠的信息收集过程中恢复的能力区分开来，我们提出不可靠同事基准（Unreliable Colleagues Benchmark，UnCoBench），通过 Misaligned（错位）、Incomplete（不完整）和 Missed（遗漏）三种设置对行为失误进行分类。主智能体需要核实上下文是否正确、诊断信息缺口并追踪尚未解决的依赖关系，才能获得解决任务所需的正确证据。我们还提出一套可验证且可扩展的自动生成流程，将基于 LLM 的情景生成与答案唯一性和角色必要性的可执行检查相结合。对十种模型的结果表明，在可靠情境下表现相近的模型，对不可靠证据的稳健性可能不同。轨迹分析发现，智能体经常遗漏纠正性追问，其恢复行为还包括低效等待和重复查询。这些发现表明，稳健协作不仅需要可靠推理，还需要有针对性的行动来诊断证据失效、找回相关信息并将其纳入决策。我们的数据和源代码见 https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/UnCoBench。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    REVEAL derives target-specific steering directions from activation contrasts in replayed agent trajectories, with representation analyses supporting this training-free control method. This substantially advances representation-based intervention and agent control, while improved task accuracy is evidence about capability rather than a direct study of reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    REVEAL 从重放的智能体轨迹中的激活差异推导出针对目标模型的引导方向，表征分析则为这种免训练控制方法提供了支持。该工作显著推进了基于表征的干预和智能体控制；不过，任务准确率的提升体现的是能力，而非对推理机制或组合泛化的直接研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Frontier LLM agents perform complex interactive tasks, but their inference costs motivate transferring their experience to smaller open-source agents. Distillation and latent communication typically require target-model training or access to source-model internals. We study how textual frontier-model trajectories can provide reusable local controls for a frozen agent. Inspired by protocol reverse engineering, we introduce $\textit{Agentic Latents}$, comprising anchored states and dynamic profiles of feedback--response cycles elicited by replay in the target model. Our training-free framework, $\textbf{REVEAL}$ ($\textbf{REV}$erse $\textbf{E}$ngineering $\textbf{A}$gentic $\textbf{L}$atents), uses these profiles and trajectory outcomes to match and select local events from successful and failed rollouts of the same task and source model. Their response-transition contrasts yield a target-specific steering direction, applied before each response. Within-benchmark evaluations on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and Humanity's Last Exam with tools report higher accuracy than unmodified agents across three targets. Representation analyses and behavioral case studies support reusing frontier-model experience as local activation control.

    中文

    前沿 LLM 智能体能够执行复杂的交互式任务，但其推理成本促使人们将它们的经验迁移给更小的开源智能体。蒸馏和潜在通信通常需要训练目标模型，或访问源模型的内部信息。我们研究如何利用前沿模型的文本轨迹，为冻结智能体提供可复用的局部控制。受协议逆向工程启发，我们提出 $\textit{Agentic Latents}$，它由锚定状态和动态剖面组成；这些剖面是通过在目标模型中重放而诱发的反馈—响应循环。我们的免训练框架 $\textbf{REVEAL}$（$\textbf{REV}$逆向$\textbf{E}$工程$\textbf{A}$智能体$\textbf{L}$潜变量），利用这些剖面和轨迹结果，在同一任务和源模型的成功与失败运行轨迹中匹配并选择局部事件。它们在响应转换上的差异可得出针对目标模型的引导方向，并在每次响应前应用。针对 Terminal-Bench 2.1 和带工具的 Humanity's Last Exam 进行的基准内评估显示，在三个目标模型上，该方法的准确率均高于未经修改的智能体。表征分析和行为案例研究支持将前沿模型的经验复用为局部激活控制。

    本文评估智能体自主解决研究级物理问题的能力，衡量问题解决准确率、工具使用情况以及对记忆文献的依赖程度。这是一项有实质内容的推理能力评估；智能体工具属于测试设置的一部分，而非智能体系统设计方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We present a suite of 50 unpublished research-level theoretical physics problems with verifiable answers. Without AI assistance, a typical problem in our collection could be solved by a world expert in about a day or less but would take considerably longer for experts in adjacent specialties. We test the ability of off-the-shelf AI agents to tackle these problems autonomously, without human hints. When given access to tools available in a realistic setting, including the ability to search the literature and write scripts for numerical and symbolic work, the best-performing agent, GPT-6-Astra harnessed in Codex, obtains the final answers with a near-perfect accuracy of 98% at an average cost under USD 3 per problem. On average, agents show only small changes in accuracy when denied web search and access to background research papers, suggesting significant memorization of the literature. These results suggest that state-of-the-art agents can accurately perform concrete calculations required across theoretical physics research. We comment on the broader implications of these findings and discuss possible explanations for the current lack of agent-led breakthroughs in theoretical physics despite their outstanding problem-solving abilities.

    For repository-grounded coding agents, a functionally correct patch is not necessarily an acceptable one: developers also constrain how the task must be carried out-modification scope, workflow order, validation, tool use, and reporting. This capability, which we call engineering constraint following, remains largely invisible to current evaluations. We introduce ANCHOR (Assessing Naturalistic Constraint Hierarchies and Ordering in Repository-Grounded Agentic Coding), a benchmark built on naturalistic, multilingual repository tasks spanning eight language groups. Across 19 agent configurations spanning 2 scaffolds and 10 foundation models on 358 tasks, the strongest measured system, Claude Opus 4.8 under Cline, reaches 70.1% atomic compliance and 63.7% relation compliance, while 19.0% of tasks pass every scored checklist item under the strict all-item FCCR criterion. A five-engineer audit of constraints from 50 instances reports 94% feasibility, 94% repository consistency, and 96% realism. In the primary paired set (14 configurations), the mean signed change in task completion after adding constraints is +0.7 percentage points; individual changes vary in both directions. These results distinguish functional success from constraint compliance, with failures concentrated in workflow ordering, tool-use discipline, and reporting, and substantial interactions between models and scaffolds.
