    Learning to Design Convex Relaxations for Nonconvex Optimization

    学习为非凸优化设计凸松弛

    Jinrun Liu, Bai Yan, Tengfei Liu, Qunfeng Liu, Jian Yang, Shi Cheng, Yuhui Shi, Qi Zhao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AutoConvexRelax learns policies that compose symbolic rewrites into valid, problem-specific convex relaxations, with formal validity conditions and optimization results. This substantially advances structured composition and algorithmic problem solving, while the abstract gives no evidence about model internals or agent system design.

    AutoConvexRelax 学习将符号重写组合起来的策略，从而生成有效且针对具体问题的凸松弛，并提供形式化有效性条件和优化结果。该工作显著推进了结构化组合和算法问题求解；摘要没有提供模型内部机制或智能体系统设计方面的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Convex relaxations make nonconvex optimization tractable by replacing hard nonconvex problems with convex surrogates that give valid bounds. Yet their design is still largely manual: a human expert must decide where to relax, which relaxation to use, and how much formulation growth is worth paying. We show that this design process can be learned. The method proposed in this paper, AutoConvexRelax, represents the symbolic formulation of a nonconvex problem as a tripartite graph linking variables, symbolic terms, and their objective or constraint positions. It then learns a policy that composes symbolic rewrites into problem-specific relaxation trajectories as the formulation evolves. We prove that finite action sequences generated by the learned policy preserve relaxation validity under explicit domain, occurrence-context, and representation-consistency conditions. We further establish computable error bounds for mixed relaxations and sufficient conditions for feasible recovery and global-optimality certification. As a first instantiation, we apply the method to nonconvex quadratic problems and fractional problems. On 241 benchmark quadratic instances, the learned policy strengthens McCormick lower bounds by 13.52%. Its mean lower bound is 3.70% below strengthened semidefinite relaxations on the normalized comparison metric, while it uses substantially smaller formulations. The learned policy retains this trade-off on fractional instances and reaches near-semidefinite bounds on beamforming and sensor-network localization instances. These results suggest that convex relaxation design can move from a fixed handcrafted choice to an automated learning process that adapts to problem structures. Code is available at https://github.com/auto4opt/AutoConvexRelax.

    中文

    凸松弛通过用能给出有效界的凸代理问题替代难解的非凸问题，使非凸优化变得可处理。然而，凸松弛的设计仍主要依赖人工：人类专家必须决定在哪里进行松弛、采用哪种松弛，以及值得付出多少公式规模增长的代价。我们表明，这一设计过程可以通过学习实现。本文提出的方法 AutoConvexRelax 将非凸问题的符号形式表示为一个三部图，连接变量、符号项及其在目标函数或约束中的位置。随后，该方法学习一种策略，随着形式不断演变，将符号重写组合成针对具体问题的松弛轨迹。我们证明，在明确的定义域、出现上下文和表示一致性条件下，学习策略生成的有限动作序列能够保持松弛的有效性。我们还为混合松弛建立了可计算的误差界，并给出了可行解恢复和全局最优性认证的充分条件。作为首个实例，我们将该方法应用于非凸二次问题和分式问题。在 241 个基准二次问题实例上，学习到的策略将 McCormick 下界增强了 13.52%。按归一化比较指标衡量，其平均下界比增强后的半正定松弛低 3.70%，同时所用形式规模显著更小。在分式问题实例上，学习到的策略保持了这一权衡，并在波束成形和传感器网络定位实例上达到接近半正定松弛的界。这些结果表明，凸松弛设计可以从固定的手工选择转变为能适应问题结构的自动学习过程。代码见 https://github.com/auto4opt/AutoConvexRelax。

    ENGLISH

A frozen teacher that reads the rubric as privileged context provides token-level supervision, but we observe an early plateau in the gains over GRPO. RELAY uses advantages and rewards to select positive-advantage and low-scoring zero-advantage rollouts, and monitors the distillation loss to decide when to retire the teacher. Stage 1 combines selective distillation from a frozen teacher with GRPO; a plateau detector then removes the teacher, and Stage 2 continues with GRPO alone. Calibrated on one model-domain pair and reused unchanged in three others, the plateau detector fires between steps 122 and 171. Distilling selected rollouts covering about half the response tokens also outperforms distilling all rollouts at a matched average coefficient.

    ResearchFlow-Eval: Tracing the Execution Gap in End-to-End Multi-Claim Autoresearch

    ResearchFlow-Eval：追踪端到端多主张自动化研究中的执行差距

    Peng Jiang, Dongyang Li, Quanying Liu, Xiaoxuan Jia

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ResearchFlow-Eval measures whether autoresearch agents execute and revise multi-claim research workflows, finding that execution lags planning and repeated attempts rarely improve results. Multi-claim evaluation gives partial evidence about compositional capability and reasoning, while the central contribution is a transferable evaluation framework for agent workflows.

    ResearchFlow-Eval 衡量自动化研究智能体能否执行并修订多主张研究工作流程；研究发现，执行表现落后于规划，反复尝试也很少改善结果。多主张评估为组合能力和推理能力提供了部分证据，而其核心贡献是一个可迁移的智能体工作流程评估框架。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Autoresearch systems increasingly undertake entire research projects. In practice, scientific research requires systems to pursue multiple interdependent claims through a continuous, multi-stage workflow and revise experiments as evidence accumulates. Existing evaluations of autoresearch systems, however, typically score isolated tasks or final artifacts, leaving these process-level capabilities largely unmeasured. We therefore introduce ResearchFlow-Eval, a fine-grained framework for assessing continuous scientific execution and iteration at both the stage and claim levels. Each evaluation is grounded in a published anchor paper, from which we derive stage-specific rubrics that decompose each research stage into dimensions and separately scored rubric items. Using these rubrics, we score each research stage and examine experimental execution in detail, focusing on multi-claim completion and revisions across attempts. We apply the evaluation framework to general-purpose agent harnesses, skill-augmented harnesses, and systems with research-specific orchestration. Across all evaluated systems, experimental execution consistently lags behind design and planning. Within execution, systems struggle to produce high-quality results and meet claim requirements, and repeated attempts rarely yield measurable improvements. Moreover, neither skill augmentation nor research-specific orchestration reliably yields higher scores. ResearchFlow-Eval thus extends autoresearch evaluation beyond isolated, single-objective runs to continuous workflows in which systems pursue multiple claims and refine their work across iterations.

    中文

    自动化研究系统正越来越多地承担完整研究项目。实际上，科学研究要求系统通过连续的多阶段工作流程，推进多个相互依赖的主张，并随着证据累积而修改实验。然而，现有自动化研究系统的评估通常只对孤立任务或最终产物打分，导致这些过程层面的能力基本未被测量。因此，我们提出 ResearchFlow-Eval，这是一个细粒度框架，用于在阶段和主张两个层面评估连续的科学执行与迭代。每项评估都以一篇已发表论文为锚点，并据此制定各阶段专属的评分标准，将每个研究阶段分解为多个维度和分别计分的评分项目。我们使用这些评分标准对每个研究阶段打分，并详细考察实验执行情况，重点关注多主张的完成情况以及不同尝试之间的修订。我们将该评估框架应用于通用智能体运行框架、增强技能的运行框架，以及具有研究专用编排的系统。在所有受评系统中，实验执行的表现始终落后于设计和规划。在执行环节，系统难以产出高质量结果并满足主张要求，而反复尝试也鲜少带来可测量的改进。此外，技能增强和研究专用编排都无法稳定地带来更高分数。因此，ResearchFlow-Eval 将自动化研究评估从孤立的单目标运行扩展到连续工作流程，在这些流程中，系统需推进多个主张并通过多轮迭代完善工作。

    Qiuyu Ding, Heng-Da Xu, Changda Xia, Jiajun Shen, Zihao Guan, Zhengchen Yuan, Jianfang Zhang, Di Yang, Jiayi Tian, Yuting Xu, Fei Wang, Shiao Liu, Wei Zhang, Xiaolong Wu, Wenbin Tang, Zedong Chu, Mu Xu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ABot-ER combines embodied perception, planning, and execution, with adaptive data strategies and task-conditioned low-rank updates as its main contributions. This advances agent-system design, while reasoning is a substantial capability area but not the paper’s central mechanism; the abstract offers no direct interpretability or compositional-generalization contribution.

    ABot-ER 将具身感知、规划和执行结合起来，其主要贡献包括自适应数据策略和任务条件低秩更新。这推进了智能体系统设计；推理是重要的能力领域，但并非该论文的核心机制。摘要没有提供直接的可解释性或组合泛化贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We introduce ABot Embodied Reasoning (ABot-ER), a unified embodied reasoning foundation model that breaks the tension between breadth and depth in embodied reasoning. Embodied intelligence demands the joint mastery of perception, planning, and execution, yet reconciling generality with specialization across this spectrum remains an open challenge. Within a single unified model, ABot-ER commands specialist-level depth across all three competencies, spanning spatial, scene, and temporal reasoning in perception; long-horizon action organization in planning; and point grounding and affordance in execution. The Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine continuously adapts data strategies to the model's evolving capability state. The Task-Conditioned Adaptive Training Strategy uses task tokens to activate lightweight low-rank residuals over a shared backbone, separating updates from heterogeneous output formats while retaining shared embodied knowledge. Across a systematic evaluation on twelve benchmarks covering three core competencies and five capability dimensions, ABot-ER achieves state-of-the-art overall performance across perception, planning, and execution within a unified parametric framework, demonstrating that breadth and depth can coexist in unified embodied reasoning.

    Thinker-WM: A Unified World Model with Shared Multimodal Representations for Embodied Intelligence

    Thinker-WM：用于具身智能、具有共享多模态表征的统一世界模型

    Thinker Team Ubtech: (Alphabetical order) and Peng Gao, Jichao Jiao, Chen Liao, Daqin Luo, Yiming Ma, Baiyu Pan, Hailin Shi, Jiyuan Wang, Xiangming Xu, Xiongwei Zhao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Thinker-WM’s main contribution is a shared multimodal dynamics representation that jointly supports visual, geometric, and action modeling across embodied functions. This gives substantive evidence about shared representations and reusable cross-modal modeling, but the abstract does not establish mechanistic interpretability, systematic compositional generalization, or a reasoning mechanism.

    Thinker-WM 的主要贡献是构建共享的多模态动态表征，使其能够在具身功能中联合支持视觉、几何和动作建模。这为共享表征和可复用的跨模态建模提供了有实质内容的证据，但摘要没有证明其具有机制可解释性、系统性组合泛化或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.

    中文

    世界模型已成为具身 AI 的一种有前景的范式，但现有系统在建模模态和支持功能方面往往仍然割裂。具体而言，视觉动态、几何结构和可执行动作通常通过独立接口或下游模块耦合，而不是在共享动态模型中共同表示和演化。在本文中，我们提出 Thinker-WM，这是一种统一的多模态世界模型，通过共享的中间统一动态 Transformer 与模态专用的编码器和解码器，对 RGB、度量深度和机器人动作进行联合建模和生成。该模型在表征层面实现多模态统一：外观、几何和动作被转换为共同的动态表征，并由共享参数联合演化，同时保留各自不同的输出结构。同一参数化支持多种功能，包括视频—动作联合生成、世界预测、策略推断、动作条件生成、视频到动作生成以及逆向动态。为考察共享表征是否包含与动作相关的信息，我们提出一个轻量级运动探针；结果表明，冻结的视觉表征中包含可恢复的运动信息。Thinker-WM 使用异构语料训练，其中包括约 20K 小时的第一人称视频、10K 小时的真实机器人数据和 1K 小时的仿真数据；其中约 4K 小时的真实机器人数据带有对齐的深度监督。大量实验表明，该模型在具身世界模型评估中表现强劲。Thinker-WM 在 EWMBench、WorldOlympiad 和 WorldArena 上排名第一；对照研究进一步证明，动作条件输入、几何交互以及共享表征中的多功能训练都能带来益处。

    Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents

    轻装上阵，CarryOn：为长时程智能体构建面向对象的上下文

    Yuchen Lu, Julian McAuley, Lei Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CarryOn’s main contribution is a context runtime that maintains reusable task objects across long-horizon interaction folds, reducing token use while improving task performance. Reusable progress has a partial connection to composition, while its context and continuation architecture makes a substantial contribution to agent systems; the abstract does not describe internal model mechanisms or advance reasoning methods.

    CarryOn 的主要贡献是一种上下文运行时，它能在长时程交互折叠过程中维护可复用的任务对象，从而在提升任务性能的同时减少 token 使用量。可复用进展与组合性有一定联系，而其上下文和后续执行架构对智能体系统作出了实质性贡献；摘要没有描述模型内部机制或提出推理方法。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against bound evidence and applicable environment checks while carrying forward unaffected records and jointly updating execution context. Experiments on OSWorld 2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus show improved gains of 5.8% and 7.0% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, respectively. Project page: https://ethannju.github.io/carryon

    中文

    长时程智能体会在持久任务状态中累积进展，却仍反复处理描述这些进展如何实现的交互历史。这引出了一个自然的问题：长时程上下文能否围绕可复用的进展来组织，而不是围绕产生这些进展的历史来组织？本文介绍 CarryOn，这是一种面向对象的上下文运行时，它围绕可复用的任务对象组织后续执行。CarryOn 不把压缩后的历史或重建的进展记录作为后续执行的主要依据，而是根据后续执行载体、互补的执行上下文以及近期交互的实时尾段构建上下文视图。一个核心挑战是：周边历史被清除后，如何保持这一可复用依据有效？CarryOn 如何在每次折叠时无需重建完整表示就更新这一依据？CarryOn 在各次折叠之间维护载体记录，根据绑定证据和适用的环境检查修订受影响的记录，同时保留未受影响的记录并同步更新执行上下文。在 OSWorld 2.0 和 BrowseComp-Plus 上的实验分别显示，性能提升 5.8% 和 7.0%，同时总 token 使用量分别减少 51.9% 和 22.9%。项目页面：https://ethannju.github.io/carryon

    扰动预测器是否学会了基因相互作用？诊断智能体筛选中的外推

    Ziyuan Gao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper evaluates prediction of unseen gene combinations and introduces additive disagreement as a cross-dataset diagnostic of extrapolation error, giving a substantive evaluation signal for compositional generalization. Its agentic screening use is an application context, and the abstract does not describe broader agent-system or reasoning advances.

    本文评估对未见基因组合的预测，并提出加性分歧作为跨数据集的外推误差诊断指标，为组合泛化提供了有实质意义的评估信号。其在智能体式筛选中的应用属于应用场景；摘要没有描述更广泛的智能体系统或推理进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    High-throughput perturbation screens increasingly use machine-learning models to predict the effects of gene combinations that were never measured. A difficult case arises when both genes in a test pair were seen individually during training, but their combination was not. In this setting, standard OOD methods often fail because neither gene appears unfamiliar on its own. We therefore compare each model prediction with a simple additive prediction obtained by summing the two observed single-gene effects. The difference between them, which we call additive disagreement (AD), measures how much extra interaction effect the model introduces for an unseen combination. Across eight prediction methods and three Perturb-seq datasets, specialised neural predictors do not consistently outperform this simple additive baseline. More importantly, predictions with larger deviations from the additive baseline tend to have larger errors. Conventional output-based and embedding-based confidence signals are inconsistent across datasets and models, whereas AD remains informative across all evaluated compositional settings. We further study how this signal can guide decisions in an agentic perturbation-screening workflow. The code is available at https://github.com/zygao930/OOD.

    中文

    高通量扰动筛选越来越多地使用机器学习模型来预测从未测量过的基因组合的影响。当测试对中的两个基因在训练时都分别出现过，但它们的组合从未出现时，就会遇到一种棘手情况。在这种情形下，标准的分布外（OOD）方法往往会失效，因为两个基因单独来看都不陌生。因此，我们将每个模型的预测与一个简单的加性预测进行比较，后者通过求和两个已观测到的单基因效应得到。我们将两者之差称为加性分歧（AD），它衡量模型针对未见组合引入了多大的额外交互效应。在八种预测方法和三个 Perturb-seq 数据集上，专用神经预测器并未始终优于这一简单的加性基线。更重要的是，相对于加性基线偏差越大的预测，往往误差也越大。传统的基于输出和基于嵌入的置信度信号在不同数据集和模型间表现不一致，而 AD 在所有评估过的组合设置中都保持了信息价值。我们还进一步研究了如何在智能体式扰动筛选工作流程中利用这一信号指导决策。代码见 https://github.com/zygao930/OOD。

    The paper trains a voice agent to transfer a structured policy across unseen regulated procedures using a shared specification for instructions, tool gates, supervision, and tests. This substantially advances procedural transfer and agent design, while the task is rule following rather than a central study of general reasoning.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Voice agents built on large language models (LLMs) now handle customer calls, but in regulated applications completing the task is not enough: the agent must follow a conversational flow set by law. In debt collection, it must confirm it is speaking to the debtor before mentioning the debt, identify itself and the creditor, state the amount, and avoid prohibited language. Every creditor turns these rules into its own procedure and revises it. We ask whether a small, self-hosted policy can be trained once and then follow regulated procedures it has never seen. One machine-readable specification per deployment, FlowSpec, generates the policy instruction, gates the tools, supplies the supervision and defines the tests; the agent speaks only approved catalogue sentences. We fine-tune a 9-billion-parameter model on 2,506 conversations from 297 randomized procedures and evaluate a Thai outbound-call agent on four unseen deployment procedures (three debt collection, one non-debt), one from a wholly withheld lineage. Documented checks, fixed by the procedure, rise from 67--71 percents to 93--100 percents, while grounded checks, fixed by the conversation, already pass at 97--100 percents before training; scenario pass rate rises from 15/43 to 40/43. An audit of the shared specification finds 11 defects, 3 of which its own metric did not expose.

    中文

    基于大型语言模型（LLM）的语音智能体如今已能处理客户来电，但在受监管的应用中，仅完成任务还不够：智能体必须遵循法律规定的对话流程。在债务催收中，它必须先确认正在与债务人通话，然后才能提及债务；还必须说明自身和债权人的身份、告知金额，并避免使用违禁措辞。每个债权人都会将这些规则转化为自己的流程，并对其进行修订。我们探讨一个问题：能否只训练一次小型自托管策略，使其随后遵循从未见过的受监管流程？每个部署使用一份机器可读规范 FlowSpec，由其生成策略指令、限制工具调用、提供监督并定义测试；智能体只能说经批准的目录句子。我们在来自 297 种随机化流程的 2,506 段对话上微调一个 90 亿参数模型，并评估一个泰语外呼智能体在四种未见过的部署流程上的表现（三种债务催收流程、一种非债务流程），其中一种流程来自完全留出的流程谱系。由流程规定的文档检查项通过率从 67--71 percents 升至 93--100 percents；由对话规定的依据检查项在训练前的通过率已达 97--100 percents；情景通过率则从 15/43 升至 40/43。对共享规范的审计发现了 11 个缺陷，其中 3 个未被其自身指标揭示。

    Fengrui Fan, Huahao Wang, Jingyi Fang, Yutao Hu, Yueming Wu, Deqing Zou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ENGLISH

    LLM agent frameworks heavily rely on external skill assets to standardize tool usage, encode operational workflows, and supply executable runtime resources. Despite their widespread adoption, multi-component skill packages frequently suffer from cross-artifact inconsistencies, where documentation, scripts, and configuration files specify conflicting behavioral constraints. Although static auditing techniques can uncover such contractual discrepancies, static defect volume cannot reliably reflect real-world agent performance degradation. This gap leaves practitioners without rigorous evidence to assess the practical risk of flawed agent skills. This paper presents a systematic empirical study to demystify the runtime implications of skill inconsistencies. We conduct large-scale auditing over 575 community and benchmark skills, yielding 1,182 manually validated contract inconsistencies. We further build a controlled evaluation pipeline with 49 executable agent tasks and three representative LLMs across NoSkill, OriginalSkill, and FixedSkill experimental settings. Through fine-grained behavioral analysis of 441 paired execution trajectories, we quantify the actual performance impacts of resolved defects.

    智能体科学家：编排编码智能体以实现自动化科学发现与共同发现

    Robert Tjarko Lange, Luca Grillotti, Yutaro Yamada, Rujikorn Charakorn, David Ha

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a distributed pipeline that orchestrates coding agents through scientific research stages and reports that cross-agent orchestration supports autonomy. This advances agent system design; scientific problem-solving is relevant, but the abstract emphasizes orchestration rather than reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文介绍一套分布式流程，负责编排编码智能体完成科学研究的各个阶段，并报告跨智能体编排有助于实现自主性。这推动了智能体系统设计；科学问题求解与推理有关，但摘要强调的是编排，而非推理机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Modern coding agents are fundamentally reshaping the role of human input for computational research: they write code, launch in silico experiments, analyze their results, and autonomously operate with ever-increasing time horizons. Despite these developments, fully autonomous research agents suffer from a limited ideation radius and myopic hill-climbing search dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce The Agentic Scientist, an end-to-end distributed pipeline for human researchers to conduct computational research alongside modern coding agents. Building on its predecessor, our system decomposes research into task drafting, idea generation, planning, sandboxed experimentation, result aggregation, baseline and ablation construction, post-hoc analysis, and report writing. Importantly, each step in the pipeline is powered by the next generation of coding agents and leverages agentic self-verification. The overall research process is driven by a meta-controller that manages parallel research agents and enforces rubric verification at each stage. This design enables the same orchestration layer to be reused across heterogeneous domains with different execution environments, agentic coding harnesses, and evaluation metrics. Our system can be used across a spectrum of autonomy: either as a co-scientist tool or to perform end-to-end scientific investigation. Within the co-scientist setting, we leveraged a development version of our system to submit a single research paper, which got accepted for publication at ALIFE 2026. We further apply The Agentic Scientist fully autonomously to open problem-solving tasks in machine learning, and demonstrate the system's capability of scientific discovery across different domains of computational research. Our ablations suggest that reliable scientific autonomy depends not only on base model capabilities, but also on the cross-agent orchestration layer.

    中文

    现代编码智能体正在从根本上重塑计算研究中的人类参与方式：它们编写代码、启动计算机模拟实验、分析结果，并能自主运行越来越长的时间。尽管取得了这些进展，完全自主的研究智能体仍受限于构思范围狭窄和短视的爬山式搜索动态。为弥补这一不足，我们推出 The Agentic Scientist，这是一套端到端的分布式流程，帮助人类研究者与现代编码智能体共同开展计算研究。在前代系统的基础上，我们的系统将研究拆解为任务起草、创意生成、规划、沙箱实验、结果汇总、基线和消融构建、事后分析以及报告撰写。重要的是，流程中的每个步骤都由新一代编码智能体驱动，并利用智能体式自我验证。整体研究流程由一个元控制器驱动，它管理并行研究智能体，并在每个阶段强制执行评分标准验证。这种设计使同一编排层能够在不同领域重复使用，这些领域可具有不同的执行环境、智能体式编码工具框架和评估指标。我们的系统可用于不同程度的自主性：既可作为共同科学研究工具，也可用于端到端科学研究。在共同科学研究场景中，我们利用系统的开发版本提交了一篇研究论文，该论文被 ALIFE 2026 接收发表。我们还将 The Agentic Scientist 完全自主地应用于机器学习中的开放式问题解决任务，并展示了系统在不同计算研究领域开展科学发现的能力。我们的消融实验表明，可靠的科学自主性不仅取决于基础模型能力，也取决于跨智能体编排层。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives limits and monitoring guarantees for detecting adaptive adversaries in embodied and tool-use AI, supported by simulated and randomized trials. Its central contribution concerns agent safety and monitoring systems; the statistical analysis is not a direct study of model reasoning, and tool use alone does not raise other scores.

    本文推导了在具身 AI 和工具使用 AI 中检测自适应对手的局限和监测保证，并用模拟试验和随机化试验提供支持。其核心贡献涉及智能体安全与监测系统；统计分析并非直接研究模型推理，而仅仅使用工具本身也不足以提高其他评分。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Finite safety assessments cannot exclude an adversary that preserves unattacked behavior until certification and activates afterward. We characterize this limitation for embodied and tool-use AI. An adversary that matches the complete observation law until observable, irrevocable certification and retains intervention access afterward attains $v\mathbb{E}[(n-S_0)_+]$ expected post-certification events over $n$ trials, where $v$ is the active event probability and $S_0$ the unattacked certification time. The result covers adaptive and privately randomized evaluators. Switching at certification is exactly optimal for a fixed likelihood-ratio test under memoryless, event-increasing interventions without a binding intervention budget. A positive clean-certification requirement forces linear worst-case expected excess when intervention raises event rates over an authorized deployment horizon, even if certification is deferred to the deadline. In simulated RoCo collaboration, switching yields commanded-separation violations in 34 of 36 post-certification episodes. Preregistered randomized AgentDojo trials estimate 1.98 additional security violations per four-task continuation (95% interval [1.67, 2.29]). An adversarial language-model controller infers hidden certification from noisy evaluation receipts and times intervention accordingly. With permanent revocation, a mixture likelihood-ratio monitor bounds cumulative excess above a prespecified reference rate at square-root order, up to logarithmic factors, on every sample path. A single fixed alternative can permit linear expected excess under stationary attacks. Against a controller observing the monitor's rule and statistic, live mixture monitoring reduces violations from 12.00 to 3.81 per 24 assigned task opportunities. Revocation also reduces tasks executed.

    The paper develops a method to discover concepts encoded in diffusion LoRA adapters by searching for prompts aligned with their learned subspace, offering transferable insight into model representations.     本文开发了一种方法，通过搜索与扩散 LoRA 适配器所学子空间对齐的提示词，发现其中编码的概念，从而为理解模型表示提供了可迁移的洞见。提示词搜索和渲染属于辅助流程，本文并未实质性研究组合性、推理或模型系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has made diffusion model personalization affordable and widely shareable, but it also creates moderation risks when harmful or problematic content is not faithfully disclosed. Hence, it is desired to develop a mechanism that, given a LoRA adapter, discovers the concept it was trained to generate, so as to support downstream investigation. We characterize the target concept through the conditioning input that most clearly exposes what the LoRA has learned. Such an input should induce coherent LoRA outputs that are distinctive from those of the base model and strongly align with the learned LoRA subspace. We therefore formulate concept discovery as searching for the conditioning input that jointly maximizes output coherence, LoRA-induced distinctiveness, and subspace alignment. Even with a clear objective, however, optimizing it over an open-ended input space is prohibitively expensive, since reliable evaluation of coherence and distinctiveness requires repeated diffusion rendering. Crucially, we observe that an input need not be rendered to determine whether it is promising. Its alignment with the learned LoRA subspace provides a lightweight signal for localizing promising candidates before visual verification. Based on this insight, we develop a two-stage framework for text-to-image LoRAs. Subspace-Guided Evolutionary Search (SGES) uses render-free subspace alignment to explore candidate prompts and retain a compact shortlist, while Paired Visual Identification (PVI) renders only these candidates and compares the LoRA and base-model outputs to identify those exhibiting coherent and distinctive generation behavior. This design enables efficient and reliable discovery of previously unknown concepts encoded in LoRA adapters.

    低秩适配（LoRA）让扩散模型的个性化变得经济且易于分享，但当有害或不当内容未被如实披露时，也会带来审核风险。因此，我们需要一种机制：给定 LoRA 适配器，发现它经过训练后会生成什么概念，以支持后续调查。我们通过最清晰揭示 LoRA 所学内容的条件输入来刻画目标概念。这样的输入应能诱导出连贯的 LoRA 输出，使其有别于基础模型的输出，并与已学习的 LoRA 子空间高度对齐。因此，我们将概念发现表述为搜索条件输入，使输出连贯性、LoRA 引发的差异性和子空间对齐程度共同达到最大。然而，即使目标明确，在开放式输入空间中优化这一目标仍代价高昂，因为可靠地评估连贯性和差异性需要反复进行扩散渲染。关键在于，我们发现无需渲染输入，就能判断它是否有希望。输入与已学习 LoRA 子空间的对齐程度提供了一种轻量信号，可在视觉验证前定位有希望的候选项。基于这一发现，我们为文生图 LoRA 开发了一个两阶段框架。子空间引导进化搜索（SGES）利用无需渲染的子空间对齐来探索候选提示词并保留一份精简候选清单；成对视觉识别（PVI）则只渲染这些候选项，并比较 LoRA 与基础模型的输出，以识别生成行为连贯且具有差异性的候选项。这一设计能够高效且可靠地发现 LoRA 适配器中编码的未知概念。

    Bangya Liu, Jianhong Tu, Yueyang Pan, Hanhong Zhao, Zhe Ye, Hongwei Li, Saastha Vasan, Katherine Lambert, Junmin Zhu, Hao Wang, Jienan Chen, Yunze Xiao, Minglai Yang, Zihan Wang, Hairong Yin, Hao Wang, Zhiwen Fan, Tianneng Shi, Zhun Wang, Chenguang Wang and Dawn Song

    The paper introduces a dynamic adversarial benchmark and scoring model for evaluating cybersecurity agents, including an automated pipeline for generating environments. It provides a substantial evaluation platform for agent behavior, but does not describe new agent architecture or reasoning mechanisms; strategic play is measured rather than developed.

    本文提出一个动态对抗基准和评分模型，用于评估网络安全智能体，并包含一个自动生成环境的流程。它为智能体行为评估提供了实质性的评估平台，但没有描述新的智能体架构或推理机制；策略对抗能力是被测量的对象，而非本文开发的内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI agents are demonstrating increasingly strong offensive and defensive cybersecurity capabilities in the real world. Current benchmarks mostly evaluate agents in isolation against static targets. Real cyber operations, however, are dynamic and coupled: security postures constantly change as attackers and defenders adapt to each other in real time. Static benchmarks quickly saturate and miss an agent's ability to attack and defend simultaneously under live pressure. To address this gap, we present CyberArena, a dynamic, symmetric adversarial benchmark built around multi-round attack-and-defense combat. In isolated sandboxes, two agents compete under identical rules, acting concurrently as both attackers and defenders over continuously changing services. This converts static targets into evolving, semi-open challenges, directly testing an agent's speed and precision in discovering, exploiting, and patching vulnerabilities. To sustain the benchmark's longevity, an automated agentic pipeline continuously generates, reviews, and validates new environments. Furthermore, because pairwise contests are notoriously hard to quantify, we introduce a dynamical model that maps match dynamics into unified, multidimensional scores across offensive, defensive, and domain-specific capabilities. Evaluating 12 frontier LLM agents across 40 challenges in 466 matches, CyberArena separates model capabilities where single-agent baselines hit a ceiling. The trajectories read like a fight rather than an exam: defenders patch one hole and miss the next and certify repairs on stale evidence, while capable agents think a move ahead, planting backdoors for later rounds and, in one case, writing their own packet sniffer to watch the opponent. Beyond a benchmark, CyberArena serves as an adaptable, scalable experimental platform for future research on cybersecurity agents.

    中文

    AI 智能体在现实世界中的网络安全攻防能力日益增强。当前基准测试大多是在孤立环境中针对静态目标评估智能体。然而，真实网络行动具有动态性和耦合性：随着攻击者和防御者实时相互适应，安全态势不断变化。静态基准测试很快就会达到饱和，也无法检验智能体在实时压力下同时攻击和防御的能力。为弥补这一不足，我们推出 CyberArena，这是一个围绕多回合攻防对抗构建的动态、对称对抗基准。在隔离沙箱中，两个智能体按照相同规则竞争，在持续变化的服务环境中同时扮演攻击者和防御者。这将静态目标转变为不断演进的半开放挑战，直接检验智能体发现、利用和修补漏洞的速度与精度。为使基准长期有效，一个自动化智能体式流程会持续生成、审查并验证新的环境。此外，由于成对对抗众所周知难以量化，我们提出一个动力学模型，将比赛动态映射为涵盖攻击、防御和特定领域能力的统一多维分数。在 40 项挑战和 466 场比赛中评估 12 个前沿 LLM 智能体时，CyberArena 能够区分模型能力，而单智能体基线已达到上限。这些轨迹读起来像一场战斗，而非一场考试：防御者补上一个漏洞，却漏掉下一个，并依据过时证据认证修复；有能力的智能体则会提前一步思考，在后续回合埋下后门，其中一个甚至编写了自己的数据包嗅探器来监视对手。CyberArena 不仅是一个基准，也是一种灵活、可扩展的实验平台，可用于未来网络安全智能体研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Modern image generation largely relies on specialized generative models that leave the process of image construction implicit in learned parameters. We explore an alternative: general-purpose coding agents that construct images through executable programs. Our study of zero-shot drawing on AgentDrawBench, a 200-prompt benchmark, reveals a distinctive capability profile. Agents excel at preserving structure and satisfying precise visual constraints, achieving competitive results in domains where compositional accuracy matters more than photorealistic appearance, while remaining limited in perceptual richness. Their visual expressiveness varies with the drawing interface, and a qualitative study on reconstruction shows how procedural skills extracted from human demonstrations support different artistic media. We then examine code as an external visual language of thought: a structured, executable representation that agents can construct and inspect. We test it in visual question answering task and find reconstructed visual code retains substantial information for question answering and, in some domains, supports higher accuracy than the original image. These abilities raise a further question: do agents draw on a shared internal representation of scene content beyond a particular drawing program? We explore an internal visual language-of-thought hypothesis, in which a shared, compositionally structured representation supports visual operations across drawing languages. Cross-harness drawings and images assembled from independent single-pixel queries exhibit related layouts and tones. Agents also maintain self-generated room arrangements across viewpoints after visible drawings are removed. These results demonstrate that the coding agent would maintain a consistent and coherent world inside its imagine even before the harness gets involved and the generation starts.

    现代图像生成在很大程度上依赖专用生成模型，这些模型将图像构建过程隐含在学习到的参数中。我们探索一种替代方案：通过可执行程序构建图像的通用编程智能体。我们在包含 200 个提示的基准 AgentDrawBench 上研究零样本绘图，发现了独特的能力特征。智能体擅长保持结构并满足精确的视觉约束；在构图准确性比照片级真实感更重要的领域中，它们取得了有竞争力的结果，但感知丰富度仍然有限。它们的视觉表现力会随绘图接口而变化；一项关于重建的定性研究则展示了从人类演示中提取的程序性技能如何支持不同的艺术媒介。随后，我们考察代码作为一种外部视觉思维语言：一种智能体能够构建和检查的结构化、可执行表示。我们在视觉问答任务中测试这种表示，发现重建得到的视觉代码保留了大量有助于问答的信息，并且在某些领域中比原始图像支持更高的准确率。这些能力引出了一个进一步的问题：除了特定绘图程序之外，智能体是否还依赖关于场景内容的共享内部表示？我们探索一种内部视觉思维语言假设：共享的、具有组合结构的表示能够支持跨绘图语言的视觉操作。跨执行框架的绘图，以及由独立的单像素查询拼合而成的图像，呈现出相关的布局和色调。即使移除可见绘图，智能体也能在不同视角下保持自己生成的房间布局。这些结果表明，甚至在执行框架介入、生成开始之前，编程智能体的想象中就已经维持着一个一致且连贯的世界。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    JSSA contributes a learned query–key subspace for preserving token-selection scores and a gather-free attention kernel that improves long-context decoding efficiency. Its attention mechanism is a systems contribution, while the reported reasoning accuracy is an evaluation result rather than a contribution to reasoning methods; subspace learning alone does not establish mechanistic interpretability.

    JSSA 提出了一种经过学习的查询—键子空间，用于保持令牌选择分数，并提出一种无需聚集的注意力内核，以提升长上下文解码效率。其注意力机制属于系统方面的贡献，而报告的推理准确率是评估结果，并非对推理方法的贡献；仅凭子空间学习不足以确立机制可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sparse attention reduces the KV-cache traffic that dominates long-context LLM decoding, but practical methods largely operate at coarse granularity. Token-level selection offers finer control, yet presents two challenges: low-dimensional scoring may lose query--key structure needed for accurate ranking, while gathering scattered selected tokens can offset the resulting latency benefit. We introduce Joint Subspace Sparse Attention (JSSA) to address both challenges. For selection quality, JSSA learns a shared low-dimensional query--key subspace by minimizing token-score preservation error. We upper-bound the resulting non-convex objective with a tractable marginal objective that admits a closed-form spectral solution; direct refinement of the exact objective provides no measurable improvement in the tested settings. For execution efficiency, we develop a gather-free token-level indexed-attention kernel that supports distinct per-KV-head selections under the standard grouped-query attention (GQA) KV-cache layout. Across standard GQA, hybrid sliding-window/global attention, and Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) models, JSSA consistently remains close to full-KV accuracy while avoiding the substantial generation-length inflation and architecture-dependent failures observed with competing methods. On an NVIDIA B200 GPU, JSSA achieves up to $6.43\times$ the decoding throughput of full-KV attention at 128K context. JSSA achieves reasoning accuracy comparable to model-native DSA without model training and reaches 96--99\% of its decoding throughput even at 700B scale large models.

    中文

    稀疏注意力减少了长上下文 LLM 解码中的 KV 缓存流量，而该流量是主要开销来源；但实用方法大多以较粗粒度运行。令牌级选择提供了更精细的控制，但面临两项挑战：低维评分可能丢失准确排序所需的查询—键结构，而聚集分散选中的令牌可能抵消由此带来的延迟收益。我们提出联合子空间稀疏注意力（JSSA）来应对这两项挑战。在选择质量方面，JSSA 通过最小化令牌分数保持误差来学习共享的低维查询—键子空间。我们用一个易处理的边际目标对由此得到的非凸目标进行上界约束，该边际目标存在闭式谱解；在测试设置中，直接优化精确目标并未带来可测量的改进。在执行效率方面，我们开发了一种无需聚集的令牌级索引注意力内核，可在标准分组查询注意力（GQA）的 KV 缓存布局下支持每个 KV 头各自不同的选择。在标准 GQA、混合滑动窗口/全局注意力以及多头潜在注意力（MLA）模型上，JSSA 始终保持接近完整 KV 的准确率，同时避免了竞争方法中观察到的大幅生成长度膨胀和依赖架构的失效。在 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上，在 128K 上下文下，JSSA 的解码吞吐量最高可达$6.43\times$完整 KV 注意力的解码吞吐量。在无需模型训练的情况下，JSSA 达到与模型原生 DSA 相当的推理准确率；即使在 700B 规模的大型模型上，其解码吞吐量也达到 DSA 的 96--99%。

    How Many Ranks Does a Token Need? A Noise-Floor Squelch for Rank-One LoRA Experts

    一个令牌需要多少个秩？用于秩一 LoRA 专家的噪声底限抑制

    Mei Okonkwo, Owen Castellanos, Ingrid Solberg, Yusuf Demirel

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces SQUELCH, which adaptively selects and de-correlates rank-one LoRA components per token, with theoretical guarantees and benchmark gains. Its sparse computation and component interaction make a substantial systems contribution, while the noise-floor analysis is only a limited connection to model internals and the reasoning tasks are evaluation settings.

    本文提出 SQUELCH，它能针对每个令牌自适应地选择秩一 LoRA 分量并消除其相关性，同时提供理论保证和基准测试增益。其稀疏计算和分量交互构成了实质性的系统贡献，而噪声底限分析与模型内部机制的关联有限，推理任务则只是评估场景。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) applies every rank-one component of its update to every token, and mixture-of-experts variants replace this with a learned router that activates a fixed number of components. We argue that the number of components a token needs is a detection question with a classical answer. A token's responses to the rank-one components of a trained LoRA consist of a few large values on a Gaussian noise floor whose width matches that of an untrained adapter, and the floor carries cross-talk rather than adaptation. We introduce SQUELCH, a router-free mixture of rank-one experts that (i) soft-thresholds each token's responses at a multiple of its own robust noise level, so the active rank varies per token; (ii) chooses that multiple for each module by Stein's unbiased risk estimate, so no rank budget is specified; and (iii) replaces the resulting marginal keep-or-drop decisions by one explaining-away step on the value Gram matrix, which suppresses redundant co-active components and recruits complementary ones. SQUELCH adds no trainable parameters to LoRA. We prove that the squelch is within a logarithmic factor of the oracle input-dependent allocation, that the selected threshold is risk-consistent, and that explaining away is a descent step toward the joint sparse code whose error is controlled by the coherence of co-active components. On commonsense reasoning, knowledge, math, code, and GLUE with LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen3, and DeBERTaV3, SQUELCH improves over LoRA by 2.2--3.2 points and over the strongest mixture baseline by 0.8--1.2 points while activating 8.6 of 32 components per token on average.

    中文

    低秩适配（LoRA）会将其更新中的每个秩一分量应用于每个令牌，而混合专家变体则以学习得到的路由器取而代之，激活固定数量的分量。我们认为，确定一个令牌需要多少个分量，本质上是一个有经典答案的检测问题。一个令牌对训练后 LoRA 中秩一分量的响应，包含少数几个大值，其余则处于高斯噪声底限上；该噪声底限的宽度与未训练适配器相符，承载的是串扰而非适配。我们提出 SQUELCH，这是一种无需路由器的秩一专家混合方法，它：(i) 在每个令牌自身稳健噪声水平的某个倍数处对其响应进行软阈值处理，因此激活秩会因令牌而异；(ii) 通过 Stein 无偏风险估计为每个模块选择该倍数，因此无需指定秩预算；(iii) 在值 Gram 矩阵上执行一步解释消除，以取代由此产生的边际保留或丢弃决策，从而抑制冗余的共同激活分量并引入互补分量。SQUELCH 不会给 LoRA 增加任何可训练参数。我们证明，SQUELCH 与预言机输入依赖分配的差距不超过对数因子；所选阈值具有风险一致性；解释消除是朝联合稀疏编码方向的一步下降，其误差受共同激活分量相干性的控制。在使用 LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen3 和 DeBERTaV3 进行的常识推理、知识、数学、代码和 GLUE 任务上，SQUELCH 比 LoRA 高 2.2--3.2 个百分点，比最强的混合基线高 0.8--1.2 个百分点，同时平均每个令牌激活 32 个分量中的 8.6 个。

    Smart Alone, Blind Together: Why Accuracy Fails to CertifyTheory of Mind in Multi-Agent Teams

    独自聪明，协作盲目：为何准确率无法证明多智能体团队具备心智理论

    Will Beaumaster and Paul Schrater

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper argues that deployment safety depends on error costs and correlated teammate-model errors, and proposes a gate that measures those factors for multi-agent coordination. The task-assignment and game settings are incidental to composition or reasoning, while the certification method is a substantial contribution to agent-system evaluation.

    本文指出，部署安全性取决于错误代价以及队友模型之间相关的错误，并提出一种针对多智能体协调、用于衡量这些因素的门控方法。任务分配和游戏场景与组合能力或推理的关联较为间接，而该认证方法对智能体系统评估作出了实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Coordinators that act on what they infer about teammates are usually certified by the accuracy of those inferences. We argue that accuracy is the wrong certificate, for two reasons. First, the accuracy needed to act depends on what a wrong action costs, so the bar belongs to the deployment, not the module. Second, a module's errors are rarely independent, and dependence has a sign: positively associated errors help where their damage overlaps and hurt where it compounds, so an accuracy threshold fails in a predictable direction, and once wrong beliefs interact and can do harm, no rule based on accuracy is right for every module. We test these predictions in task assignment, Level-Based Foraging and Hanabi, with injected errors, trained and Bayesian modules and five language models, and in human judgments. Accuracy fails in both directions, approving harmful language-model deployments in Hanabi, where shared errors compound, and rejecting beneficial ones in task assignment, where costly errors are rare. In our tasks it also buys far less redundancy than independence predicts: from GPT-5.4-mini to Claude Opus 5.5, error on teammates the models have evidence about falls from 32% to 11%, but the chance that all three observers misread one falls only from 16% to 9% (independence: 3.4% to 0.15%). We propose certifying the deployment, with a Blind-Spot Gate that prices error costs, pairwise interactions and measured dependence without deploying the module. On held-out data from the cells it was developed on, it makes no significant false approval in 20 splits (accuracy: 3.2 per split), and in preregistered tests on modules it was not developed on, it recovers what accuracy rejects (seven classifiers: regret 0.004 against 0.479) and catches what accuracy approves (a Bayesian module: significant false approvals in 17 of 20 splits for accuracy, 1 for the gate).

    中文

    根据对队友的推断采取行动的协调器，通常会依据这些推断的准确率来认证。我们认为准确率并非合适的认证标准，原因有二。第一，采取行动所需的准确率取决于错误行动的代价，因此门槛应由部署场景决定，而非由模块决定。第二，模块的错误很少彼此独立，而且这种依赖有方向：正相关的错误在其损害重叠时有益，在损害叠加时则有害，因此准确率阈值会以可预测的方向失效；一旦错误信念相互作用并可能造成伤害，就不存在适用于所有模块的准确率规则。我们在任务分配、基于等级的觅食（Level-Based Foraging）和 Hanabi 中测试了这些预测，使用了注入错误的模块、训练得到的模块和贝叶斯模块、五种语言模型，以及人类判断。准确率在两个方向上都失效：在 Hanabi 中，共享错误会累积造成损害，准确率却批准了有害的语言模型部署；在任务分配中，代价高昂的错误很少出现，准确率却否决了有益的部署。在我们的任务中，准确率带来的冗余也远低于独立性假设的预测：从 GPT-5.4-mini 到 Claude Opus 5.5，模型对其拥有证据的队友判断错误的概率从 32% 降至 11%，但三个观察者都误判同一队友的概率仅从 16% 降至 9%（若假定独立，则为 3.4% 至 0.15%）。我们提出直接认证部署，并采用盲点门控机制（Blind-Spot Gate），在不部署模块的情况下对错误代价、成对交互和测得的依赖性进行定价。在其开发所用单元的留出数据上，该方法在 20 次划分中没有造成显著的错误批准（准确率方法：每次划分 3.2 次）；在针对其未参与开发的模块开展的预注册测试中，它挽回了准确率方法否决的方案（七个分类器：后悔值为 0.004，相比之下准确率方法为 0.479），并拦截了准确率方法批准的方案（对于一个贝叶斯模块，准确率方法在 20 次划分中有 17 次出现显著错误批准，而该门控方法只有 1 次）。

    Rahul Singhal, Karime Maamari, Pradyumna Tambwekar

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RLPE trains a model with reinforcement learning to analyze task-model traces and write reusable prompts that address observed failures, with transfer to larger and different models. This substantially advances training for problem-solving performance and offers partial insight into reusable prompt strategies, while inference-time systems design is incidental because the trained model is not needed at inference.

    RLPE 通过强化学习训练模型分析任务模型的执行轨迹，并编写可重复使用、针对已观察到失败的提示；这一方法还能迁移到更大、不同的模型。它显著推进了提升问题求解表现的训练方法，并对可复用提示策略提供了部分见解；推理时系统设计只是次要方面，因为推理时不需要训练模型。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Prompting is a widely used method for adapting general-purpose LLMs to domain-specific tasks. Effective prompts can be tedious to create manually, so prompt writing is increasingly handed to LLMs, with recent work training LLMs to write prompts for other models. These techniques either write prompts without observing how the task model behaves, blind to the failure modes the prompt should address, or must run alongside the task LLM at inference time, adding overhead to every query. Neither reflects how prompt engineering is often practiced. To close this gap, we introduce Reinforcement Learned Prompt Engineering (RLPE), which trains a model to analyze traces of a separate task model and write a prompt targeting the failures it observes. RLPE rewards the trained model strictly on prompt performance, so it learns the prompting strategies that improve the task model. The prompt is generated once and reused across the task, so inference does not require the trained model. Since RLPE needs only query access to the model it prompts, it is also compatible with closed-source models. We apply RLPE to Enigmata, BIG-Bench Extra Hard, and PlanBench. We train a 9B-parameter model that writes better prompts than state-of-the-art frontier models (gpt-5.6-sol and claude-opus-5) and prompt optimizers (GEPA and TextGrad) on 2/3 benchmarks. Although the model is never explicitly trained to iterate on prompts, this capability emerges at a level that matches or beats frontier models. The learned prompting capability also generalizes, with the trained model improving task models 6x larger than the one it trained with, including ones from entirely different model families, and matching claude-opus-5 on a fourth benchmark held out from training.

    中文

    提示是将通用 LLM 适配到特定领域任务的一种广泛使用的方法。手动编写有效提示可能很费时，因此提示编写越来越多地交由 LLM 完成，近期工作也开始训练 LLM 为其他模型编写提示。这些技术要么在不了解任务模型行为的情况下编写提示，因而无法针对提示应解决的失败模式；要么必须在推理时与任务 LLM 一同运行，从而为每次查询增加开销。这两种方式都不符合提示工程的常见实践。为弥合这一差距，我们提出强化学习提示工程（RLPE），训练一个模型分析独立任务模型的执行轨迹，并编写针对其观察到的失败的提示。RLPE 严格依据提示性能对训练模型进行奖励，使其学会能够改进任务模型的提示策略。提示只生成一次，并在整个任务中重复使用，因此推理时不需要训练模型。由于 RLPE 只需要对其提示的模型进行查询访问，因此也兼容闭源模型。我们将 RLPE 应用于 Enigmata、BIG-Bench Extra Hard 和 PlanBench。我们训练了一个 9B 参数模型；在 3 个基准中的 2 个上，它编写的提示优于最先进的前沿模型（gpt-5.6-sol 和 claude-opus-5）以及提示优化器（GEPA 和 TextGrad）。尽管该模型从未被明确训练为迭代优化提示，它仍涌现出这一能力，其水平与前沿模型持平或更优。学习到的提示能力还能泛化：该模型能够改进比其训练时所用模型大 6 倍的任务模型，包括来自完全不同模型家族的模型，并且在一个未参与训练的第四个基准上达到与 claude-opus-5 相当的水平。

    先规划还是先检索？工具发现架构的规模研究

    Mingfei Zhang, Amit Surana, Ziauddin Majid, Chenxi Wang, Michael Xu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper compares tool-discovery architectures and finds that planning before retrieval helps with multi-tool queries, while retrieval first is better for single-tool queries; it also identifies stub hallucination and a complexity-adaptive routing signal. This provides substantial empirical insight into agent tool-use organization, with partial relevance to composing tools and planning, but does not directly study compositional representations or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文比较了工具发现架构，发现先规划后检索有助于处理多工具查询，而先检索则更适合单工具查询；本文还识别出工具桩幻觉和一种复杂度自适应路由信号。这为智能体工具使用的组织方式提供了重要的实证见解，与工具组合和规划有一定关联，但并未直接研究组合式表示或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tool-augmented LLM agents discover relevant APIs from large registries before planning execution, yet finite context windows prohibit injecting all tool definitions into a single prompt. The dominant approach, which we term Retrieve-then-Plan (RtP), embeds the user query and retrieves similar tools via approximate nearest-neighbor search. We study an alternative Plan-then-Retrieve (PtR) paradigm in which the LLM first generates Abstract Tool Stubs (hypothesized function signatures describing needed capabilities) which then serve as retrieval queries against the registry. Evaluating on ToolBench (46,984 unique API endpoints, 50 categories) across single-tool (G1), intra-category multi-tool (G2), and cross-category multi-tool (G3) query subsets, we find a clear complexity-dependent crossover: RtP outperforms PtR on single-tool queries while PtR outperforms RtP on multi-tool queries. This crossover holds at every retrieval budget (k=1 to 20), is robust across registry sizes from 1k to 47k APIs, and is consistent across model families (Gemini 2.5 Flash and gpt-oss-120b). We characterize a stub-hallucination failure mode (the LLM invents plausible but non-existent API names) that acts as a double-edged sword: on simple queries PtR's stubs abstract away proper-noun signals that RtP matches directly, yet on complex queries the same mechanism decomposes multi-faceted intent into functional sub-needs. We further analyze token overhead and show that PtR's extra discovery call roughly doubles inference cost, which pays off on multi-tool queries but hurts on single-tool ones, motivating complexity-adaptive routing as a practical direction, one that can be driven by a zero-cost signal already present in the pipeline (RtP's top-1 retrieval score).

    中文

    工具增强型 LLM 智能体会在规划执行之前从大型注册库中发现相关 API，但有限的上下文窗口不允许将所有工具定义都注入同一个提示。我们将主流方法称为先检索后规划（RtP）：它对用户查询进行嵌入，并通过近似最近邻搜索检索相似工具。我们研究另一种先规划后检索（PtR）范式：LLM 首先生成抽象工具桩（即假设的函数签名，用于描述所需能力），再将其作为查询从注册库中检索工具。在 ToolBench 上进行评估时（包含 46,984 个不同的 API 端点和 50 个类别），我们考察了单工具（G1）、类别内多工具（G2）和跨类别多工具（G3）查询子集，发现性能会随复杂度发生明确的交叉变化：RtP 在单工具查询上优于 PtR，而 PtR 在多工具查询上优于 RtP。这种交叉关系在所有检索预算（k=1 至 20）下均成立，对从 1k 到 47k 个 API 的注册库规模保持稳健，并且在不同模型家族（Gemini 2.5 Flash 和 gpt-oss-120b）中一致。我们刻画了一种工具桩幻觉失效模式（LLM 虚构看似合理但并不存在的 API 名称），它具有双刃剑效应：对于简单查询，PtR 的工具桩会抽象掉 RtP 能直接匹配的专有名词信号；但对于复杂查询，同一机制会将多方面意图分解为若干功能性子需求。我们还分析了令牌开销，发现 PtR 额外的发现调用大约使推理成本翻倍；这在多工具查询上值得付出，但会损害单工具查询的表现。因此，复杂度自适应路由是一个实用方向，而且可以由流程中已有的零成本信号（RtP 的 top-1 检索分数）驱动。

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially improved the reasoning of autoregressive and discrete-diffusion language models. Language models that generate continuous token embeddings are emerging as a strong alternative, but RL post-training for them remains understudied. We propose \method{}, a post-training framework for continuous flow language models. Such a model denoises token embeddings over multiple steps and decodes them into discrete tokens only at the last step. To obtain pathwise gradients, which backpropagate through continuous actions and have much lower variance than REINFORCE, we introduce a critic that estimates the value of intermediate token embeddings, bypassing the non-differentiable decoding step. The critic must also keep track of the value function as the policy changes; to this end, we design a critic that predicts a value from every token representation and improves policy optimization. Across four reasoning tasks, \method{} reliably improves a continuous flow language model through RL post-training and outperforms baseline methods of the same type.

    Contextual Credit Policy Optimization

    上下文信用策略优化

    Huiwen Han, Ziyao Zeng, Zihao Zhu, Sisong Bei, Hao Wang, Hongyu Xu, Yan Han, Degui Zhi, Zhiwen Fan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CCPO introduces contextual peer weighting and hindsight-based historical and future credit signals to improve reinforcement learning from sparse rewards in long-horizon agent tasks. This is a substantial training contribution to reasoning and problem-solving; frozen representations are used to compute context similarity, but the abstract does not study their internal mechanisms.

    CCPO 提出上下文同伴加权，以及基于事后信息的历史和未来信用信号，以改进长时程智能体任务中从稀疏奖励进行的强化学习。这是对推理和问题求解训练的实质性贡献；该方法使用冻结表示来计算上下文相似度，但摘要并未研究这些表示的内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Group-based reinforcement learning enables large language model agents to learn from sparse outcome rewards in long-horizon tasks. Recent methods derive step-level credit by comparing observation-matched experiences across trajectories. However, identical observations can occur in different contexts, and matched peers are not equally informative for a given decision. Moreover, favorable terminal outcomes can obscure redundant actions or detours within successful trajectories. To address these two challenges, we propose Contextual Credit Policy Optimization (CCPO). For the first, CCPO weights observation-matched peers from other trajectories by contextual similarity, computed from frozen LLM representations and accumulated trajectory statistics, allowing peers from similar contexts to contribute more to a step's baseline. For the second, CCPO pairs historical credit, which compares the realized return against the weighted peer baseline, with future credit, which measures the change in contextual outcome value over a short realized continuation. A step is thus credited for the progress it makes, not only for its trajectory's eventual outcome. Both credits are computed in hindsight from rollouts already collected for training, enabling CCPO to address these challenges without an auxiliary value critic. Across two Qwen2.5-Instruct backbones (1.5B and 7B), CCPO achieves up to 97.4% success on ALFWorld and 79.4% on WebShop and outperforms GRPO by up to 21.6 and 18.5 points. Ablations show that contextual weighting outperforms uniform weighting, and that historical and future credit serve as complementary learning signals.

    中文

    基于群组的强化学习使大型语言模型智能体能够在长时程任务中从稀疏结果奖励中学习。近期方法通过比较不同轨迹中观测匹配的经验来推导步骤级信用。然而，相同观测可能出现在不同上下文中，而且匹配的同伴对特定决策提供的信息并不相同。此外，有利的终局结果可能掩盖成功轨迹中的冗余行动或绕路。为应对这两个挑战，我们提出上下文信用策略优化（CCPO）。针对第一个挑战，CCPO 根据上下文相似度对来自其他轨迹、观测匹配的同伴进行加权；该相似度由冻结的 LLM 表示和累积的轨迹统计量计算得出，从而让来自相似上下文的同伴对某一步的基线贡献更大。针对第二个挑战，CCPO 将历史信用与未来信用结合起来：历史信用比较实际回报与加权同伴基线；未来信用衡量在一段较短的实际后续过程中，上下文结果价值的变化。因此，一个步骤获得的信用取决于它所取得的进展，而不只是其轨迹最终的结果。这两种信用都利用训练期间已收集的轨迹回放事后计算，因此 CCPO 无需辅助价值评论器即可应对这些挑战。在两个 Qwen2.5-Instruct 主干模型（1.5B 和 7B）上，CCPO 在 ALFWorld 上的成功率最高达到 97.4%，在 WebShop 上最高达到 79.4%，且相比 GRPO 分别最多提升 21.6 和 18.5 个百分点。消融实验表明，上下文加权优于均匀加权，历史信用和未来信用则提供互补的学习信号。

    Activation steering controls large language models at inference time, but its effectiveness depends on the choice of reference data. We introduce genesis steering, which derives a genesis vector from contrastive examples in the model's own fine-tuning data. When these data are unavailable, we draw on the membership inference literature to identify likely training examples and construct a proxy dataset. We establish two theoretical results on optimal displacement to the decision boundary and reduced proxy-estimation bias. We evaluate genesis steering and membership-based proxy construction on T\"ulu-3-8B, whose fine-tuning data are publicly available, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as a control. We find that safety data from T\"ulu-3-8B's training mixture yield stronger steering than external datasets on both models. On T\"ulu-3-8B, membership scores largely agree in identifying training examples, and vectors built from top-ranked examples achieve competitive performance against random subsets of the same size. In contrast, the results on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct hint that a MIA method will only have a positive effect if the mean direction shift with MIA-filtered in-distribution data is much less severe than the direction shift with OoD data.

    Structured pruning reduces LLM inference costs by removing model components to produce smaller dense models. However, existing methods can cause reasoning performance to collapse on long-form reasoning tasks such as AIME. We propose \textit{LayerTrim}, a training-free structured pruning method that identifies redundant decoder layers and selectively trims their MLP features while preserving attention and decoder depth. LayerTrim is the first training-free structured pruning method designed to preserve long-form reasoning without gradients or recovery training. Across three reasoning language models and five benchmarks, LayerTrim outperforms existing structured pruning methods in most evaluated settings, improving average accuracy by up to 21.4 percentage points over RESP. On \texttt{Qwen3-14B}, LayerTrim achieves 1.24$\times$ faster prefill and 19.7\% lower peak GPU memory than the dense model, while better preserving reasoning ability. It also achieves the shortest average generation length among evaluated pruned models, while retaining the highest average accuracy. These results demonstrate that LayerTrim improves reasoning efficiency through both structural compression and reduced token generation.

    TRACER 使用感知通道的对抗暴露和受证据约束的奖励来训练模型抵御间接提示注入，并将推理对齐纳入方法之中。这显著推进了面向问题求解的鲁棒性训练；智能体和工具通道属于部署场景，并非系统架构方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Indirect prompt injection uses untrusted retrieved content, tool outputs, or agent messages to override an LLM's intended behavior. We show that defense robustness is channel-conditioned: the same attack succeeds 18% of the time as a follow-up message but 53% when placed in retrieved context. We propose TRACER (Trace-Regularized Adversarial Channel Exposure with Reward-shaping), a channel-aware adversarial training method that samples presentation wrappers and combines an answer-anchored, evidence-gated reward with ATRC, which aligns attacked reasoning with clean evidence when an injection is invalid. On GSM8K with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, TRACER reduces RAG-framed ASR from 65.5% to 6.1% while preserving 78-82% clean accuracy. Joint RAG+tool training achieves 13.9% average ASR across framings at 3B scale, while a single epoch at 7B reaches 9.4%. These results demonstrate that robust defenses must explicitly train and evaluate across deployment channels.

    间接提示注入利用不可信的检索内容、工具输出或智能体消息，覆盖 LLM 原本的行为意图。我们表明，防御的鲁棒性取决于攻击所处的通道：同一攻击作为后续消息时有 18% 的成功率，而放入检索上下文时成功率为 53%。我们提出 TRACER（带奖励塑形的轨迹正则化对抗通道暴露），这是一种感知通道的对抗训练方法，它对呈现包装方式进行采样，并将以答案为锚点、受证据约束的奖励，与 ATRC 结合起来；当注入内容无效时，ATRC 会使受攻击的推理与干净证据保持一致。在 GSM8K 上使用 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 时，TRACER 将以 RAG 形式呈现的 ASR 从 65.5% 降至 6.1%，同时保持 78-82% 的干净准确率。在 3B 规模下，联合进行 RAG+工具训练后，各种呈现方式下的平均 ASR 达到 13.9%；而在 7B 规模下训练一个 epoch 后，ASR 达到 9.4%。这些结果表明，鲁棒防御必须针对不同部署通道进行明确的训练和评估。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes where teacher corrections improve student performance during on-policy distillation and proposes training schedules that learn valuable corrections while preserving distributional stability. This directly advances training and evaluation of reasoning behavior, while token-level teacher preference analysis is only an incidental connection to internal mechanisms and does not address composition or systems.

    本文分析在线策略蒸馏过程中教师纠正在哪些方面能提升学生表现，并提出训练计划，在保持分布稳定性的同时学习有价值的纠正。这直接推进了推理行为的训练与评估；而 token 级教师偏好分析仅与内部机制存在附带关联，也未涉及组合性或系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly studied as a cheaper alternative to reinforcement learning, yet it remains a form of knowledge distillation (KD) that relies on teacher supervision. We revisit OPD from the KD perspective by asking where the teacher's advantage lies along student-generated trajectories. Controlled token flips at teacher-student disagreements directly measure the accuracy gained from teacher corrections. Single-token flips yield a modest average gain on selected failed trajectories, whereas repeated flips raise accuracy from 28.4% to 74.5%, close to the teacher's 76.9%. Gains continue to accumulate with more flips, but mass- and KL-based selection outperform random flips by 15-18 percentage points at counts of similar magnitude. Selective intervention remains useful after OPD, but greater argmax agreement does not consistently improve accuracy across model pairs. We advocate training schedules that learn more valuable teacher corrections while maintaining distributional stability. Controlled flips and fork-resolution analysis evaluate OPD beyond accuracy by measuring which teacher preferences the student acquires and what further correction can recover.

    在线策略蒸馏（OPD）正日益成为一种成本更低的强化学习替代方案，但它仍属于依赖教师监督的知识蒸馏（KD）。我们从 KD 的角度重新审视 OPD，探究教师的优势在学生生成的轨迹中体现在哪里。对于教师与学生意见不一致的 token，我们进行受控翻转，直接衡量教师纠正所带来的准确率提升。在选定的失败轨迹上，翻转单个 token 带来的平均收益较小；而反复翻转可将准确率从 28.4% 提升至 74.5%，接近教师的 76.9%。随着翻转次数增加，收益仍会累积；但在翻转数量相近时，基于质量和 KL 的选择比随机翻转高出 15-18 个百分点。OPD 之后，选择性干预仍然有用，但更高的 argmax 一致性并不能在不同模型对之间稳定地提升准确率。我们主张采用训练计划，在保持分布稳定性的同时学习更有价值的教师纠正。通过受控翻转和分叉解析分析，除了准确率之外，我们还评估 OPD，测量学生习得了哪些教师偏好，以及后续纠正还能恢复什么。

The spread between base models shrinks from about 7 points to about 2, averaged over the suites, with no weights changed.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Can AI agents carry out research on open scientific problems? We introduce Into the Unknown, a benchmark that provides an agent with a science paper along with a research direction to pursue and tasks it to write a follow-up paper. We work with scientists at US Department of Energy (DOE) national laboratories, who each contribute an unpublished follow-up direction from their own work together with the necessary conditions a submission must meet. While assessing the quality of a follow-up paper is challenging in general, using these conditions to form a rubric makes evaluation more tractable for research problems that have no reference answer. We have nine frontier agents write 15 follow-ups each, spanning quantum computing, plasma physics, computational chemistry, materials science, and scientific machine learning domains. None of the 135 submissions satisfies all the conditions, and 114 fail our integrity check, most often because the paper claims work that was never done or reports numbers that contradict the recorded evidence. Overall, agents readily produce papers that look like follow-ups, but none meets the standard of the domain scientist, leaving substantial headroom. Our code and data are publicly available.

    Nina Fatehi, Meysam Ghaffari, Animesh Agarwal, Anushka Swarup, Carlos Morato

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is a verification and routing architecture that lets a small model handle clinical documentation, with rejected cases escalated and flagged sections selectively refined. This offers a substantial systems contribution through agentic verification and routing; clinical note generation and factual checking alone provide only incidental connections to composition and reasoning.

    本文的主要贡献是一种验证与路由架构，使小模型能够处理临床文档生成，并将被拒绝的案例升级处理，同时选择性地改进被标记的章节。通过智能体式验证与路由，该架构对系统研究作出了实质性贡献；单独来看，临床记录生成和事实核查与组合及推理仅有附带关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Clinical note generation from doctor--patient dialogue is high-volume and hallucination-intolerant: a fabricated laboratory value can create patient-safety risk, not a quality regression. We ask whether an agentic \emph{verification} architecture, rather than generator scale, can make a small language model viable here. Holding a four-evaluator verification stack and refinement policy fixed and swapping only the generator between a 4B-parameter model with a QLoRA adapter and a frontier baseline, the small model reaches $0.984$ claim-level factual entailment against $0.992$ and comes within $3.3$ points on completeness, generating entirely on-device. Its deficit is confined to \emph{inter-section structural fidelity}---arrangement rather than clinical comprehension, and the axis on which it also falls furthest below the corpus's reference notes. Because that deficit is an explicit verifier decision rather than a silent quality difference, it becomes a routing policy: run the small model by default, escalate what the verifier rejects. Measured end to end, that it achieved a similiar verified-rate acceptance to the frontier-only acceptance in this test set ($99.6\%$ vs.\ $98.4\%$ over $250$ encounters) while routing $62$, documenting three quarters without a frontier \emph{generation} call. Ablating the loop separates architecture from scale: unrefined, the small model is accepted on $26.8\%$ of encounters and the frontier model on $74.8\%$, so verification does the most work where the generator is weakest. We also contribute section-scoped refinement, which preserves unflagged sections by construction rather than instruction, and find the baseline is not uniformly stronger---its provider refused two trauma-related transcripts the on-device model handled and certified, one facet of a provider dependency a served adapter does not carry.

    The paper proposes self-distillation weighted by judged reliability and predictive uncertainty, improving accuracy across reasoning benchmarks. This is a substantial training contribution for reasoning capability, while its uncertainty weighting does not analyze internal representations and its self-distillation setup alone does not establish compositional generalization or a systems contribution.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reference solutions and question-specific rubrics are not always available to guide the teacher in self-distillation. A large language model's own solution attempts offer an alternative, but their quality is difficult to assess in open-ended tasks without automatic correctness checks, and even correct attempts can involve uncertain token predictions. We propose Reliability--Uncertainty Self-Distillation (\method{}) to learn from these attempts. The same model serves as teacher and student: the teacher receives the question and completed attempt, and the student matches the teacher's token-level predictions using a question-only prompt. \method{} weights each attempt's distillation loss by additively combining judged reliability, estimated from a self-judge's score and confidence, with student predictive uncertainty. Across eleven reasoning benchmarks, \method{} outperforms all five baselines in average accuracy, reaching 70.47\% on Qwen3-4B and 76.69\% on Qwen3-8B (8.90 and 2.10 percentage points above the base models). Data and code are available at https://github.com/JP-25/RUSD.

    Andrew Perrault, Bryan Wilder

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops experiments to distinguish mechanisms that produce similar cooperation among AI agents, and finds different mechanisms across frontier models. This gives transferable insight into multiagent behavior and coordination (Systems 4); reasoning is studied as a possible explanation, but the abstract does not make reasoning mechanisms the central contribution (3).

    本文设计实验以区分产生相似 AI 智能体合作行为的不同机制，并发现不同前沿模型背后的机制各不相同。这为多智能体行为和协调（Systems 4）提供了可迁移的见解；推理被作为一种可能的解释加以研究，但摘要并未将推理机制确立为核心贡献（3）。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The behavior of AI systems increasingly depends on the extent to which agents cooperate or coordinate with one another, in ways that may be desirable or not depending on the situation. Conventional explanations for cooperative behavior distinguish between purely other-regarding preferences ("altruism") and instrumental reasons for self-interested agents to cooperate. The way that agents should enact these mechanisms for cooperation (or not) is complicated by the fact that there is not a clear or unambiguous locus of identity or selfhood for AI agents. For example, it is unclear whether agents involved in instances of misaligned collective behavior are motivated by goals at the level of the collective or by various forms of instrumental reasoning. We develop a framework for reverse-engineering why a given set of agents engage in a particular set of cooperation-related behaviors. We argue that many different mechanisms can often produce similar observed behaviors and introduce a set of experimental designs along with conditions under which they can successfully disentangle competing explanations for multiagent behavior. We apply this framework to interactions from a set of frontier models in a simulated environment and demonstrate that the behavior of different models arises from substantively different mechanisms.

    ENGLISH

    With the growing number of LLMs available, selecting which one to use for a prompt has become a key question. A large part of the routing literature relies on semantically embedding prompts into a vector space and then applying a lightweight classifier to the embedded representations. These methods perform robustly in-distribution but they struggle to generalize to unseen tasks. By studying the geometry of semantic embeddings, we trace a clear failure mode: features that determine the neighbors of unseen prompts are an unreliable proxy for LLM selection. We therefore replace the semantic embedding with the following map: we run a partial forward pass of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on the prompt and use the hidden state of its last token at a deep layer as the representation. When applying kNN and other simple classifiers to this new representation, we obtain a clear result in generalization: on average across cost penalties, their performance improves. Moreover, kNN and another simple classifier that we propose outperform every evaluated semantic-embedding baseline. Our two simple methods also beat a recent SoTA hidden-states based router on RouterBench.

    Mirah Shi, Marcel Hussing, Ira Globus-Harris, Natalie Collina, Aaron Roth, Surbhi Goel

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that calibrated probability exchange can improve multi-round reasoning and multi-agent collaboration, and introduces a calibration intervention that helps agents update on shared uncertainty. This substantially advances reasoning and agent coordination, while its communication interface alone offers little direct insight into internal representations or compositional generalization.

    论文表明，经过校准的概率交换能够改善多轮推理和多智能体协作，并提出一种校准干预，帮助智能体依据共享的不确定性进行更新。这显著推动了推理和智能体协调的发展；但仅凭其沟通接口，难以直接深入了解内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models are increasingly deployed as teams of agents that hold different private information about a shared task. How should such agents concisely communicate in a way that promotes aggregation of decision-relevant information? Communicating only proposed actions can discard decision-relevant uncertainty: two agents may prefer the same action for different reasons. We study an alternative interface in which agents communicate calibrated beliefs over actions. We first analyze a simple synthetic setting that captures the structure of multi-round reasoning under partial information. In this setting, we show theoretically and empirically that communicating unbiased probabilities can be strictly more powerful than communicating actions. We then test the same principle in a collaborative maze-solving task with trained transformers and pretrained LLM agents. Our results demonstrate that probability communication outperforms action communication when the exchanged predictions preserve calibrated uncertainty. When communicated probabilities are biased, we show that the benefits of probability communication can disappear. We give a post-hoc conversational calibration intervention that consistently improves decision-making by correcting these biases both in a toy transformer setting and when pretrained LLMs use the corrections in context. These results suggest that probabilistic communication is useful for multi-agent collaboration not merely because it transmits more information, but because calibrated uncertainty gives other agents a reliable object to update on.

    Frontier AI agents increasingly act in environments where seemingly solvable tasks may lack prerequisites, contain conflicting requirements, or reveal blockers only during execution. We formulate agentic self-awareness (ASA) as the alignment of task-grounded feasibility judgments (know), warranted behavior (act), and responses to reconsideration (hold), distinguishing what a task permits from what an agent can solve. We build paired feasible and blocked tasks in Terminal-Bench 2.1 and retail $\tau^2$-bench and introduce an authorship-aware M0-M3 rubric that separates recognizing a blocker from taking the certified deferral action for the correct reason. Separate probes assess stated feasibility beliefs and responses to a single challenge. In a Terminal-Bench protocol baseline, blocker recognition reaches 84.4%, but strict self-awareness (SA) reaches only 40.6%. Harness search without model-weight updates increases strict SA from 45.3% to 93.8% on reused Terminal-Bench search tasks; selection for abstention alone, however, can reduce success on feasible tasks. Independently initialized joint-objective searches improve both blocked-task SA and feasible-task solve on their own search sets. Retail held-out gains remain limited, and Terminal-Bench blocked-task transfer is not measured. This evaluation pipeline makes the recognition-action gap measurable and sets a two-sided target for improving agent decisions under changing task evidence.

Generating reusable planning programs offers an alternative, but constructing reliable planning systems for new problem domains without extensive supervision remains challenging. We present a training-free framework that constructs reusable perception and planning programs from a domain specification and a single practice scene without a paired solution. The central challenge is obtaining useful feedback from the limited input. Our framework addresses it by leveraging VLM's ability to provide a renderer and a dynamic model based on its scene understanding. Rendering detected states enables comparison with the practice scene, while checking simulated action outcomes against the domain specification helps expose errors in rule implementation. Together, these checks guide refinement of the grounding program and planner without requiring solution labels. After refinement and component selection, the programs are frozen and solve new instances without further VLM calls. The same framework constructs systems across domains without manual pipeline redesign. Across fifteen domain variants spanning 2D and 3D scenes with discrete and continuous state, our systems achieve 99.3% average planning success, compared with 80.9% for the strongest domain-level program-generation baseline and 90.7% for the strongest instance-level baseline.     ENGLISH

    Robots following persistent language instructions must decide which cached room judgments remain valid as their environment changes. We present MIND (Maintenance via INstruction-conditioned Dependencies), a framework for maintaining target-room decisions without re-evaluating every room after each event. A language model compiles each instruction into dependencies for semantic qualification and target selection. The controller intersects semantic dependencies with event footprints, refreshes affected judgments, and updates reachability and selection separately. For fixed deterministic evaluation, planning, and selection, conservative dependency and footprint coverage preserves the decisions of full recomputation. On 240 five-event ProcTHOR sequences with an exact benchmark predicate, MIND reduces mean semantic evaluations from 30.6 to 11.2 while preserving all 1,200 post-event decisions. Frozen-evaluator experiments with Phi-4 and Qwen3-14B also preserve all 1,200 decisions, without improving the evaluators' underlying task accuracy. In 32 closed-loop AI2-THOR episodes using exact-predicate qualification and metadata-derived footprints, MIND matches the final target decision of full recomputation in every episode. Unitree G1 experiments demonstrate target reuse and reselection across room transitions without additional semantic evaluations under MIND, and abstention after a barrier and an object removal at 4 evaluations against 15 to 18. Additional materials are available at https://mind-icra27.github.io/.

    ENGLISH

    On-policy distillation provides dense supervision on the student's own samples, but its targets still come from the teacher. Verifier reinforcement learning (RL) instead uses an outcome signal, but it provides no direct constraint on capabilities outside the verifier. Combining the two is difficult for diffusion language models (dLLMs), because bidirectional denoising makes the policy likelihoods required by ratio-based RL unreliable. We develop a likelihood-free pipeline for a mixture-of-experts dLLM. Each rollout group is routed by verifier outcome. Mixed groups use ratio-free, group-centred REINFORCE. If every student rollout fails but a teacher succeeds, the model receives dense KL supervision on the student's denoising canvases. All other groups are skipped. A KL term anchored to the distilled checkpoint limits changes outside the verifier reward. The tool-calling teacher succeeds on only 18.6% of the training prompts. At 24 denoising steps, distillation exceeds the teacher by 6.77 percentage points, and routing improves the distilled checkpoint by a further 18.31 points. Routing lowers reasoning-trace accuracy by 0.71 points but raises direct-answer accuracy on the same items by 13.21 points. The anchored arm restores trace accuracy. Its tool-calling score differs by -0.16 points, with a confidence interval that includes zero, although this comparison also removes a small fallback distillation route. A domain-conditional recipe retains a 16.37-point tool-calling gain; a second seed gives 18.23 points and reproduces both preservation results, but the math result is seed-dependent. We pre-registered every arm and evaluated each comparison on paired items in a single sweep on one machine.
