    Dimension-Free Scaling Laws for Size Generalization: An Exponential Separation

    规模泛化的无维度缩放定律：一种指数级分离

    Behrooz Tahmasebi, Melanie Weber

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper establishes dimension-free scaling laws and matching lower bounds for transfer across input sizes, characterizing when size generalization has polynomial or exponential sample complexity. This is a substantial theoretical contribution to generalization across structured inputs, but it does not address model internals, reasoning, or system organization.

    本文建立了跨输入规模迁移的无维度缩放定律和相匹配的下界，刻画了规模泛化何时具有多项式或指数级样本复杂度。这是对结构化输入泛化理论的重要贡献，但没有涉及模型内部机制、推理或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Modern machine learning models increasingly operate on variable-size structured data, such as sets and graphs. A central requirement is \emph{size generalization}: the ability of a model trained on inputs of one size to generalize to inputs of a different, potentially much larger, size. Classical statistical learning theory, however, primarily considers fixed input domains, and its guarantees often deteriorate with input dimension. Although extensive work has established when models on sets and graphs can be transferred across input sizes, such results do not characterize the statistical cost of doing so: the sample complexity of size generalization, and its relationship to classical in-domain learning, remain largely unknown. We develop a statistical learning theory of size generalization and establish a sharp exponential separation in sample complexity. Letting $n$ denote the number of training samples, we show that polynomial source decay is insufficient for efficient size generalization: while it yields error $n^{-\Theta(1)}$ and hence polynomial sample complexity for in-domain learning, size-generalization error decays only as $(\log n)^{-\Theta(1)}$, yielding an exponential separation. Thus, polynomial in-domain sample complexity can become exponential across sizes. We then identify an exponential source condition under which size generalization achieves error $n^{-\Theta(1)}$, recovering polynomial sample complexity. These guarantees are independent of input dimension and depend only on the number of training samples, yielding dimension-free scaling laws. We also provide matching minimax lower bounds, establishing optimality. To our knowledge, this work provides the first dimension-free minimax theory of size generalization and a rigorous characterization of when, and at what statistical cost, learning can transfer across input sizes.

    中文

    现代机器学习模型越来越多地处理可变规模的结构化数据，例如集合和图。一个核心要求是\emph{规模泛化}：在一种规模的输入上训练的模型，能够泛化到规模不同、且可能大得多的输入。经典统计学习理论主要考虑固定的输入域，其保证往往会随着输入维度增大而减弱。尽管已有大量研究确定了集合和图上的模型何时可以迁移到不同输入规模，但这些结果并未刻画这一迁移的统计代价：规模泛化的样本复杂度及其与经典域内学习的关系，在很大程度上仍不清楚。我们建立了规模泛化的统计学习理论，并证明样本复杂度存在尖锐的指数级分离。令 $n$ 表示训练样本数，我们证明，多项式源衰减不足以实现高效的规模泛化：虽然它使误差达到 $n^{-\Theta(1)}$，从而令域内学习具有多项式样本复杂度，但规模泛化误差仅以 $(\log n)^{-\Theta(1)}$ 的速度衰减，因而产生指数级分离。因此，域内学习的多项式样本复杂度在跨规模迁移时可能变为指数级。接着，我们找到了一个指数源条件，在该条件下规模泛化的误差达到 $n^{-\Theta(1)}$，从而恢复多项式样本复杂度。这些保证与输入维度无关，只取决于训练样本数，因此得到无维度缩放定律。我们还给出了相匹配的极小极大下界，确立了结果的最优性。据我们所知，本工作首次为规模泛化提供了无维度极小极大理论，并严格刻画了学习何时能够跨输入规模迁移，以及其统计代价。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies history-aware model routing for stateful agents and shows how session context and asymmetric prompt-cache costs affect sequential routing decisions.     本文研究面向有状态智能体的历史感知模型路由，并展示会话上下文和非对称提示缓存成本如何影响序贯路由决策。其智能体架构和计算资源分配使其与 Systems 高度相关；跨轮次依赖是评估的一部分，但摘要并未声称在组合推理方面取得进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Model routing can reduce the cost of LLM applications by assigning simpler requests to cheaper models without sacrificing the quality of the response. However, most routers treat requests as independent. Stateful agents do not operate under this assumption: a user turn may require multiple model and tool calls, its difficulty depends on the state produced by earlier turns, and changing models can sacrifice reuse of the conversational prompt cache. We study zero-shot, cost-aware routing at the user-turn boundary, systematically varying the routing rule, access to session history, candidate models that differ in size, reasoning effort, or model provider, and prompt-cache behavior. We evaluate on multi-turn versions of SheetCopilot and SpreadsheetBench 2, where persistent workbooks and cross-turn dependencies make isolated routing decisions especially brittle. At a matched offloading rate, giving the router session history improves task pass rate over the same router without history, with gains for every model pair; history-aware routing remains within one point of always using the expensive model. We also found that cost depends on execution dynamics rather than token prices alone: the cheaper model's per-task cost advantage narrows from 6.8x to 3.2x on longer sessions. A closed form cache analysis further shows that downward switches (expensive to cheap) recover their cache cost within two LLM calls, whereas upward switches do not break even under the evaluated conditions. Together, these results show that agent routing is a sequential decision problem: effective policies must account for what happened earlier in the session and for the asymmetric cost of switching models.

    中文

    模型路由可以将较简单的请求分配给成本较低的模型，从而降低 LLM 应用的成本，同时不牺牲响应质量。然而，大多数路由器都将请求视为彼此独立。有状态智能体并非如此运作：一个用户轮次可能需要多次模型调用和工具调用，其难度取决于先前轮次产生的状态，而且更换模型可能导致无法复用对话提示缓存。我们研究了用户轮次边界上的零样本、成本感知路由，系统地改变路由规则、会话历史的可用性、在规模、推理力度或模型提供商方面各不相同的候选模型，以及提示缓存行为。我们在 SheetCopilot 和 SpreadsheetBench 2 的多轮版本上进行评估；持久化工作簿和跨轮次依赖使孤立的路由决策尤其脆弱。在卸载率相同的条件下，为路由器提供会话历史，比使用相同但不具备历史信息的路由器提高了任务通过率，且每一对模型都取得提升；具备历史信息的路由与始终使用昂贵模型相比，差距保持在一个百分点以内。我们还发现，成本取决于执行动态，而不仅仅是 token 价格：在较长会话中，较便宜模型的单任务成本优势从 6.8 倍缩小到 3.2 倍。闭式缓存分析进一步表明，向下切换（从昂贵模型切换到便宜模型）在两次 LLM 调用内即可收回缓存成本，而向上切换在所评估的条件下无法达到盈亏平衡。总之，这些结果表明，智能体路由是一个序贯决策问题：有效策略必须考虑会话中先前发生的事情，以及模型切换所带来的非对称成本。

    本文针对多轮智能体式 RL 开发了基于验证器诊断信息的奖励和完整性审计，显著提升了形式化代码验证和补丁交付能力。这推动了算法问题求解和智能体任务执行的训练；在未见语言上的评估表明存在迁移能力，但摘要的重点并非可复用的组合表示或内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning for code usually rewards passing tests, which a model can do while remaining wrong on the inputs the tests do not cover. A program verifier instead decides whether a program satisfies a formal specification for all inputs. Language models are almost always paired with verifiers at inference time only, and turning a verifier into a reward raises two difficulties. It reports only acceptance or rejection, which gives no gradient when every attempt fails, and a policy can cheat it, most simply by telling it to assume what the proof was supposed to establish. We build an agentic environment and reward that address both. The reward reads the verifier's diagnostics rather than its verdict, scoring a candidate by the weighted fraction of proof obligations it discharges, extended with hidden probes from a reference proof's annotations. An integrity audit outranks the verifier, rejecting any candidate that alters the specification or assumes what it was meant to prove. The model works as an agent against a live verifier over many turns, with a separately trained proof specialist as a frozen collaborator. Across Qwen3 models from 1.7B to 14B and a 35B Qwen3.6 mixture-of-experts model, held-out verification on code generation rises from 66.1% to 93.5% on DafnyBench and from 56.3% to 100% on SWE-Proof. This reward leads every other training signal we compare, including a binary pass-or-fail reward trained under otherwise identical settings, with the widest margin on code generation. When the agent must also deliver the repository patch, graded by each project's withheld tests, the fraction of held-out issues it resolves rises from 59.6% to 72.5%. Evaluated unchanged on three verification suites withheld from training, the checkpoints improve on all of them, including one whose language and verifier are absent from training.

    中文

    代码强化学习通常以通过测试作为奖励，但模型即使对测试未覆盖的输入仍然出错，也可能通过测试。程序验证器则判定程序是否对所有输入都满足形式化规范。语言模型几乎总是在推理时才与验证器配合使用；若要将验证器转化为奖励，则会面临两个难题。验证器只报告接受或拒绝；当所有尝试都失败时，这无法提供梯度，而且策略可能欺骗验证器，最简单的做法就是让它假设本应由证明确立的结论。我们构建了一个智能体环境和奖励机制来解决这两个问题。奖励机制读取验证器的诊断信息，而非判定结果，并根据候选程序完成的证明义务加权比例进行评分，同时纳入来自参考证明注释的隐藏探测项。完整性审计的优先级高于验证器；任何修改规范或假设本应证明内容的候选程序都会被拒绝。模型作为智能体，跨多个轮次与实时验证器交互，并由一个单独训练且冻结的证明专家协作。在从 1.7B 到 14B 的 Qwen3 模型以及 35B 的 Qwen3.6 混合专家模型上，代码生成的留出验证率在 DafnyBench 上从 66.1% 提升至 93.5%，在 SWE-Proof 上从 56.3% 提升至 100%。与我们比较的其他所有训练信号相比，该奖励效果更好，其中包括在其他设置完全相同的条件下训练的二元通过或失败奖励，且在代码生成任务上的优势最大。当智能体还必须提交仓库补丁，并依据各项目的留出测试进行评分时，它解决的留出问题比例从 59.6% 上升至 72.5%。在三个训练中未使用的验证套件上原样评估时，这些检查点在所有套件上都有提升，其中一个套件所用的语言和验证器均未出现在训练中。

    DTDD: Divergence-Triggered Dynamic Distillation for Reliable On-Policy Supervision

    DTDD：用于可靠在线策略监督的散度触发动态蒸馏

    Qijia He, Zequn Li, Spencer Luo, Tianle Chen, Pradyumna Narayana, Zixian Ma, Ranjay Krishna, Lan Nie, Sugato Basu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DTDD adaptively switches from on-policy distillation to teacher-generated recovery examples, with experiments showing faster math training and gains in long-horizon reasoning and agent tasks. This substantially advances reasoning training, while tool use and agent settings are evaluation regimes rather than a central systems contribution; no internal mechanism or compositional-generalization insight is claimed.

    DTDD 自适应地从在线策略蒸馏切换到教师生成的恢复示例；实验显示，它能加快数学任务训练，并提升长程推理和智能体任务表现。这实质性地推动了推理训练；工具使用和智能体设置属于评估场景，并非系统贡献的核心；论文也未声称揭示了内部机制或组合泛化方面的见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision on student rollouts, but this supervision can become unreliable when the student and teacher diverge, either because of a large initial policy gap or compounding errors in long-horizon reasoning and tool use. We introduce Divergence-Triggered Dynamic Distillation (DTDD), an adaptive OPD framework that uses segment-level student-teacher divergence to trigger teacher takeover during training. When divergence triggers an intervention during reasoning, the student prefix continues to receive standard OPD supervision. The teacher then generates a recovery suffix, which the student learns through behavior cloning, using cross-entropy on the teacher-generated tokens. We evaluate DTDD in three regimes: long-horizon reasoning, distillation from a base initialization without offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and multi-turn agents. We also compare alternative trigger designs and teacher-intervention rates. DTDD reduces the post-warmup peak gradient norm by $8.6\times$ and, from a base initialization, reaches $21.3\%$ held-out math accuracy in $2.6\times$ fewer optimizer updates than OPD; both methods finish near $22\%$. It improves best-observed performance by $4.8$ and $4.1$ percentage points on ALFWorld with LoRA and agentic code, respectively. Ablations show that segment-averaged triggers outperform token-spike triggers. Behavior cloning is also more effective than the tested OPD surrogate for training teacher-generated recoveries. Across 23 experimental arms, takeover tends to help when the teacher substantially outperforms the OPD-trained student, provided that the teacher can recover from student-visited states, the student can learn those recoveries, and teacher intervention is neither excessive nor insufficient.

    中文

    在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在学生模型的轨迹上提供密集的 token 级监督，但当学生模型与教师模型发生偏离时，这种监督可能变得不可靠；偏离可能源于较大的初始策略差距，也可能源于长程推理和工具使用中的错误累积。我们提出散度触发动态蒸馏（DTDD），这是一种自适应 OPD 框架，利用学生与教师之间的片段级散度，在训练过程中触发教师接管。当推理期间的散度触发干预时，学生模型的前缀仍接受标准 OPD 监督。随后，教师生成恢复后缀，学生通过行为克隆学习该后缀，即对教师生成的 token 使用交叉熵。我们在三种设置下评估 DTDD：长程推理、从基础初始化开始且不进行离线监督微调（SFT）的蒸馏，以及多轮智能体。我们还比较了不同的触发设计和教师干预率。DTDD 将预热后的峰值梯度范数降低了 $8.6\times$；从基础初始化开始时，它比 OPD 少用 $21.3\%$ 次优化器更新，就达到 $2.6\times$ 的留出数学准确率；两种方法最终都接近 $22\%$。在采用 LoRA 的 ALFWorld 和智能体式代码任务上，其观察到的最佳表现分别提升了 $4.8$ 和 $4.1$ 个百分点。消融实验表明，按片段平均的触发优于 token 尖峰触发。对于训练教师生成的恢复内容，行为克隆也比经过测试的 OPD 替代方法更有效。在 23 组实验中，当教师显著优于经 OPD 训练的学生时，接管往往有帮助，前提是教师能够从学生访问过的状态中恢复、学生能够学会这些恢复方式，并且教师干预既不过多也不过少。

    Why don't Graph Transformers attend to the same token?

    为什么图 Transformer 不会关注同一个 token？

    Alexandre Bismuth

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes what causes attention sinks in graph transformers, showing how attention scoring and node distinguishability affect sink formation and predictive importance. This is a substantial mechanistic study of model behavior, while its discussion of attention structure does not establish a broader contribution to composition, reasoning, or system organization.

    本文分析了图 Transformer 中注意力汇的成因，展示注意力评分和节点可区分性如何影响注意力汇的形成及其对预测的重要性。这是对模型行为的重要机制研究；不过，对注意力结构的讨论并未确立其在组合、推理或系统组织方面有更广泛的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In large language models (LLMs), attention concentrates heavily on the first token. This 'attention sink' is believed to protect deep models against over-mixing. Even though graph transformers face a related pressure, we find that a SoTA graph transformer, GRIT, rarely forms sinks on molecules, and that it sinks less when trained on larger graphs, the opposite of the trend in LLMs. In principle, a graph can prevent sinks: we prove and show empirically that its symmetry and locality limit the attention any node can receive. On molecules, however, with distinguishable atoms and global attention, neither limit prevents sinks; what stops them lies in the model. We find that the attention scoring function is the main cause. Replacing GRIT's gated logit with a dot product raises its sink rate from 0.09 to 0.68 on identical graphs. In Graph Transformers using dot-product attention, removing the sink gives about the same error as removing a random node, while GRIT's most-attended nodes matter to its predictions. Attention sinks are therefore a property of dot-product attention rather than of Transformers. In our experiments, they form when dot-product scoring has a distinguishable node to concentrate on.

    中文

    在大型语言模型（LLM）中，注意力高度集中于第一个 token。这种“注意力汇”被认为能保护深层模型免于过度混合。尽管图 Transformer 面临类似压力，我们发现，先进的图 Transformer GRIT 在分子上很少形成注意力汇，而且在更大的图上训练时，注意力汇更少，这与 LLM 中的趋势相反。原则上，图可以阻止注意力汇：我们通过证明和实证表明，其对称性和局部性限制了任一节点能够获得的注意力。然而，在具有可区分原子和全局注意力的分子上，这两种限制都无法阻止注意力汇；阻止注意力汇的因素来自模型本身。我们发现，注意力评分函数是主要原因。在相同图上，将 GRIT 的门控 logit 替换为点积后，其注意力汇比例从 0.09 升至 0.68。在采用点积注意力的图 Transformer 中，移除注意力汇造成的误差与移除随机节点造成的误差大致相同；而 GRIT 中最受关注的节点会影响其预测。因此，注意力汇是点积注意力的属性，而非 Transformer 的属性。在我们的实验中，当点积评分有一个可区分的节点可供集中关注时，就会形成注意力汇。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies how guided starts and handoff rules shape GRPO training for long-horizon agents, finding that outcome-informed tool-call selection improves task completion. Curriculum structure has an incidental connection to composition, but the abstract does not establish compositional generalization or internal mechanisms.

    本文研究引导式起始和交接规则如何影响长程智能体的 GRPO 训练，并发现依据结果选择工具调用能够提升任务完成率。课程结构与组合能力存在间接联系，但摘要并未确立组合泛化或内部机制方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) provides no reward-relative learning signal when all rollouts receive identical rewards. In long-horizon tasks that require multiple interactions, rewards are given only upon successful task completion, making all-fail groups common early in training and limiting opportunities to practice later steps. Guide Assisted GRPO replays a successful reference prefix before the learner continues. We study how initial positions, handoff units, and movement rules affect unassisted task completion. Across three model sizes on BFCL, starting near completion is more effective under a fixed turn-level threshold rule. Finer handoffs alone do not consistently help, but outcome-informed tool-call selection outperforms GRPO on trained and untrained task categories. Guided starts also improve AppWorld success on both evaluation splits. These findings highlight where learning starts and how starting positions move as key curriculum choices.

    中文

    当所有轨迹获得相同奖励时，组相对策略优化（GRPO）无法提供相对于奖励的学习信号。在需要多次交互的长程任务中，只有成功完成任务时才会给出奖励，因此训练早期所有尝试都失败的组很常见，限制了模型练习后续步骤的机会。引导辅助 GRPO 会先重放成功参考轨迹的前缀，再由学习者继续完成任务。我们研究初始位置、交接单位和移动规则如何影响无辅助任务完成情况。在 BFCL 的三种模型规模上，在固定的轮次级阈值规则下，从接近完成的位置开始效果更好。单独采用更细粒度的交接并不总是有帮助，但依据结果选择工具调用，优于在已训练和未训练的任务类别上使用 GRPO。引导式起始也提升了 AppWorld 两个评估划分上的成功率。这些发现凸显了学习从哪里开始，以及起始位置如何移动，是课程设计中的关键选择。

    Steering Vectors for Competing Ethical Frameworks Are Interchangeable: A Competing-Target Test for Activation Steering

    针对相互竞争的伦理框架，转向向量可以互换：一种用于激活转向的竞争目标检验

    Weilun Xu (EPFL), Zipeng Sun (McGill University and Mila)

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The competing-target test shows that activation-steering vectors for ethical frameworks largely share a direction and can control a mixture of neighboring behaviors, offering transferable evidence about what hidden-state interventions control. This supports mechanistic interpretability, while the paper does not study composition, reasoning mechanisms, or system organization.

    竞争目标检验表明，针对伦理框架的激活转向向量在很大程度上共享相同方向，并可能控制相邻行为的混合，从而为隐藏状态干预究竟控制什么提供了可迁移的证据。这支持机制可解释性；不过，论文没有研究组合能力、推理机制或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Activation steering adds a vector to a model's hidden states to control a named behaviour. A gain on that behaviour, however, does not show that the vector controls it directly: it may act through a component shared with neighbouring behaviours, which unsteered and random baselines cannot separate. We introduce the competing-target test: a vector is compared with the vector built the same way for a competing target, and an equivalence test states when their difference is below a useful margin. We apply it in open-weight models to vectors for Kantian deontology, which judges an act by the rule it follows, and act utilitarianism, which judges it by the welfare it produces. On held-out situations, prompting a framework raises its score and lowers the other's, whereas vectors for either framework move both scores alike, and none reaches the margin. The two vectors share most of their direction, a request to apply some framework; the same construction separates an optimistic from a pessimistic tone, whose vectors share much less. What a vector shares with its competitors therefore sets what it controls: steering a perspective can deliver a mixture, and measuring a disposition can measure its neighbours, unless tested against the competing target.

    中文

    激活转向会向模型的隐藏状态添加一个向量，以控制某种指定行为。然而，该行为上的提升并不能证明该向量直接控制了它：向量可能通过与相邻行为共享的成分发挥作用，而未进行转向的基线和随机基线无法区分这种情况。我们提出竞争目标检验：将一个向量与以相同方式为竞争目标构造的向量进行比较，并通过等效性检验判定二者差异何时低于有实际意义的阈值。我们在开放权重模型中，将该方法用于康德义务论和行为功利主义对应的向量：前者根据行为遵循的规则进行评判，后者根据行为产生的福祉进行评判。在留出情境中，提示模型采用某一框架会提高该框架的得分并降低另一框架的得分；而任一框架对应的向量都会以相似方式改变两个得分，且都未达到该阈值。这两个向量的大部分方向相同，都在要求应用某种框架；同样的构造方法能够区分乐观和悲观语气，其向量的共享方向则少得多。因此，向量与竞争目标共享的部分决定了它控制什么：转向某种视角可能带来混合效果，测量某种倾向也可能测到其相邻倾向，除非用竞争目标进行检验。

    Tail Competition Explains Scaling in Best-of-N Sampling for Verifiable Problems

    尾部竞争解释可验证问题中 Best-of-N 采样的缩放规律

    Taro Yano, Yoichi Ishibashi, Masafumi Oyamada

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses extreme value theory to characterize how reward-tail competition affects Best-of-N scaling and proposes a diagnostic for harmful sampling regimes. This strongly advances reasoning-time scaling, while the sampling setup alone gives only an incidental connection to model systems and none to internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文利用极值理论刻画奖励尾部竞争如何影响 Best-of-N 的扩展效果，并提出诊断有害采样情形的方法。这有力推动了推理时扩展研究；采样设置本身与模型系统仅有间接联系，也未涉及内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Best-of-N sampling is a simple inference-time scaling strategy for large language models, yet its behavior under incomplete reward models remains poorly understood. We study Best-of-N as a competition between the extreme reward tails of correct and incorrect responses. This view shows that success depends not only on the probability of sampling a correct response, but also on whether correct responses dominate incorrect ones in the upper tail. Using extreme value theory, we characterize three asymptotic regimes: correct-tail-dominant, incorrect-tail-dominant, and critical explaining both monotonic gains and reward-hacking-induced degradation. We further derive finite-sample scaling laws for representative reward distributions, showing that, under Gaussian rewards, incorrect responses with sufficiently large variance can dominate selection even when their mean reward is lower. Unlike oracle selection, convergence with an incomplete selector can be polynomial rather than exponential. Finally, we propose a lightweight tail-tension criterion to estimate when additional sampling may become harmful. Experiments on synthetic data and real reward model scores are consistent with the theoretically predicted regimes, scaling laws, and diagnostic behavior, suggesting that tail competition provides a unified lens on Best-of-N sampling for verifiable problems.

    中文

    Best-of-N 采样是大型语言模型一种简单的推理时扩展策略，但在奖励模型不完整时，其表现仍缺乏充分理解。我们将 Best-of-N 视为正确响应与错误响应的极端奖励尾部之间的竞争。这一视角表明，成功不仅取决于采样到正确响应的概率，也取决于正确响应是否在上尾部占优。利用极值理论，我们刻画了三种渐近情形：正确响应尾部占优、错误响应尾部占优，以及临界情形；它们解释了单调提升和奖励黑客行为导致的性能退化。我们进一步推导了代表性奖励分布下的有限样本缩放定律，并表明在高斯奖励下，即使错误响应的平均奖励较低，只要其方差足够大，也可能在选择中占优。与预言机选择不同，使用不完整选择器时，收敛速度可能是多项式而非指数级。最后，我们提出一种轻量级的尾部张力判据，用于估计进一步采样何时可能有害。在合成数据和真实奖励模型分数上的实验结果，与理论预测的情形、缩放定律和诊断表现一致，表明尾部竞争为可验证问题中的 Best-of-N 采样提供了统一的分析视角。

    本文根据多模态智能体记忆中信息的表示方式及记忆策略的演进方式对其进行组织，并为长程使用提出设计原则。对记忆机制的归纳与 Systems 高度相关；论文将表示作为框架的一部分加以讨论，但摘要没有直接分析模型内部表征，因此与 MechInterp 的关联有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal models and agents have emerged to enable AI systems to learn from and interact with the real world more like humans by integrating information across multiple modalities. However, enabling multimodal agents to continually acquire useful information from complex, heterogeneous multimodal data remains a significant challenge as they move toward long-horizon tasks and lifelong settings. Addressing this challenge requires effective memory mechanisms that can maintain continuity across sessions, adapt to changing users and environments, and refine memory-management policies through accumulated experience. We introduce a two-axis analytical framework for multimodal agent memory structured around two key questions: how multimodal information is formed and represented (Axis I, Formation and Representation), and how its management adapts with accumulated experience (Axis II, Memory Management). Axis I, Formation and Representation, characterizes what information is retained and how it is encoded (e.g., modality-specific embeddings, textual and structured records, latent and parametric representations) to support subsequent reasoning and action. Axis II, Memory Management, distinguishes three tiers: T1 Static Memory reuses fixed memory; T2 Dynamic Memory updates memory through a stable policy; and T3 Self-Evolving Memory updates memory through an evolving policy. Based on this framework, we synthesize recurring design patterns and derive principles for balancing source fidelity with abstraction, maintaining temporal validity and provenance, grounding memory use in recoverable evidence, and evolving memory policies over time. Furthermore, we discuss the challenges and potential future directions for the memory mechanism of multimodal agents.

    中文

    多模态模型和智能体应运而生，旨在通过整合多种模态的信息，使 AI 系统能够像人类一样从现实世界中学习并与之交互。然而，随着多模态智能体迈向长程任务和终身学习场景，如何使其持续从复杂、异质的多模态数据中获取有用信息，仍是一项重大挑战。应对这一挑战需要有效的记忆机制，以维持跨会话的连续性、适应不断变化的用户和环境，并通过积累的经验改进记忆管理策略。我们提出一个关于多模态智能体记忆的双轴分析框架，围绕两个关键问题展开：多模态信息如何形成和表示（轴 I：形成与表示），以及其管理如何随着经验积累而调整（轴 II：记忆管理）。轴 I“形成与表示”刻画保留哪些信息以及如何编码这些信息（例如，特定模态的嵌入、文本和结构化记录、潜在表征和参数化表征），以支持后续推理和行动。轴 II“记忆管理”分为三个层级：T1 静态记忆复用固定记忆；T2 动态记忆通过稳定策略更新记忆；T3 自演进记忆通过不断演进的策略更新记忆。基于这一框架，我们归纳了反复出现的设计模式，并提出若干原则：在来源保真度与抽象之间取得平衡，保持时间有效性和来源信息，使记忆使用以可恢复的证据为依据，并随时间演进记忆策略。此外，我们还讨论了多模态智能体记忆机制面临的挑战和未来可能的发展方向。

    Policy-Verified Self-Training: Learning Agent Compliance from Verifiable Policy Rewards

    策略验证自训练：从可验证的策略奖励中学习智能体合规性

    Min-Young Yu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces self-training from executable policy-verifier rewards and tests whether this improves agent compliance under prompt injection. Its main contribution is a transferable agent-training method, so Systems scores strongly; reasoning is incidental because the evaluation concerns policy compliance rather than reasoning or problem-solving.

    本文提出从可执行的策略验证器奖励中进行自训练，并检验这种方法能否提升智能体在提示注入下的合规性。其主要贡献是一种可迁移的智能体训练方法，因此系统方向得分较高；推理只是附带内容，因为评估关注的是策略合规性，而非推理或问题求解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Runtime policy verifiers can prevent agents from executing disallowed actions, but their decisions are typically used only for enforcement and discarded afterward. We ask whether these decisions can instead become verifiable policy rewards for training the agents they guard. We introduce Policy-Verified Self-Training (PVST), a post-training paradigm in which an agent generates its own interaction trajectories and an executable policy verifier, here a deterministic gate compiled from a written policy, evaluates whether each action complies. Compliant trajectories are reinforced, and violations become negatives for preference optimization; beyond the gate and the benchmark's task-success signal, PVST needs no stronger teacher model, no human preference labels and no attack-specific supervision, although rollouts are collected in the benchmark's attacked environment. On held-out AgentDojo tasks under prompt injection, policy-verified preference training of Qwen3-8B reduces violating trajectories from 37.2% to 10.3 $\pm$ 0.9% (three seeds) and successful attacks from 12.4% to 0.5% at equal or higher pooled task utility, although utility falls on travel, compared with 22.0% when negatives are selected by an attack oracle and 31.9 $\pm$ 0.9% with negatives that contain no violation. The learned behavior holds under an attack template never used in training (37.7% to 11.0%) and on a suite excluded from training (34.8% to 16.7%), and the retained verifier's intervention rate falls from 39.2% to 8.8% (seed 0). Our analysis identifies two conditions under which the verdict is most informative: success must not already imply compliance, and guarded actions must appear in both permitted and forbidden contexts.

    中文

    运行时策略验证器可以阻止智能体执行不允许的操作，但其决策通常仅用于强制执行，之后便被丢弃。我们探讨这些决策能否转而成为可验证的策略奖励，用来训练它们所保护的智能体。我们提出策略验证自训练（PVST），这是一种后训练范式：智能体生成自己的交互轨迹，而可执行的策略验证器（此处为根据书面策略编译而成的确定性门控器）则评估每个操作是否合规。合规轨迹得到强化，违规行为则作为偏好优化的负例；除了门控器和基准测试的任务成功信号外，PVST 不需要更强的教师模型、人工偏好标签或针对攻击的监督信号，不过收集 rollout 的环境是基准测试中的受攻击环境。在提示注入条件下的留出 AgentDojo 任务中，经策略验证的偏好训练使 Qwen3-8B 的违规轨迹比例从 37.2% 降至 10.3 $\pm$ 0.9%（三个随机种子），成功攻击比例从 12.4% 降至 0.5%，同时汇总任务效用持平或更高，尽管旅行任务上的效用有所下降；作为对比，使用攻击预言机选择负例时，违规轨迹比例为 22.0%，而使用不含违规行为的负例时为 31.9 $\pm$ 0.9%。学习到的行为在训练中从未使用过的攻击模板下（从 37.7% 降至 11.0%）以及未纳入训练的测试套件上（从 34.8% 降至 16.7%）仍然成立，并且保留的验证器的干预率（seed 0）从 39.2% 降至 8.8%。我们的分析指出，在两种情况下，判定信息量最大：成功本身不能已经意味着合规，且受保护的操作必须同时出现在允许和禁止的情境中。

    Tianle Chen, Pushkar Singh, Ketan Todi, Biswajit Paria, Qijia He, Wenqi Wang, Yuwen Tan, Jike Zhong, Sugato Basu, Deepti Ghadiyaram, and Arjun Akula

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DeLoop uses rollout-derived preferences to train long-horizon agents to avoid repeated tool actions, substantially reducing loops and steps while preserving or improving task success. Its incidental connection to learning from action sequences does not establish compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms, and it does not analyze internal representations.

    DeLoop 使用从 rollout 中导出的偏好训练长时程智能体，使其避免重复的工具操作，在保持或提升任务成功率的同时，大幅减少循环和步数。它与从动作序列中学习只有附带关联，并未证明组合泛化或推理机制，也没有分析内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language-model agents that run long tasks often redo work they have already done: they re-issue a tool call they made earlier and get back exactly the same observation, a step that adds no new information. We identify this failure as a loop. Loops appear natively in Qwen, Llama, and Gemini agents and become far more common once the agent's history is compressed to fit its context window. To reduce these loops, we propose DeLoop, a self-supervised training method. DeLoop builds on a simple observation: the agent's own rollout can provide the supervision needed to learn from its loops. We use a looping action as a negative example and the first later non-looping action in the same rollout as a positive example. DeLoop learns from these pairs through direct preference optimization and does not require task rewards, gold answers, or LLM judges. On CodeGym under compression, DeLoop reduces the share of Qwen3-8B tasks containing loops from 57.3% to 6.1%. It also uses about one third as many steps per task, with similar task success. On Qwen3-32B, DeLoop reduces loops and steps while raising task success from 37.7% to 44.8%.

    中文

    执行长任务的语言模型智能体常常会重复已经做过的工作：再次发出先前发过的工具调用，并得到完全相同的观察结果，这一步不会带来任何新信息。我们将这种失效称为循环。Qwen、Llama 和 Gemini 智能体原生就会出现循环；当智能体的历史记录被压缩以适应上下文窗口时，循环会变得常见得多。为减少循环，我们提出 DeLoop，一种自监督训练方法。DeLoop 基于一个简单的观察：智能体自己的 rollout 可以提供从循环中学习所需的监督信号。我们将循环操作作为负例，并将同一 rollout 中之后首次出现的非循环操作作为正例。DeLoop 通过直接偏好优化从这些配对中学习，无需任务奖励、标准答案或 LLM 评判器。在经过压缩的 CodeGym 环境中，DeLoop 将包含循环的 Qwen3-8B 任务比例从 57.3% 降至 6.1%。它完成每项任务所用的步数也约为原来的三分之一，同时任务成功率相近。在 Qwen3-32B 上，DeLoop 减少了循环和步数，并将任务成功率从 37.7% 提高至 44.8%。

    Robust Explanatory Analysis for Structured Optimization Networks (REASON) in Learning

    学习中的结构化优化网络鲁棒解释性分析（REASON）

    Vahid Jebraeeli, Hamid Krim, Keisuke Fujii

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    REASON proposes a two-loop inference method in which residual error triggers active evidence acquisition, with a provable comparison to the fast loop and empirical gains under shift at reduced computation versus the medium loop. Its main contribution advances adaptive problem solving, while the System 1/System 2 framing and computational organization do not establish internal model mechanisms or composition.

    REASON 提出一种双循环推理方法，由残差误差触发主动证据获取；该方法给出了与快速循环的可证明比较，并在分布偏移下取得实证增益，且与中速循环相比计算量更低。其主要贡献推动了自适应问题求解；系统 1/系统 2 的表述和计算组织并未证明模型内部机制或组合能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We seek a hierarchical resolution of residual error under a composite learning objective as a principled mechanism for identifying and exploiting additional information, particularly under distribution shift and perturbation. Inspired by the System 1/System 2 paradigm, we formulate this principle as a two-loop mechanism serving a common inference goal. A fast, System 1-like loop resolves the residual addressable by the available evidence; the remaining epistemic residual triggers a medium speed, System 2-like loop that actively acquires additional evidence and measures its informational value through residual reduction. Over nested solution spaces, the medium-loop optimum is provably no worse than the fast-loop optimum. Experiments show that the resulting two-loop model consistently improves upon the fast loop at approximately half the computation of the medium loop, including under unseen corruptions, and, when provided a cleaner observation, outperforms staged classifiers and learning-to-defer methods at equal computational cost.

    中文

    我们希望在复合学习目标下分层消解残差误差，并将其作为识别和利用额外信息的一种有原则的机制，尤其是在分布偏移和扰动条件下。受系统 1/系统 2 范式启发，我们将这一原则表述为服务于共同推理目标的双循环机制。快速的、类似系统 1 的循环会消解现有证据所能处理的残差；剩余的认知残差则触发一个中速的、类似系统 2 的循环，该循环主动获取额外证据，并通过残差减少量衡量其信息价值。在嵌套的解空间上，中速循环的最优解可证明不劣于快速循环的最优解。实验表明，所得双循环模型在各种情况下都优于快速循环，所需计算量约为中速循环的一半，其中包括面对未见过的损坏时；在提供更干净的观察结果时，它还以相同计算成本胜过分阶段分类器和延迟决策学习方法。

    SkillGrain learns which atomic feedback rules transfer to future requests and jointly optimizes skill induction and skill-conditioned generation, with cross-request evaluation. This directly advances reusable composition and personalized memory-like skill systems; reinforcement learning and credit assignment support the method, but the abstract does not center general reasoning or internal representations.

    SkillGrain 学习哪些原子反馈规则能够迁移到未来请求，并联合优化技能归纳和技能条件生成，同时进行跨请求评估。这直接推动了可复用组合以及类似记忆的个性化技能系统；强化学习和信用分配为该方法提供支持，但摘要并未以通用推理或内部表征为核心。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    User feedback enables LLMs to refine reusable personalized skills, but often mixes persistent preferences with request-specific corrections. Indiscriminately retaining both risks negative transfer, motivating selective retention at the level of individual requirements. We frame this challenge as selective transfer over atomic rules and propose SkillGrain, a framework for learning reusable personalized skills from user feedback. SkillGrain decomposes feedback into independently actionable rules, predicts their transferability, and retains only those suitable for future requests. To learn these decisions, we combine rubric-guided skill rewards with fine-grained credit assignment that separately evaluates rule content and retention decisions. We further jointly optimize skill induction and skill-conditioned generation through reinforcement learning, ensuring that learned skills support downstream personalization. We construct a benchmark spanning five personalized writing tasks to evaluate cross-request generalization. Experiments across three base models in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings show that SkillGrain achieves the best overall average performance among competing methods.

    中文

    用户反馈使 LLM 能够改进可复用的个性化技能，但反馈中往往混杂着持久偏好和针对特定请求的修正。不加区分地保留两者可能导致负迁移，因此需要在单项要求层面进行选择性保留。我们将这一挑战表述为针对原子规则的选择性迁移，并提出 SkillGrain，这是一种从用户反馈中学习可复用个性化技能的框架。SkillGrain 将反馈拆解为可独立执行的规则，预测这些规则的可迁移性，并仅保留适用于未来请求的规则。为学习这些决策，我们将基于评分细则的技能奖励与细粒度信用分配相结合，分别评估规则内容和保留决策。我们还通过强化学习联合优化技能归纳和技能条件生成，确保学到的技能能够支持下游个性化。我们构建了一个涵盖五项个性化写作任务的基准，用于评估跨请求泛化。在领域内和领域外设置下对三个基础模型进行的实验表明，SkillGrain 在各竞争方法中取得了最佳的总体平均性能。

    RA$^2$: Retain-Anchored Attraction Preserves Forget-Adjacent Utility in LLM Unlearning

    RA$^2$：保留锚定吸引力在 LLM 遗忘中保留遗忘邻近效用

    Zinan Ling, Yang Xiao, Ruimeng Ye, Sijia Liu, Bo Hui

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RA² redirects forget-token representations toward nearby retain-supported states, and its results support a mechanistic claim that this migration direction preserves benign behavior near the forgotten domain. The work also touches reasoning utility, but its main contribution is latent-space unlearning rather than a general advance in reasoning methods.

    RA² 将遗忘 token 表征重新引导至邻近的、由保留数据支持的状态，其结果支持一个机制层面的主张：这种迁移方向能够保留被遗忘领域附近的良性行为。该研究也涉及推理效用，但其主要贡献是潜在空间遗忘，而非对通用推理方法的推进。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Model (LLM) unlearning is often evaluated primarily by target suppression and clean retain utility. These metrics can miss a local failure mode: a model may perform well on standard retain prompts, yet degrade on benign reasoning when prompts lie near the forgotten domain. This phenomenon is termed forget-adjacent utility loss. A fundamental question is: where should forget representations go after they leave the removed behavior? Successful unlearning depends not only on whether forget-conditioned representations depart from the harmful computation, but also on the direction in which they are redirected afterward. We propose RA$^2$ (Retain-Anchored Attraction), a latent-space unlearning method that redirects forget-token states toward nearby retain-supported representations while preserving higher-layer behavior on retain data. On WMDP and MUSE, RA$^2$ yields higher forget-adjacent utility than strong unlearning baselines at similar broad-utility levels. These results show that the migration direction of forget representations materially affects benign behavior near the forget boundary. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZacLing/retain_anchored_attraction.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）遗忘通常主要根据目标抑制效果和干净保留数据上的效用进行评估。这些指标可能遗漏一种局部失效模式：模型在标准保留提示上表现良好，但当提示接近被遗忘领域时，其良性推理能力却会下降。这种现象称为遗忘邻近效用损失。一个根本问题是：遗忘表征脱离被移除的行为后应当去往何处？成功的遗忘不仅取决于受遗忘条件影响的表征是否脱离有害计算，也取决于它们之后被重新引导的方向。我们提出 RA$^2$（保留锚定吸引力），一种潜在空间遗忘方法，将遗忘 token 状态重新引导至邻近的、由保留数据支持的表征，同时保留模型在保留数据上的高层行为。在 WMDP 和 MUSE 上，RA$^2$在总体效用水平相近时，取得了高于强力遗忘基线的遗忘邻近效用。这些结果表明，遗忘表征的迁移方向会实质性地影响遗忘边界附近的良性行为。我们的代码见 https://github.com/ZacLing/retain_anchored_attraction。

    EpiGuard: An Autonomous Infectious-Disease Early Warning Agent Platform

    EpiGuard：自主传染病预警智能体平台

    Tonglong Wei, Zheng Yuan, Lingshuai Lin, Yuhui Yao, Xing Xie, Na Zou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EpiGuard describes an autonomous agent that adapts its analysis to evidence availability and reuses stored procedures to generalize to unseen diseases and regions. This is a substantial agent-system contribution and offers partial insight into reusable composition, while forecasting performance alone does not establish a reasoning-mechanism contribution.

    EpiGuard 描述了一种自主智能体，它会根据证据可用性调整分析方式，并复用已保存的流程，将能力泛化至未见过的疾病和地区。这是对智能体系统的重要贡献，也对可复用组合提供了一定启示；但仅凭预测性能并不能证明其对推理机制有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Infectious disease outbreaks often spread rapidly before signs of widespread transmission become apparent, leaving a big challenge for rapid response and effective intervention. However, current infectious-disease early-warning systems face three major challenges: fragmented epidemiological evidence across diverse surveillance sources, highly uneven data availability across diseases and geographic regions, and delayed warning procedure caused by manual data collection, analysis, and reporting. To address these challenges, we present EpiGuard, an autonomous, continually self-improving agentic platform for timely and reliable early warning of more than 50 infectious diseases across different regions. EpiGuard proactively monitors and captures newly released official surveillance records, using the latest available evidence for risk assessments. It dynamically adjusts its analytical strategy across three evidence availability regimes, enabling reliable risk assessment under diverse data conditions, ranging from the absence of historical observations to sparse and abundant evidence. Moreover, EpiGuard learns from the successful execution process by preserving effective data-acquisition and analytical procedures as reusable standard operating procedures, enabling it to progressively generalize to previously unseen diseases and regions. We use officially released infectious-disease surveillance data from the China CDC and the United States CDC to evaluate EpiGuard's effectiveness. Experimental results demonstrate that EpiGuard outperforms state-of-the-art forecasting systems, improving forecasting performance by 9.68% and 14.04% on the China CDC and U.S. CDC datasets, respectively.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper characterizes how tensor and pipeline parallelism affect LLM serving throughput, latency, and SLO attainment across workloads and context lengths. Its systematic guidance for configuring distributed inference is a substantial systems contribution, without investigating model internals or reasoning.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Model (LLM) serving systems must balance latency and throughput while efficiently utilizing distributed GPU resources. This challenge arises because inference consists of two fundamentally different phases: prefill, which determines time-to-first-token (TTFT), and decode, which determines inter-token latency (ITL). The use of tensor parallelism (TP), pipeline parallelism (PP), and hybrid configurations exposes different trade-offs between these latency dimensions, making the optimal parallelism configuration highly dependent on workload characteristics, latency requirements, and context length. Moreover, despite the widespread adoption of distributed inference, there is still limited understanding of how parallelism configurations should be selected under varying workload conditions and service-level objectives (SLO). In this paper, we develop a systematic framework for characterizing LLM inference parallelism via throughput-latency trade-offs, SLO-aware serving, and long-context scalability. We introduce the notion of parallelism operating regions by constructing TTFT-ITL feasible sets and Pareto frontiers across different workload compositions, thereby revealing a systematic transition from TP-dominant to PP-dominant configurations as workloads become increasingly prefill-heavy. We further formulate SLO-aware parallelism selection using goodput, showing that stringent TTFT requirements favor PP-dominated configurations, whereas relaxed latency constraints progressively shift the optimality toward TP-dominated configurations with higher serving capacity. Finally, we demonstrate that increasing context length fundamentally changes the relative advantages of parallelism configurations, with PP-dominant configurations exhibiting more favorable scalability and SLO attainment in the long-context regime.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）服务系统必须在延迟和吞吐量之间取得平衡，同时高效利用分布式 GPU 资源。这一挑战源于推理包含两个本质不同的阶段：决定首 token 时间（TTFT）的预填充阶段，以及决定 token 间延迟（ITL）的解码阶段。采用张量并行（TP）、流水线并行（PP）和混合配置会在这些延迟维度之间产生不同的权衡，因此最优并行配置高度依赖工作负载特征、延迟要求和上下文长度。此外，尽管分布式推理已被广泛采用，人们对于如何在不同工作负载条件和服务级别目标（SLO）下选择并行配置仍知之甚少。本文提出一个系统框架，通过吞吐量与延迟的权衡、SLO 感知服务以及长上下文可扩展性来刻画 LLM 推理并行化。我们通过针对不同工作负载组合构建 TTFT-ITL 可行集和帕累托前沿，引入并行化运行区域的概念，从而揭示：随着工作负载中的预填充计算占比不断增加，配置会从以 TP 为主系统地转向以 PP 为主。我们进一步利用有效吞吐量（goodput）构建 SLO 感知的并行化选择方法，表明严格的 TTFT 要求有利于以 PP 为主的配置，而较宽松的延迟约束会逐步使最优选择转向服务能力更高、以 TP 为主的配置。最后，我们证明上下文长度的增加会从根本上改变不同并行配置的相对优势：在长上下文场景中，以 PP 为主的配置具有更好的可扩展性和 SLO 达成能力。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AgentSafeEvo 通过强化学习博弈训练攻击者和防御者，并依据防御者奖励的变化情况对任务进行加权，从而提升使用工具的智能体在遭受攻击时的安全性。其主要贡献推动了智能体训练和鲁棒性；任何与组合或推理的联系都只是任务中的附带因素，并未得到直接研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents accomplish complex tasks through multi-turn interactions with external tools. However, malicious content embedded in user queries, tool descriptions, or environment observations can manipulate their decisions and induce unsafe actions. Adversarial co-evolution has emerged as an effective approach to strengthening LLM safety, but existing work primarily focuses on language-level safety or indirect prompt injection in web tasks. In this paper, we introduce AgentSafeEvo, a co-evolutionary reinforcement learning framework for agent safety built on an attacker-defender game spanning diverse tasks and attack types. The attacker learns to construct adversarial agent tasks that expose weaknesses in the defender's tool use, while the defender learns to complete tasks safely under these attacks. We further introduce learnability-guided task weighting, which uses within-task defender-reward variability to adjust each task's contribution to attacker and defender updates. Extensive experiments on agent safety and general capability benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves adversarial robustness while maintaining general agent capabilities.

    超越试错循环：面向分布式训练的混合投影与自动调优

    Anshu Raina, Peyman Razaghi, Yuankai Chen, Cheng Yao, Yao Fu, Vidushi Goyal, Devang Patel, Wen Xie, Zhenyu Gu, Emad Barsoum

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Primus Projection estimates distributed training performance, and its tuning agent searches configurations using that estimate to improve throughput while reducing costly trial and error. This is a substantial contribution to training systems and optimization, but the abstract presents no substantive insight into model reasoning, representations, or composition.

    Primus Projection 用于估算分布式训练性能，其调优智能体利用该估算搜索配置，以提升吞吐量并减少代价高昂的试错。这是对训练系统和优化的重要贡献，但摘要未提供关于模型推理、表征或组合的实质性见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Configuring distributed LLM training across hundreds of GPUs requires jointly optimizing tensor, pipeline, expert, context, and data parallelism alongside micro-batch size, recomputation, sharding, and overlap, a combinatorial space where memory legality can hinge on a single byte of activation accounting. Today, teams navigate it through expensive multi-node trial and error, burning GPU-hours on crashes and suboptimal recipes. We present Primus Projection, which closes this loop with two coupled components. First, a hybrid projection engine that measures what it can and simulates what it cannot: GPU microbenchmarks on as few as a single device capture compute kernels and any in-scope communication; a sub-node downscale-measure-upscale workflow analytically restores out-of-scope collectives, FSDP overlap, and the full pipeline schedule at the multi-node target. A pure simulation mode runs entirely on CPU, enabling pre-silicon planning without any GPU. Second, the Primus Tuning Agent treats the projection engine as a fast scoring oracle (seconds per candidate instead of tens of minutes) and uses it to drive an intelligent search over the configuration space. A deterministic seed planner sweeps single axes; an LLM investigation loop proposes cross-axis combinations the planner cannot reach, with an analytic memory pre-filter that rejects infeasible candidates before any GPU time is spent. Validated on Llama 3.1 (dense) and Mixtral 8x22B (MoE) across two GPU generations, all projections stay within ~10% of measured multi-node throughput, and fidelity holds at production scale: 4.7% error on DeepSeek V3 671B at 1,024 GPUs and 1.9% on Qwen3-235B-A22B at 256 GPUs. In a Mixtral 8x22B case study, the Primus Tuning Agent discovers a configuration delivering +27% throughput over the published 4-node BF16 reference at the same scale, in under 30 minutes of single-node exploration.

    Agentic capabilities are increasingly important for modern LLMs, yet remain difficult to evaluate during pretraining. Existing approaches typically rely on static trajectory-derived tasks or likelihood-based proxies, which are lightweight but provide limited visibility into how base models behave in interactive environments. We introduce ASAP (Agent Scaffold Adaptation for Pretraining Evaluation), a lightweight framework for eliciting and evaluating agentic behavior from pretrained base models on end-to-end tasks. Rather than converting base models into chat-style agents, ASAP preserves the completion interface and adapts existing agent scaffolds through structured trajectory continuation, short reference prefixes, and minimal recovery mechanisms. Across software-engineering and deep-research benchmarks, ASAP yields discriminative end-to-end performance across base models and pretraining checkpoints. Beyond aggregate scores, ASAP exposes model-generated execution trajectories, enabling analysis of exploration, editing, testing, recovery, and task completion across training stages. These trajectories provide a behavioral view of how agent-relevant capabilities change during pretraining and how execution patterns differ after post-training. Our results suggest that end-to-end agent evaluation can complement conventional pretraining benchmarks by providing a practical diagnostic of interactive model behavior.

    Multimodal language models often need to reason about the physical dynamics of the world in order to answer questions appropriately. Various methods have emerged for solving physical reasoning tasks, and in particular, two leading approaches are Chain-of-Thought reasoning and physics-grounded simulation. However, relatively little is known about which particular problems can be solved by each approach. Some tasks may benefit from computationally expensive generative video simulations, whereas others may be solved equally well (or even better) with language-based reasoning. Our work addresses this by systematically comparing simulation and language reasoning across a variety of multimodal tasks involving physical reasoning, such as answering questions about fluid dynamics and elasticity. We draw a parallel with this to resource-rational theories of human cognition, which propose that people optimally trade off simulation and reasoning depending on task demands. We present a novel cognitively-inspired hybrid model which optimally trades off simulation and reasoning to improve model performance and computational efficiency. Our model is able to decide the appropriate method to solve a physical reasoning problem at test time, and finds an optimal balance between accuracy and cost. Further, our model can be trained on a smaller vision-language model that is only 4B parameters and deployed to improve performance on much bigger base models with $>$3T parameters like Gemini 3 Pro.

    Several recent studies propose detecting prompt injections from a language model's internal state. However, these methods do not measure a single security property. Residual-stream probes, attention scores, role projections, exposure probes, and concept readouts may capture injection presence, recognition, information routing, or behavioral influence. It is therefore unclear what differences in prompt-injection detection performance reveal about the internal signals these methods read. We study how five representation-reading methods vary under a common structured indirect prompt-injection setup on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it. We evaluate each method by how well it distinguishes injected prompts from benign controls. We then further analyze each detection method's ability to detect attacks in cases where they are successful and in cases where they are not. This helps us better assess what properties each detection method might rely on. Methods trained to detect injection presence or attack-related concepts generally separate unsuccessful injections more strongly from benign inputs, whereas attention diversion, exposure, and role-confusion-based methods separate successful injections more strongly on both models. Attention Tracker provides the strongest consistent successful injection separation, reaching 0.949 AUROC on Qwen and 0.887 on Gemma. These results suggest that signals closer to response formation may better encode information about an attack's success, and that detection performance can depend strongly on the prompt template. We share the data associated with this study at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/paper-evaluation-data-7877

    近期有多项研究提出从语言模型的内部状态检测提示注入。然而，这些方法衡量的并非同一种安全属性。残差流探针、注意力分数、角色投影、暴露探针和概念读出，可能捕捉的是注入是否存在、模型是否识别到注入、信息路由，或行为影响。因此，提示注入检测性能的差异究竟揭示了这些方法读取的内部信号的哪些特征，目前尚不明确。我们在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 和 Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 上，基于一种共同的结构化间接提示注入设置，研究五种表征读取方法的差异。我们评估每种方法区分注入提示与良性对照的能力。随后，我们进一步分析各检测方法在攻击成功和攻击失败的情况下检测攻击的能力。这有助于我们更好地评估每种检测方法可能依赖的属性。在检测注入是否存在或攻击相关概念方面训练的方法，通常能更清晰地区分失败的注入与良性输入；而基于注意力转移、暴露和角色混淆的方法，在两个模型上都能更清晰地区分成功的注入。Attention Tracker 对成功注入的区分效果最强且最稳定，在 Qwen 上达到 0.949 AUROC，在 Gemma 上达到 0.887。这些结果表明，更接近响应形成过程的信号可能更充分地编码了攻击是否成功的信息，并且检测性能可能高度依赖提示模板。我们在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/paper-evaluation-data-7877 分享了本研究相关数据。

    MIPS: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Reinforcement Learning for Large Outcome Spaces

    MIPS：缓解大结果空间强化学习中的模式坍塌

    Armaan Sandhu, Abhijeet Sinha, Dianbo Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MIPS introduces a marginal probability estimation method for RL policy gradients to sustain diverse, high-quality outcomes in large outcome spaces, with evidence across synthetic and scientific tasks. This advances training for solution generation, though the abstract does not focus on reasoning mechanisms or capabilities specifically.

    MIPS 提出一种用于强化学习策略梯度的边际概率估计方法，以在大型结果空间中维持多样且高质量的结果，并在合成任务和科学任务上提供了证据。这推动了解生成训练的发展，但摘要并未聚焦于推理机制或能力本身。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Expected-reward maximization in reinforcement learning concentrates probability mass on a few outcomes, even in tasks that require many distinct, high-quality solutions, a failure known as mode collapse. Inverse Probability Scaling (IPS) counters this in group-based policy gradients such as GRPO by dividing each reward by the outcome's probability, estimated from its frequency within the sampled group. When the outcome space is large relative to the group, outcomes rarely repeat and these estimates become uninformative. Since an outcome can be constructed along many trajectories, its probability is a sum over all of them, and computing it directly is intractable. We propose Marginal IPS (MIPS), which performs marginal evaluation by combining the sampled trajectory with a learned model of the trajectories that lead to each outcome. On Hypergrids, where the exact sampling distribution is computable, MIPS stays near the reward-distribution target as the outcome space grows relative to the rollout group, while frequency-based IPS degrades. In molecular synthesis and phylogenetic inference, MIPS sustains diverse, high-quality sampling where GRPO and frequency-based IPS collapse, showing that MIPS serves as a reliable solution to mode collapse in RL.

    中文

    在强化学习中，最大化期望奖励会将概率质量集中到少数结果上，即使任务要求生成大量不同的高质量解；这种失效称为模式坍塌。逆概率缩放（IPS）通过将每项奖励除以结果的概率来应对这一问题，适用于 GRPO 等基于组的策略梯度方法，其中结果概率根据其在采样组中的出现频率估计。当结果空间相对于采样组较大时，结果很少重复，这些估计便会失去信息量。由于一个结果可以沿着许多条轨迹构造，其概率是所有这些轨迹概率之和，直接计算这一概率不可行。我们提出边际 IPS（MIPS），通过将采样轨迹与一个学习得到的、描述哪些轨迹会导向各结果的模型相结合，执行边际评估。在 Hypergrids 上，由于可以计算精确的采样分布，随着结果空间相对于 rollout 组增大，MIPS 仍能接近奖励分布目标，而基于频率的 IPS 则会退化。在分子合成和系统发育推断任务中，GRPO 和基于频率的 IPS 都会发生模式坍塌，而 MIPS 能持续生成多样且高质量的样本。这表明 MIPS 是解决强化学习模式坍塌问题的一种可靠方法。

    PFedMA contributes feedback-driven agent selection, response evaluation, and evolving privacy rules for multi-round federated collaboration.     PFedMA 在多轮联邦协作中提供由反馈驱动的智能体选择、响应评估和隐私规则演进。这对智能体系统组织作出了重要贡献；协作和推理任务属于其评测内容，但摘要未能确立其对推理机制或组合泛化的主要贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Federated Multi-Agent Systems (FedMAS) offer a promising paradigm for collaborative reasoning among LLM-based agents while keeping raw client data decentralized. However, reliable multi-round collaboration remains challenging. Agent selection must take into consideration evolving task requirements and the agent's historical reliability, while privacy rules must adapt to changing collaboration contexts and meet the client's personalized needs. To address these challenges, we propose PFedMA, a federated multi-agent framework for feedback driven multi-round collaboration under heterogeneous privacy requirements. Across rounds, PFedMA maintains historical capability and reliability states to guide agent selection, evaluates task responses before aggregation, and refines subsequent queries according to accumulated collaboration feedback. PFedMA enables bidirectional local to global and global to local private rule evolution across heterogeneous clients. Clients generalize locally updated privacy rules and selectively incorporate globally maintained rules, thereby facilitating cross-client privacy rule evolution while preserving personalized constraints. Extensive experiments across reasoning, privacy sensitive, and adversarial settings show that PFedMA improves task performance, reduces measured privacy leakage, and improves system robustness.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MemCode introduces discrete semantic coding, associative retrieval, and asynchronous consolidation for long-term agent memory, with improved benchmark accuracy and construction speed. Its codebook and atomic units have incidental connections to representation and composition, but the abstract focuses on a memory system rather than model internals or compositional capability.

    MemCode 为长期智能体记忆引入离散语义编码、关联检索和异步整合，并提升了基准准确率与构建速度。其码本和原子单元与表征和组合存在附带联系，但摘要聚焦于记忆系统，而非模型内部机制或组合能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-term memory remains a fundamental bottleneck for large language model (LLM) agents across sessions. Existing systems typically adopt a write-then-retrieve paradigm, storing context-dependent dialogue fragments and retrieving them via nearest-neighbor search in a continuous embedding space. This design yields unstable access units and systematically misses logically related but lexically distant evidence. We propose MemCode, a long-term agent memory framework that couples retrieval-oriented writing with discrete associative retrieval. MemCode rewrites dialogue into self-contained atomic memory units (AMUs), maps AMUs into a learnable codebook with isomorphic semantic quantization (ISQ), and uses codebook co-occurrence topology as a retrieval path complementary to vector search. For long-term memory stores, MemCode separates online atomic writes from asynchronous offline consolidation. On LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo with GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 backbones, MemCode achieves the best overall accuracy while keeping per-dialogue memory construction within roughly 40~130 seconds, making it 3~21 times faster than LightMem and over an order of magnitude faster than A-MEM and MemoryOS.

    Questions about an agent's history often require aggregating events, which retrieval alone does not resolve. We combine source-preserving evidence access with executable aggregation.     Yanshu Li, Ruixiang Tang, Junyi Jessy Li, Elias Stengel-Eskin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ActICL trains a multimodal agent to identify information gaps through iterative reasoning and use targeted retrieval to build an ICL context, with joint post-training of acquisition and answering. Its main contributions concern reasoning and agent behavior; composing demonstrations is incidental, with no substantive focus on compositional generalization or internal mechanisms.

    ActICL 训练多模态智能体通过迭代推理识别信息缺口，并利用定向检索构建 ICL 上下文，同时对上下文获取和回答能力进行联合后训练。其主要贡献涉及推理和智能体行为；示例组合只是附带内容，没有实质性关注组合泛化或内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal in-context learning (ICL) is an important capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Its performance is closely tied to the demonstrations it uses, making demonstration retrieval a core problem for ICL. Common methods use fixed scoring methods to retrieve all the demonstrations at once, which may introduce redundancy and noise. Context-aware retrieval methods have emerged to address this problem by allowing incremental retrieval from a growing context. However, none of them lets the MLLM learn how to judge what new demonstrations it needs and then carry out progressive retrieval on its own. To this end, we introduce ActICL, which trains an MLLM agent to acquire and use an ICL context via tool-augmented reasoning. An ActICL agent analyzes its own information gaps during iterative reasoning and tool-use actions. Based on these gaps, it performs targeted retrieval to acquire a set of initial candidates. It can then use the existing context to further filter the candidates and refine the context, or it can iteratively perform a new retrieval. When the agent judges that the context is sufficient for the task, or when the resource limit is reached with the user request met, it sends the acquired context to an answering model, either the agent itself or another MLLM. We use a two-stage post-training procedure that jointly optimizes the agent's acquisition and answering. With an adaptive number of demonstrations, ActICL improves average performance by 11.6 percentage points over standard similarity-based retrieval across seven benchmarks and three MLLMs, and by 4.4 points compared to the strongest prior baseline. The contexts acquired by ActICL agents can also be used effectively by frontier models. When GPT-5.6-Sol performs 4-shot ICL, ActICL's contexts improve its performance by 3.5 points over standard retrieval, averaged over three benchmarks.

    中文

    多模态上下文学习（ICL）是多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的一项重要能力。其表现与所用示例密切相关，因此示例检索是 ICL 的核心问题。常见方法采用固定评分方法，一次性检索所有示例，这可能引入冗余和噪声。为解决这一问题，已有上下文感知检索方法允许从不断扩展的上下文中增量检索。然而，这些方法都没有让 MLLM 学会判断自己需要哪些新示例，并自主进行渐进式检索。为此，我们提出 ActICL，通过工具增强推理训练 MLLM 智能体获取和使用 ICL 上下文。ActICL 智能体会在迭代推理和工具使用过程中分析自身的信息缺口。基于这些缺口，它会有针对性地检索一组初始候选项。随后，它可以利用已有上下文进一步筛选候选项并完善上下文，也可以迭代地进行新一轮检索。当智能体判断上下文足以完成任务，或者已满足用户请求且达到资源限制时，它会将获取的上下文发送给回答模型，该模型可以是智能体本身，也可以是另一个 MLLM。我们采用两阶段后训练流程，对智能体的上下文获取和回答能力进行联合优化。在示例数量自适应的情况下，ActICL 在七个基准和三种 MLLM 上的平均表现比标准的基于相似度的检索高 11.6 个百分点，比最强的先前基线高 4.4 个百分点。ActICL 智能体获取的上下文也能被前沿模型有效利用。在三个基准上的平均结果中，GPT-5.6-Sol 执行 4-shot ICL 时，使用 ActICL 的上下文比使用标准检索提升 3.5 个百分点。

However, blocks are still denoised in strict sequence, a cost that within-block acceleration leaves untouched. Here, we investigate decoding blocks concurrently and propose One Block Ahead (OBA), a training-free decoding algorithm that denoises the next block alongside the current one. We demonstrate that for uniform-state diffusion LMs, where a block's denoising progress is not visible in its intermediate tokens, concurrent decoding is advantageous if the next block's tokens are promoted together with the corresponding sampler state, including the self-conditioning signal and the denoising time. We also derive a break-even criterion that relates the benefit of OBA to the relative cost of a paired-block forward pass. On DiffusionGemma, a state-of-the-art diffusion LM, OBA increases the tokens per forward pass by 42.3% (from 15.64 to 22.25) and the single-request denoising throughput by 16.3%, averaged over ten benchmarks, with a small accuracy regression.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SRAT trains a translation agent to decide when to retrieve, what evidence to retrieve, and how to use it, with retrieval and translation optimized for final quality. The learned action policy and retrieval organization are a substantial systems contribution; composition and reasoning are only incidental to combining evidence with translation, with no direct study of compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    SRAT 训练翻译智能体决定何时检索、检索哪些证据以及如何使用这些证据，并针对最终质量优化检索和翻译。学习到的动作策略和检索组织方式构成实质性的系统贡献；组合和推理只是将证据与翻译结合时的附带内容，没有直接研究组合泛化或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Retrieving external knowledge can improve large language model (LLM) translation by providing supplementary information such as idiom interpretations and terminology. However, existing retrieval-augmented machine translation systems typically apply predefined retrieval strategies uniformly across all inputs. We argue that translation operates in a partial-evidence regime: LLM's parametric knowledge suffices for many inputs, while external evidence benefits a subset and usually supports rather than directly provides the desired translation. This creates two challenges: deciding when to retrieve and what evidence to acquire. We introduce Selective Retrieval-Augmented Translation (SRAT), an agentic reinforcement learning framework that learns when to translate directly or retrieve, what to retrieve, and how to integrate these decisions by optimizing final translation quality. To align evidence retrieval with downstream translation quality rather than simple semantic similarity, we further develop joint Plackett--Luce optimization and translation-quality contrastive training for retriever-training. Experiments on idiom, knowledge-intensive, and document-level translation with offline or online retrieval show that SRAT consistently outperforms never- and always-retrieve baselines, and quality-aligned retriever training provides further gains when similarity-based retrieval is insufficient. The results demonstrate the benefit of treating retrieval as a learnable translation action rather than fixed preprocessing.

    ENGLISH

    Foundation models for dynamical systems can forecast unseen partial differential equations (PDEs), ordinary differential equations (ODEs), and time series during inference. However, it remains an open question whether these foundation models truly learn generalizable in-context forecasting strategies. We show that looped transformers are capable of emulating propagators for dynamical systems in-context by first establishing a link between linear attention and (extended) dynamic mode decomposition. We then generalize this insight into the $\textit{Test-Time Forecasting}$ (TTF) framework in which a one-step forecaster leverages iterations of gradient descent as recurrent depth. We demonstrate that lightweight TTF models trained on ODEs and PDEs generalize to out-of-distribution system dynamics during autoregressive rollout after being trained for one-step prediction.     In long-horizon tool-calling tasks, LLM agents can fail not only because of tool-use errors, but also because of ineffective interaction with users. Yet existing benchmarks largely assume cooperative and behaviorally stable users, leaving the effect of emotional variation on agent reliability underexplored. We introduce $\tau$-Emotion-Bench, a ten-domain benchmark for evaluating tool-calling agents under controlled emotion-conditioned user interactions while preserving the underlying task objective. To scale both benchmark construction and agent training, we introduce Tracer, a scalable agentic data-generation pipeline that constructs grounded, policy-valid tasks and collects trajectories through an interactive agent--user--environment harness. By allowing dissatisfied users to terminate inefficient interactions, the harness provides an interaction-aware signal that filters trajectories with excessive user dependence and favors effective tool use. Experiments with two user simulators show that frontier agents remain unreliable, with substantial gaps between average task success and consistent task completion. Tracer-generated supervision consistently improves Qwen3 models across scales, generalizes to unseen domains, and transfers to $\tau$-Bench and $\tau$-Trait. Behavioral analyses further show that higher task success is associated with a better balance between tool execution and necessary user follow-up. Overall, $\tau$-Emotion-Bench and Tracer provide a scalable framework for evaluating agent reliability under diverse user behaviors and improving tool-calling agents through interaction-aware supervision.

XferAgent reconciles compatible contributions from heterogeneous agents while avoiding unreliable merges.     A coding agent repeatedly makes decisions as it repairs code. These decisions shape repair trajectories and affect the token cost of successive model requests. We ask which repair decisions can be delegated to a low-cost probabilistic judge to reduce token use while maintaining repair quality. The judges answer questions with probabilities over predefined answers, without generating explanations. We evaluate judgment quality across repair stages and test how individual interventions change subsequent repair work. We compare these interventions with unguided repair, which uses no judge, and with the same workflow using the repair model itself as the judge. The benefit depends on the work an intervention changes, rather than the cost of the judgment alone. Based on these studies, we propose JevCoder, a workflow built around Jev, a low-cost probabilistic judge. It combines code-snippet recommendations with action-type guidance and uses judgments to determine when to submit. We evaluate three repair models, each on the same 400 tasks: 200 from SWE-bench Verified and 200 from SWE-Bench Pro Verified. Compared to unguided repair, JevCoder reduces mean repair-model token use by 21.6%-50.6%, with higher observed repair rates across all three models.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests a decision model’s performance and robustness on cognitive reflection, bias, and probability tasks, finding sensitivity to wording and answer order and frequent violations of a probability rule. This provides substantial empirical insight into reasoning capability and evaluation, while compositionality is only incidental to adapted task formulations and no internal mechanisms or system design are examined.

    论文测试了一个决策模型在认知反思、偏差和概率任务上的表现与稳健性，发现其对措辞和答案顺序敏感，并且经常违反一条概率规则。这为推理能力和评估提供了重要的实证洞见；组合性只通过改编任务表述间接涉及，也没有考察内部机制或系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Do AI models designed for fast, structured decisions exhibit the cognitive and social biases observed in human judgment? We evaluate Jev, a model described as a System One decision-maker, using 41,500 responses across cognitive reflection tasks, five classical cognitive-bias paradigms, and a pricing experiment testing ethnic and gender bias. At the level of selected answers, the results are largely encouraging. We confirm previous findings that Jev performs extremely well on cognitive reflection problems. We also observe that it generally avoids the characteristic choice patterns associated with several well-documented human biases, and exhibits only small differences among demographic groups in the tested pricing scenario. However, this apparent robustness conceals important vulnerabilities. Its judgments are sensitive to irrelevant numerical information and the ordering of response options. Moreover, several cognitive-bias manipulations substantially affect returned probabilities even when selected answers remain unchanged. Most strikingly, Jev answers a well-known probability problem correctly in every response but violates the same underlying probability rule in every response to an adapted version. We investigate this discrepancy using 15,000 additional responses across 30 conjunction tasks. Jev violates the rule in 54\% of responses, with accuracy varying dramatically across formulations and answer orders. These findings suggest that evaluating decision models solely on familiar benchmarks and selected answers may substantially overstate their reliability in practical applications. They also identify vulnerabilities for developers to address and practical considerations for users integrating such models into automated decision-making systems.

    We propose DAGFormer, a Transformer language model whose cross-layer connections are planned by a jointly trained topology predictor. Beyond the residual connections in a standard Transformer, DAGFormer adds direct connections from earlier layers to later ones, and the predictor controls the strength of every connection based on input tokens. Unlike existing cross-layer routing architectures, which set each layer's connections separately, DAGFormer plans the routing of the whole model at once. On matched OLMo-2 pairs from 75M to 1B parameters, DAGFormer lowers WikiText-2 perplexity by 17% to 25% over the vanilla Transformer, and a 1B DAGFormer trained on 5B tokens outperforms the vanilla model trained on 10B. Against four routing baselines with the same data and budget, it reaches the lowest perplexity at 75M, 300M and 1B. The gain carries over to 13 commonsense, science, reading and math evaluation tasks (2.0 to 2.5 points higher mean accuracy at 300M and 1B) and to instruction finetuning (63% to 70% AlpacaEval win rate against the vanilla Transformer, leading every routing baseline), and under structured pruning DAGFormer degrades the least in five of six settings.

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning provides a direct mechanism for optimizing task objectives in large language model-driven agents, but task rewards are typically sparse trajectory-level signals that only evaluate task success, without directly supervising action-conditioned environment transitions, leaving the model with limited explicit understanding of action consequences and environment dynamics. Recent work introduces auxiliary supervision through policy and world modeling co-training, yet typically treats complete environmental observations uniformly as world modeling targets, overlooking the varying decision relevance of observation content. We propose DGS-WM (Decision-Guided Selective World Modeling), a decision-guided policy-world modeling co-training approach for language agents. DGS-WM employs a Decision-Guided Observation Selection component that filters observation units with decision value as world modeling targets based on their support for subsequent policy responses, and a Confidence-Adaptive Weighting component that adaptively adjusts supervision strength according to the model's prediction confidence on selected targets. Together, these components form a decision-aware auxiliary world modeling loss, jointly optimized with the RL loss on the same policy model. Across multiple benchmarks covering single-hop/multi-hop question answering and interactive web tasks, DGS-WM achieves consistent improvements under different model scales and RL algorithms, demonstrating more stable and effective performance compared to full-observation world modeling methods.

Harmful knowledge can cause regression: changing a correct answer into an incorrect one. We construct a medical knowledge-poisoning benchmark covering retrieved evidence and reasoning chains, with seven attack families filtered by a three-judge "subtle-but-wrong" vote and paired clean exams that separate poisoning effects from question difficulty. No fixed knowledge-use strategy is robust across these settings: strong RAG methods trade robustness to poisoned evidence against accuracy when evidence is useful. We formulate knowledge use as per-instance routing and introduce Med-TrustRouter, a lightweight controller that keeps the solver frozen. From leakage-free runtime signals, it estimates each action's expected correctness gain and uncertainty, preserving the base answer unless another action is confidently better. Across seven medical reasoning settings, Med-TrustRouter achieves 78.9 macro and 69.2 worst-case accuracy, matching the strongest competitor on macro accuracy while substantially improving the worst-case floor. Its gains transfer across solvers and evidence judges, unlike a hand-coded router using the same signals. Similar performance across linear, tree, and neural action-value heads suggests that the benefit comes from routing rather than estimator complexity. These results support learning when to trust external knowledge for robust clinical reasoning.

    中文

    临床推理 LLM 需要外部医学知识，但检索到的证据和推理链可能过时、遭到投毒或由模型幻觉产生。有害知识可能导致回归：把正确答案变成错误答案。我们构建了一个医学知识投毒基准，涵盖检索证据和推理链；其中包含七类攻击，经三位评审者以“隐蔽但错误”投票筛选，并配有成对的干净试题，以区分投毒效应与题目难度。在这些设定中，没有一种固定的知识使用策略具有鲁棒性：强大的 RAG 方法需要在抵御遭投毒证据的鲁棒性与证据有用时的准确率之间权衡。我们将知识使用建模为逐实例路由，并提出 Med-TrustRouter，这是一种保持求解器冻结的轻量级控制器。它根据无信息泄漏的运行时信号，估计每种操作预期带来的正确性提升及其不确定性；除非另一种操作有较高把握能带来更好结果，否则保留基础答案。在七种医学推理设定中，Med-TrustRouter 的宏平均准确率为 78.9，最差情形准确率为 69.2；其宏平均准确率与最强竞争方法持平，同时显著提高了最差情形的准确率下限。与使用相同信号的手工编写路由器不同，它的收益可以迁移到不同求解器和证据评审者。线性、树模型和神经网络动作价值头的表现相近，这表明收益来自路由本身，而非估计器的复杂度。这些结果支持学习何时信任外部知识，以实现鲁棒的临床推理。

    MCAIR: Monitoring and Correcting Agent Unfaithfulness via Internal Representations

    MCAIR：通过内部表征监控并纠正智能体的不忠实行为

    Yan Xu, Dandan Song, Luan Zhang, Jun Yang, Ke Duan, Yuhang Tian, Yading Li, Xudong Li, Xing Pei, Guangyuan Feng, Chenhao Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MCAIR trains probes on agents’ internal representations to detect unfaithful execution and uses the signals to guide corrections, a substantial contribution to representation-based monitoring and agent runtime design. The work concerns multi-step agents, but its central contribution is detecting report-execution inconsistency rather than advancing reasoning or compositional generalization.

    MCAIR 利用智能体的内部表征训练探针，以检测不忠实执行，并用这些信号指导纠正，是对基于表征的监控和智能体运行时设计的重要贡献。本文研究多步智能体，但其核心贡献是检测报告与执行之间的不一致，而非推进推理或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in completing complex tasks through multi-step reasoning and tool interactions. However, recent studies have revealed that LLM-based agents can exhibit unfaithful behaviors, where their final reports fail to faithfully reflect their actual execution trajectories. Specifically, when agents fail to accomplish tasks through the intended sources or procedures, they may resort to alternative sources or strategies while failing to disclose such deviations, leading users to incorrectly believe that the tasks have been completed according to the original requirements. We refer to this specific form of agent unfaithfulness as Agent Completion Unfaithfulness. Detecting and mitigating agent completion unfaithfulness is critical yet remains largely unexplored. In this work, we propose MCAIR, a runtime monitoring and correction framework that leverages internal representations of LLM-based agents. MCAIR uses multi-step internal representations as inputs to train a risk-aware probe, enabling online detection of potential completion unfaithfulness during execution. Furthermore, MCAIR introduces a risk-guided correction loop that prompts agents to review their execution history and mitigate potential inconsistencies between their execution trajectories and final reports. Additionally, we construct ACUD, a dataset for Agent Completion Unfaithfulness detection that provides step-level execution traces, step-level internal representations, and consistency annotations for training and evaluating runtime detection probes. Experiments demonstrate that MCAIR outperforms LLM-as-a-judge baselines, generalizes across prompts and tasks, and effectively reduces agent completion unfaithfulness.

    中文

    基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体已展现出卓越能力，能够通过多步推理和工具交互完成复杂任务。然而，近期研究揭示，基于 LLM 的智能体可能出现不忠实行为，即其最终报告未能忠实反映实际执行轨迹。具体而言，当智能体未能通过预期的信息来源或流程完成任务时，可能转而采用其他来源或策略，却没有披露这些偏离，导致用户误以为任务已按原始要求完成。我们将这种特定形式的智能体不忠实行为称为智能体完成不忠实。检测并缓解智能体完成不忠实至关重要，但迄今对此研究仍很少。在本文中，我们提出 MCAIR，这是一种利用基于 LLM 的智能体内部表征进行运行时监控和纠正的框架。MCAIR 将多步内部表征作为输入来训练风险感知探针，从而能够在执行过程中在线检测潜在的完成不忠实行为。此外，MCAIR 引入风险引导的纠正循环，提示智能体回顾其执行历史，并缓解执行轨迹与最终报告之间可能存在的不一致。我们还构建了 ACUD，即用于检测智能体完成不忠实的数据集，其中包含逐步执行轨迹、逐步内部表征和一致性标注，可用于训练和评估运行时检测探针。实验表明，MCAIR 优于 LLM-as-a-judge 基线，能够泛化到不同提示和任务，并有效减少智能体完成不忠实行为。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SRP-SFT preserves selected non-target logit-margin relations, with analysis of its KL cost and feasible region and experiments showing gains on math and code tasks. This is a substantial training contribution to reasoning capability; logit-margin behavior alone does not amount to mechanistic interpretability, and the abstract gives no compositional or systems contribution.

    SRP-SFT 保留选定的非目标 logit 边际关系，并分析其 KL 代价和可行区域；实验显示它能提升数学和代码任务的表现。这是对推理能力的重要训练贡献；仅有 logit 边际行为并不构成机制可解释性，摘要也未体现组合性或系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) changes logit margins among non-target tokens at teacher-forced prefixes. Matching a local reference distribution keeps those probabilities and also penalizes margin expansions. We ask whether a soft auxiliary can preserve selected local non-target margin relations without freezing that distribution. We introduce \textbf{Selective Rank-Preserving SFT (SRP-SFT)}, a soft margin target: a hinge on reference-scaled lower bounds for pairs from the reference's top-$K$ non-target tokens, applied at fixed teacher-forced prefixes. The hinge stops once the requested bound is met. We derive the KL cost of violating a margin, characterize the feasible region and its conditional utility, and give a finite-step condition for reducing aggregate violations. In one-epoch experiments on Qwen3-4B-Base and UltraFeedback, this target raises MATH-500 and code-generation scores over CE and LP-SFT at all three training seeds. At seed 1234, MATH-500 pass@1 rises from 49.56\% to 54.56\% and the four-metric code mean rises from 65.91\% to 69.50\% relative to LP-SFT. Ranking controls, held-out cache diagnostics, sensitivity sweeps, and six additional backbones show where these score changes appear.
